qe: The survey officer visited Nawadeh, where a Jain temple stands on a small square terrace in the middle of a tank. What did the two carved stones in the temple bear on their top?
qh: सर्वेक्षण में नवादा पहुँचने पर वहाँ तालाब के बीच छोटे वर्गाकार चबूतरे पर एक जैन मंदिर मिला। मंदिर के दो तराशे हुए पत्थरों के ऊपर क्या बना हुआ था?
oe: Resemblances of the human feet surrounded by short inscriptions
A carved lotus with a bull
The figure of a seated Buddha
The figure of a Jain Tirthankara
oh: मानवीय चरणों के चिह्न, जिनके चारों ओर छोटे अभिलेख खुदे थे
e: Gaya kshetra ke sarvekshan me Nawadeh naam ke ek chhote bazaar gaon ka zikr milta hai. Wahan ek talaab hai, jo purab-pashchim lambai me phaila hua tha tatha kai tarah ke paudhon se bhara pada tha. Talaab ke beech ek chhote vargakar chabutre par ek mandir bana hua tha; yah ek chhota magar suhavana bhawan tha, jiske upar ek gumbad tha tatha wahan pahunchne ke liye ek purani sadak tatha eenton ka bana saral pat tha. Mandir achhi halat me tha, isliye andaza lagaya gaya ki sau saal purana hote hue bhi yah kai baar theek kiya gaya hoga. Mandir ke andar do patthar the, jinpar bahut tarashai ki gayi thi tatha jo purane lagte the; inme se ek patthar to chhura hua tha. In pattharon ke upar manushya ke pairon ke chinh bane the tatha unke charon or chhote-chhote abhilekh khude the. Aashcharya ki baat yah thi ki us talaab ke aas-paas kisi purane Bauddh ya Jain vihar ka koi nishan nahi mila tatha wahan ek bhi Jain nahi rahta tha. Exam point: Nawadeh ke talaab ke beech chhote chabutre par ek gumbad wala mandir tha; uske do tarashe pattharon ke upar manav pairon ke chinh tatha unke charon or chhote abhilekh khude the tatha unme se ek patthar chhura hua tha; us kshetra me Jain ya Bauddh vihar ka koi nishan nahi mila.

qe: The surveyor saw under a tree at a village named Karim a broken image of which deity, which the people of the vicinity had renamed and were worshipping?
qh: करीम नाम के गाँव में एक पेड़ के नीचे सर्वेक्षक ने किस देवता की टूटी प्रतिमा देखी, जिसका नाम बदलकर आसपास के लोग उसकी पूजा कर रहे थे?
e: Gaya kshetra me sarvekshan karte hue ek gaon Karim me, ek ped ke niche, kuch tooti-phooti murtiyan dekhi gayin. Inme ek murti Buddha ki thi, jo unki sabse aam mudra yaani posture me bani hui thi. Us daur me Bauddh dharm ka prabhav khatm ho chuka tha tatha logon ko is baat ki jaankari nahi thi ki yah murti kis devta ki hai; isliye gaon ke aas-paas ke logon ne us murti ka naam badal kar uski puja shuru kar di thi. Sarvekshan afsar ko bataya gaya ki jile ke is bhag me aisi murtiyan bahut aam hain tatha unhe Rajgriha se la kar yahan sthapit kiya gaya tha. Aise nishaan dikhate hain ki prachin Bauddh sthalon ki murtiyan samay ke saath lok-devtaon me badal gayin tatha gaon ki puja ka hissa ban gayin. Exam point: Karim gaon me ped ke niche Buddha ki ek tooti hui murti mili, jise sthanik logon ne naya naam de kar puja shuru kar di thi; bataya gaya ki aisi murtiyan is kshetra me aam hain tatha unhe Rajgriha se la kar yahan rakha gaya tha.

qe: On his way to Nawadeh the surveyor noted a ruined old mud fort near which was a small neat mosque. Who was the fort said to have belonged to?
qh: नवादा जाते समय सर्वेक्षक ने जर्जर पुरानी मिट्टी की गढ़ी देखी, जिसके पास सुंदर सी एक मस्जिद थी। वह गढ़ी किसकी बताई जाती थी?
e: Gaya kshetra ke sarvekshan me ek jagah se doosri jagah jate hue raaste me kai purane nishan dikhe. Nawadeh ki or jate samay ek purani mitti ki gadhi mili, jo us samay jarda-jarda hokar toot chuki thi; yah gadhi Kamdar Khan ki batai jaati thi tatha uske paas hi ek chhota magar sundar tareeke se bana hua masjid tha. Itne saalon me gadhi dhal gayi, lekin masjid abhi bhi khadi thi; isse andaza milta hai ki us daur me aisi mitti ki gadhiyan sabse pehle toot-ti thin, jabki pakki eenton se bane dharmik bhawan lambe samay tak tike rahte the. Isi safar me jile me aise gumbad-dar-gumbad eenton ki dhair bhi milti rahi, jo purane mandiron tatha mathon ke nishaan the. Exam point: Nawadeh ki or jate hue raaste me Kamdar Khan ki purani mitti ki gadhi mili, jo jarda-jarda hokar toot chuki thi; uske paas ek chhota sundar masjid tha; aise sthal dikhate hain ki mitti ke banaye bhawan jaldi tootte the tatha eenton ke bane bhawan der tak khade rahte the.

qe: The surveyor came to a ruined mud fort on a fine rising ground, and a quarter of a mile beyond it found a small heap of bricks with what upon it?
qh: सर्वेक्षक एक ऊँची अच्छी भूमि पर बनी जर्जर मिट्टी की गढ़ी तक पहुँचा, तथा उससे पौन मील आगे ईंटों का छोटा ढेर मिला, जिस पर क्या रखा था?
e: Gaya kshetra ke is safar me ek sthal par ek purani mitti ki gadhi mili, jo ek unchi tatha aankhon ko bhane wali zameen par bani hui thi; wahan se aas-paas ka poora drishya dikhta tha. Is gadhi me ek bada mitti ka kila tha tatha kaha jaata tha ki yah bhi puraane zamindaron ki rahi hogi. Gadhi se lagbhag paun mile aage eenton ka ek chhota dher mila, jispar do shivling rakhe hue the; iske aage ek talaab ke paar eenton ka ek aur bada dher bhi mila. In nishanon ko dekh kar sarvekshan afsar ne yah andaza lagaya ki Musalmano ke aane se pehle yah sthal Hindu samaj me koi mahatvapurn jagah rahi hogi, kyunki shivling tatha eenton ke dher aise sthalon ke purane nishaan hote hain. Is tarah purane tille tatha eenton ke dher aise sthalon ke itihas ke gawah ban jaate hain. Exam point: ek unchi zameen par purani mitti ki gadhi mili tatha uske paas eenton ke dher milte the; gadhi se paun mile aage eenton ke chhote dher par do shivling tatha aage bade dher ke nishan mile; sarvekshan afsar ne isse yah andaza lagaya ki Musalman rajaon se pehle yah sthal Hindu samaj me mahatvapurn tha.

qe: At Morera, about five miles beyond the Sakri river, the surveyor saw a considerable brick building which was the residence of some Sannyasis. What was it called?
qh: साकरी नदी से लगभग पाँच मील आगे मोरेरा में सर्वेक्षक ने ईंटों की एक बड़ी इमारत देखी, जो कुछ संन्यासियों का निवास थी। उसे क्या कहा जाता था?
e: Gaya kshetra me sarvekshan ke dauran ek sthal Morera par eenton ki ek badi imarat mili. Yah imarat kuch sanyasiyon ka nivas thi tatha usay Math kaha jaata tha. In sanyasiyon ke paas us eenton ki imarat ke alava kai bade mitti ke gharon ka samooh bhi tha; is tarah dikhta hai ki us daur me math tatha akhade keval ek imarat nahi hote the, balki ek chhote gaon jaise aawas ban jaate the, jahan anek kothiyan tatha rasoiyan chalti thin. Aise sansthan sanyasiyon ke bharan-poshan tatha unke aahar ka pura bandobast rakhte the; isliye unke paas kheti wali zameen tatha gaushale bhi hoti thin. Yah baat dikhati hai ki us daur me math tatha sadhu-sansthaon ka gaon ki zameen tatha arthavyavastha par bhi bharpur asar tha. Exam point: Morera me eenton ki badi imarat Math kehlati thi tatha woh sanyasiyon ka nivas thi; unke paas kai bade mitti ke ghar bhi the; aise math tatha akhade khadi zameen tatha gaushala ke saath apna aarthik bandobast chalate the.

qe: When the surveyor's men were sent to look for rock crystal near Buduya, they were at first frightened away by whom?
qh: बुडुया के निकट फत्तिक ढूँढने भेजे गए सर्वेक्षक के आदमियों को सबसे पहले किसने डरा कर भगाया?
oe: The owners of the quarry and their traders
oh: खान के मालिक तथा उनके व्यापारी
e: Gaya kshetra me phatik yaani rock crystal dhoondhna aasan kaam nahi tha. Jab sarvekshak ke aadmi Buduya ke paas ki do pahadiyon par phatik dhoondhne bheje gaye, to unke saath bheja gaya vyapari unhe galat jagahon par le gaya tatha unhe dara-dhamka kar bhaga diya. Khan ke maalik tatha unse jude vyapari aise sthal ka pata bahar wale ko nahi dete the, kyunki unka poora munafa isi baat par tika tha ki khan ka asli sthal gupt rahe. Kuch samay baad jab sarvekshak ne das rupe mahine ke kharch ka zikr kiya tatha maalik par dabav dala, tab ek vyapari ne khud bataya ki phatik ka sthal asal me Buduya se kuch door, pahadiyon ke beech hai. Is tarah vyaparik munaafe ke kaaran khanon ki jaankari gupt rakhi jaati thi. Exam point: phatik ki khan ki jaankari khane ke maalik tatha unke vyapari gupt rakhte the tatha sarvekshak ke aadmiyon ko darate tatha galat jagah le jaate the; dabav padne par hi ek vyapari ne bataya ki asli sthal Buduya se kuch door pahadiyon me hai.

qe: Tikuli art, a craft of Patna revived from an 800-year-old tradition, is made on which base material?
qh: पटना की 800 वर्ष पुरानी परंपरा से पुनर्जीवित टिकुली कला किस आधार-सामग्री पर बनाई जाती है?
e: Tikuli art Patna kshetra ki ek purani kala hai; 'tikuli' shabd ka sambandh tikli ya kaanch ke chhote tukron se hai, isliye ismein kaanch (glass) ke adhaar par rang-birange chitra tatha design banaye jaate hain. Purane samay me mahilaayein mathe par tikuli lagati thi tatha uski sajavat ke liye aisi kalakari hoti thi; samay ke saath yah kala kam ho gayi thi, lekin Patna ke kalakaron, khaas taur par Ashok Kumar Biswas, ke prayason se ise dobara jeevit kiya gaya. Aaj tikuli par Radha-Krishna, Buddha, machhli tatha lok-aakritiyon ke chitra bana kar wall hangings, aise chitra bana kar wall hangings tatha gift items banaye jaate hain, jo desh-videsh me bikte hain. Clay pots par Mithila ki mitti-kala, bamboo se Sikki, pital se Barh ki brass work tatha Gaya se patthar ki murtiyan judi hain - isliye Tikuli ke liye kaanch hi sahi hai. Exam point: Tikuli art = Patna ki kaanch (glass) par bani lok-kala, lagbhag 800 varsh purani parampara se punarjeevit; Ashok Kumar Biswas is kala ke jane-jaane kalakar hain.

qe: Manjusha art, a folk painting tradition, belongs to which region of Bihar?
qh: लोक-चित्रकला परंपरा मंजूषा कला बिहार के किस क्षेत्र से संबंधित है?
e: Manjusha art Bihar ka ek lok-chitran (folk painting) hai jo Anga kshetra, mukhya roop se Bhagalpur tatha uske aas-paas ke ilaake se juda hai; ise 'Karnamandal' kala bhi kaha jaata hai, kyunki iska sambandh Karn tatha Bihula ki lok-katha se jodkar dekha jaata hai. Isme manjusha (ek patra ya dabi) ke aakaran ke bhande tatha kagaz par lambi tatha seedhi lines ke beech chhote-chhote chitra banaye jaate hain; rang mukhya roop se teen hote hain - hariyali (green), peela (yellow) tatha gulaabi (pink). Yah kala Bihula-Bishhari ki puja se judi hai, isliye iska naam Manasa devi ki katha se bhi joda jaata hai. Mithila ki Madhubani chitrakala tatha Sikki kala, Magadh ke tilkut tatha Saran ke Sonepur mela anya pehchan hain - isliye Manjusha ke liye Anga kshetra (Bhagalpur) hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: Manjusha art (Karnamandal kala) = Anga kshetra, Bhagalpur; rang mukhya roop se teen - green, yellow tatha pink; Bihula-Bishhari lok-katha se judi lok-chitrakala; Madhubani painting Mithila ki alag kala hai.

qe: Godna painting, a style painted on canvas by Dalit artists, was pioneered mainly by which artist from Bihar?
qh: दलित कलाकारों द्वारा कैनवास पर बनाई जाने वाली गोदना चित्रकला को मुख्य रूप से बिहार की किस कलाकार ने आगे बढ़ाया?
e: Godna kala mool roop se shareer par godne (tattoo) jaisi parampara se nikli hai; aadivasi tatha dalit samudayon me godna banwana ek purani parampara rahi hai, jisme sabhi aay ke log apne shareer par aakritiyan gotwate the. Chano Devi ne isi parampara ko kagaz tatha canvas par utara tatha 'Godna painting' ko pehchan dilai; woh Raja Salhesh ki lok-kathayein tatha samaajik samanata ke sandesh apne chitron me dikhati hain. Isi parampara ko aage badhane me Shanti Devi tatha Shivan Paswan ki jodi ko 2024 me Padma Shri mila, jinhone godna kala ko videshon me bhi prasiddh kiya. Mahasundari Devi tatha Baua Devi Mithila (Madhubani) chitrakala ki kalakar hain tatha Dulari Devi ko bhi isi Mithila kala ke liye Padma Shri mila - isliye Godna painting ke liye Chano Devi hi sahi uttar hain. Exam point: Godna painting = Dalit-aadivasi godna (tattoo) parampara se canvas tak layi gayi kala; pramukh kalakar Chano Devi; Shanti Devi tatha Shivan Paswan ko 2024 me sanyukt Padma Shri; Mahasundari Devi-Baua Devi-Dulari Devi Mithila kala ki kalakar hain.

qe: Applique (Khatwa) patchwork, which has a GI tag, is a craft in which pieces of cloth are:
qh: जीआई टैग प्राप्त कथवा (अप्लीके) पैचवर्क वह शिल्प है जिसमें कपड़े के टुकड़ों को:
oe: knitted with wool on hand machines
printed with wooden blocks and dyed in indigo
cut into shapes and stitched on a base fabric by hand
woven on a powerloom with jute yarn
oh: हाथ की मशीनों पर ऊन से बुना जाता है
लकड़ी के छापों से छापा जाता है तथा नील में रंगा जाता है
आकृतियों में काटकर मूल कपड़े पर हाथ से सिला जाता है
जूट के धागे से पॉवरलूम पर बुना जाता है
e: Khatwa (Applique) shilp me ek mool kapde (base fabric) ke upar alag-alag rangon ke kapdon ko geometric, phool-patti ya pashu-pakshi ke aakaron me kaat kar badee bareeki se haath se sila jaata hai, isliye ise patchwork ya applique kaha jaata hai. Yah kala Bihar me poori tarah haath ke kaam par adhaarit hai; Mughal tatha British kaal me shahi khaimon (tents) tatha shamiyane isi technique se sajaye jaate the. Is kala ko 2007 me GI (Geographical Indication) tag mila tatha iske mukhya cluster Patna (Fatuha), Muzaffarpur tatha Madhubani kshetra me hain; NIFT jaisi sansthaon ne ise aadhunik fashion se jodne me madad ki. Powerloom par bunai, wooden block printing tatha wool knitting anya prakar ki kalaen hain - isliye Khatwa ke liye 'aakritiyon me kaat kar haath se sina' hi sahi hai. Exam point: Khatwa/Applique = mool kapde par kaate hue tukdon ko haath se sine ki kala, GI tag 2007, mukhya cluster Patna (Fatuha), Muzaffarpur tatha Madhubani; Mughal-British kaaleen tents isi se bante the.

qe: Bawan Buti saree, which got a GI tag in 2023, is woven in which district of Bihar and contains how many traditional motifs?
qh: 2023 में जीआई टैग पाने वाली बावन बूटी साड़ी बिहार के किस जिले में बुनी जाती है तथा उसमें कितनी पारंपरिक बूटियाँ होती हैं?
e: Bawan Buti saree Nalanda jile ke Baswanbigha tatha Bihar Sharif kshetra me hathkargha (handloom) par bunti jaati hai; 'Bawan' ka arth hai 52 tatha 'Buti' ka arth hai chhoti chhitri ya design, isliye is saree me 52 paramparik butiyan (aakritiyan) bunti jaati hain. Iski khaas baat yah hai ki ek-ek buti haath se bunne me bahut samay lagta hai - ek saree taiyar karne me lagbhag 8 se 10 din ka kathin shram lagta hai. Kaha jaata hai ki bharat ke pratham Rashtrapati Dr. Rajendra Prasad, jo Bihar se the, unhone Rashtrapati Bhavan ke parde tatha table linen isi kala se banwaye the; 2023 me ise GI tag mila. Bhagalpur tussar silk ke liye, Darbhanga makhana ke liye tatha Gaya Patharkatti patthar-kala ke liye jaana jaata hai - isliye Bawan Buti ke liye 'Nalanda, bavan' hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: Bawan Buti saree = Nalanda (Baswanbigha, Bihar Sharif belt), 52 butiyan haath se buni jaati hain, GI tag 2023; Dr. Rajendra Prasad ke samay Rashtrapati Bhavan me iska upyog.

qe: Pattharkatti stone craft, which received a GI tag in 2023, belongs to which district of Bihar?
qh: 2023 में जीआई टैग प्राप्त पत्थरकट्टी पाषाण शिल्प बिहार के किस जिले का है?
e: Pattharkatti Gaya jile ka ek gaon (Khizirsarai/Atri kshetra) hai jahan sadiyon se patthar tarashne ki anokhi parampara chali aati hai; 2023 me is kala ko GI tag mila. Yahan ke shilpakar kaale 'kasauti' patthar tatha blue-black granite ko chheni-hathode se tarash kar Bhagwan Buddha, Bhagwan Vishnu tatha anya devi-devtaon ki sundar murtiyan banate hain. Bodh Gaya aane wale videshi Buddhist yatri (Thailand, Myanmar, Sri Lanka, Japan se) in murtiyon ko apne desh le jaate hain, isliye yah kala aarthik roop se bhi mahatvapurn hai. Lok-kathaon me yah bhi milta hai ki 18vein sadi me Gaya ke Vishnupad mandir ke nirman ke liye Indore ki Maharani Ahilyabai Holkar ne is kshetra me shilpakaron ko basaya tha; saans ki bimaari (silicosis) in shilpakaron ke liye ek badi samasya hai. Rohtas, Nawada tatha Munger anya patthar tatha khanij kshetra hain, lekin Pattharkatti kala Gaya se judi hai, isliye sahi uttar Gaya hai. Exam point: Pattharkatti stone craft = Gaya jila (Khizirsarai/Atri kshetra), GI tag 2023, kaale kasauti patthar tatha shilpkaron ki paramparik murti-kala; Bodh Gaya ke Buddhist yatri iske mukhya grahak hain.

qe: Sikki grass craft of Mithila, called 'golden grass', is used to make which of the following items?
qh: मिथिला की 'सुनहरी घास' कहलाने वाली सिक्की घास शिल्प से क्या बनाया जाता है?
e: Sikki grass (jise 'Golden Grass' ya sunhari ghaas kaha jaata hai) Mithilanchal ke talabon, dhabon tatha jheelon ke kinare barsaat ke baad natural roop se ugti hai; sukhane ke baad isme sone jaisi chamak aa jaati hai. Gaon ki mahilayein is ghaas ko pehle geela karke mulayam karti hain, phir patli doriyon me baant kar tokriyan, dabbe, jewellery box, coaster tatha sajavat ki wall-plates banai jaati hain. 'Pauti' naam ka aisa hi utpad Mithila ke vivaah sanskar me shubh maana jaata hai, isliye yah kala lok-parampara ka hissa hai; 2007 me Sikki ko GI tag mila. Loha ke auzar tatha tale, kaanch ki chudiyan tatha unke darpan, tatha chamde ke joote-bag alag shilp hain - isliye sahi uttar 'tokriyan, dabbe tatha sajavat ke utpad' hai. Exam point: Sikki grass craft = Mithila, 'Golden Grass' ke naam se prasiddh, GI tag 2007; isse tokri, dabbe tatha sajavat ke utpad bante hain; vivaah me 'Pauti' ka upyog shubh maana jaata hai.

qe: Silao, which got a GI tag for its 'khaja' sweet, is a town in which district of Bihar?
qh: अपने 'खाजा' मिष्ठान के लिए जीआई टैग पाने वाला सिलाव बिहार के किस जिले का कस्बा है?
e: Silao Nalanda jile ka ek qasba hai jo Rajgir tatha Bihar Sharif marg par sthit hai; yahan ka 'Silao Khaja' apni parat-dar (layered) banawat tatha meethas ke liye rajya bhar me prasiddh hai. 2018 me 'Silao Khaja' ko GI (Geographical Indication) tag mila, jisse is mithai ke naam ke saath uske kshetra ka vishesh rishta jud gaya. Lok-kathaon me Magadha samrajya tatha Gautam Buddha ke samay se hi is kshetra me khaja banane ki parampara maani jaati hai; aaj bhi yahan ke kaarigar aata, cheeni tatha ghee se haath se khaja banate hain tatha Rajgir aane wale yatree ise shauk se kharidte hain. Patna, Gaya tatha Begusarai ke bhi apne prasiddh khane hain (jaise Gaya ka tilkut), lekin Silao khaja Nalanda jile se juda hai, isliye sahi uttar Nalanda hai. Exam point: Silao Khaja (GI 2018) = Nalanda jila, Rajgir-Bihar Sharif marg par sthit qasba; Rajgir tatha Bodh Gaya jaane wale yatree ise kharidte hain.

qe: Papier-mache (Kutti art) of Madhubani, for which Subhadra Devi received the Padma Shri in 2023, is made by using:
qh: मधुबनी की पेपर-माशे (कुट्टी कला), जिसके लिए सुभद्रा देवी को 2023 में पद्म श्री मिला, किस सामग्री से बनाई जाती है?
oh: भट्ठियों में पिघलाया लोहे का कबाड़
रद्दी कागज से बनाया गया गूदा (pulp)
e: Papier-mache kala me raddi (waste) kagaz ko paani me bhigokar geela kiya jaata hai tatha uske gude (pulp) me gond tatha anya saamagri milakar ek lai taiyar ki jaati hai; isi lai se khilone, murtiyan, dabi tatha sajavat ke samaan banaye jaate hain. Madhubani ki Subhadra Devi ne isi 'Kutti art' ko naya jeevan diya, jisme kagaz ke gude ke saath kutti (kaat kar banaye chhote tukde) milakar teen-aayami (3D) aakritiyan banai jaati hain; unhe 2023 me Padma Shri mila. Yah kala paryavaran ke liye achhi hai kyunki isme kabad (waste) kagaz ka upyog hota hai tatha gaon ki mahilaon ko gharelu aay ka zariya bhi deta hai. Loha pighlane wali kala, baans ki patti se Sikki jaise utpad tatha sangmarmar-ya cement ki murtiyan alag shilp hain - isliye sahi uttar 'raddi kagaz ka guda (pulp)' hai. Exam point: Papier-mache/Kutti art = Madhubani, raddi kagaz ke gude (pulp) se teen-aayami khilone tatha murtiyan; Subhadra Devi ko 2023 me Padma Shri; yah kala paryavaran-anukool tatha gaon ki mahilaon ke liye aay ka srot hai.

qe: Which poet, honoured as 'Maithil Kavi Kokil' and 'Abhinava Jayadeva', is regarded as the father of Maithili literature and wrote 'Kirtilata'?
qh: 'मैथिल कवि कोकिल' तथा 'अभिनव जयदेव' की उपाधि पाने वाले तथा मैथिली साहित्य के जनक माने जाने वाले कवि कौन थे, जिन्होंने 'कीर्तिलता' लिखी?
e: Vidyapati Thakur ko 'Maithil Kavi Kokil' (Mithila ke kavi-koyal) tatha 'Abhinava Jayadeva' ke naam se yaad kiya jaata hai; 'abhinava' ka arth hai naya, yaani unhe Jayadeva jaisa kavi maana gaya. Unhone Maithili me 'Padavali' ki rachna ki jisme Radha-Krishna ke prem ka madhur varnan hai, tatha Sanskrit me 'Kirtilata' likhi jisme Mithila ke raja Shiva Singh (Oiniwar vansh) ke samay ke rajnitik tatha samajik drishya hain. 'Kirtilata' ko Mithila ka samkalin aitihasik dastavez maana jaata hai kyunki usme us daur ki ghatnayein kavi ki aankhon dekhi ke roop me milti hain. Vidyapati Oiniwar raja Shiv Singh ke darbar me rahe tatha unki rachnaon ka asar Bengali, Assamiya tatha Odia sahitya par bhi pada; unki padavali aaj bhi Mithila me vivaah ke avsar par gayi jaati hai. Nagarjun Hindi-Maithili ke jan kavi, Dinkar Rashtrakavi tatha Harimohan Jha Maithili hasya-vyangya ke lekhak the - teeno Vidyapati se alag samay ke hai. Exam point: Maithili ke janak = Vidyapati ('Maithil Kavi Kokil'), 'Kirtilata' Sanskrit me likhi, 'Padavali' Maithili me; Oiniwar raja Shiva Singh ke rajdarbari kavi.

qe: Which folk artist, called the 'Shakespeare of Bhojpuri', created the 'Bidesiya' form of folk theatre that portrayed the pain of migration?
qh: किस लोक-कलाकार को 'भोजपुरी का शेक्सपियर' कहा जाता है, जिन्होंने प्रवास की पीड़ा दिखाने वाला 'बिदेसिया' लोक रंगमंच का रूप रचा?
e: Bhikari Thakur (janm kutubpur, Saran) ko Bhojpuri lok-rangmanch ka sabse bada rachayita maana jaata hai, isliye unhe 'Bhojpuri ka Shakespeare' kaha jaata hai. Unhone 'Bidesiya' natak likha jisme gaon ka ek yuva kaam ke liye sheher-desh (kaale paani) chala jaata hai aur peechhe uski patni tatha parivar ka dukh darshaaya gaya; is natak ne guru-ghar (sasural) me chhoot-chhaat, rang-bhinn bhedbhav tatha dalit-narayan ki suno. Unka 'Bidesiya' shabd aaj bhi Bhojpuri sanskriti me door desh jaane wale mazdoor ki vyatha ka prateek hai. Unhone 20 se zyada natak likhe - jaise Bidesiya, Beti-Bechwa, Bhand-Aur-Gangaram, Kaljug-Prem - tatha khud inme abhinay kiya. Rameshwar Singh Kashyap ne radio ke liye 'Loha Singh' character banaya, Mahendra Misir 'Purvi' lok gayan ke kavi the tatha Ramchandra Manjhi 'Launda Naach' ke aakhri bade kalakar the, isliye woh alag shakhsiyat hain. Exam point: 'Bhojpuri ka Shakespeare' = Bhikari Thakur, 'Bidesiya' natak tatha parvaas ki vyatha se juda; unhone Beti-Bechwa tatha Bhand-Gangaram jaise natak bhi likhe.

qe: Which poet from Bihar is known as 'Rashtrakavi' and received the Jnanpith Award for the work 'Urvashi'?
qh: बिहार के किस कवि को 'राष्ट्रकवि' कहा जाता है तथा 'उर्वशी' कृति के लिए ज्ञानपीठ पुरस्कार मिला?
e: Ramdhari Singh Dinkar (janm Simaria, Begusarai) ko 'Rashtrakavi' tatha 'Samay Surya' kaha jaata hai; unki kavitayein rashtriya bhavna tatha shramik-manav ki shakti se bhari rehti hain. Unhe 1972 me 'Urvashi' kavya-sangrah ke liye Jnanpith Award mila, jo bharat ka sabse bada sahitya samman hai; iske alava 1959 me Sahitya Akademi Award ('Sanskriti ke Char Adhyay') tatha Padma Bhushan bhi mile. Unki 'Kurukshetra', 'Rashmirathi' tatha 'Parashuram ki Pratiksha' kavitayein aaj bhi vidyarthiyon ko prerit karti hain; 'Rashmirathi' me Karna ke jeevan ka punar-vichar hai. Unka janm-sthal Begusarai me hai aur woh azaadi ke baad Rajya Sabha ke sadasya bhi rahe. Nagarjun 'Jan Kavi' ke naam se jaane jaate hain, Gopal Singh Nepali rashtriya geetkar the tatha Acharya Shivpujan Sahay 'Bhasha ke Jadugar' the, isliye baki vikalp alag shakhsiyat se jude hain. Exam point: 'Rashtrakavi' = Ramdhari Singh Dinkar (janm Simaria, Begusarai), 'Urvashi' par Jnanpith (1972); 'Rashmirathi' tatha 'Kurukshetra' unki prasiddh rachnaein.

qe: Ustad Bismillah Khan, the 'Shehnai Samrat' who won the Bharat Ratna in 2001, was born at which place in Bihar?
qh: 2001 में भारत रत्न पाने वाले 'शहनाई सम्राट' उस्ताद बिस्मिल्लाह खान का जन्म बिहार में कहाँ हुआ था?
e: Ustad Bismillah Khan (janm 1916, Dumraon, Buxar jila) ne shehnai ko ek sadharan lok-vadya se aise uchch sthar par pahunchaya ki woh bharat ke sangeet ka prateek ban gaya. Unhe shehnai ke liye 'Shehnai Samrat' kaha jaata hai; unhone 1947 me Lal Qila (Red Fort) me azaadi ki subah shehnai bajai thi, jo itihas me yaad rakha jaata hai. Unka parivar Dumraon riyasat ka shaahi sangeetkar parivar tha; unke pitamah tatha pita Bihar ki darbar me shehnai bajate the, isliye unki taleem bachpan se Dumraon me hi shuru hui. Unhe 2001 me Bharat Ratna mila, iske alava Padma Shri (1961), Padma Bhushan (1968), Padma Vibhushan (1980) tatha Sangeet Natak Akademi Award bhi mila. Sasaram, Darbhanga tatha Gaya Bihari kala-sanskriti ke anya kendra hain, par Bismillah Khan ka janm-sthal Dumraon hai; wahan unke naam par sanskritik kendra tatha path bhi hai. Exam point: Bismillah Khan = janm Dumraon (Buxar), shehnai ke 'Samrat', 1947 me Red Fort par shehnai, 2001 me Bharat Ratna.

qe: Which singer, known as 'Bihar Kokila', is famous for Chhath and Maithili folk songs and received the Padma Bhushan in 2018?
qh: 'बिहार कोकिला' कही जाने वाली कौन-सी गायिका छठ तथा मैथिली लोकगीतों के लिए प्रसिद्ध हैं और उन्हें 2018 में पद्म भूषण मिला?
e: Sharda Sinha (janm Hulas, Supaul) ko unke madhur lok-svar ke karan 'Bihar Kokila' kaha jaata hai. Woh Chhath Puja ke geeton - jaise 'Kartik Maas Ijoriya' tatha 'Bahangi Lachkat Jaye' - ke liye poori duniya me jaani jaati hain, isliye Chhath ke samay Bihar me unki aawaz ghar-ghar sunai deti hai. Unhone Maithili, Bhojpuri tatha Magahi me lokgeet gaye tatha 'Maine Pyar Kiya' jaisi Hindi filmon me bhi apni aawaz di; unhe 2018 me Padma Bhushan, 1991 me Padma Shri tatha 2000 me Sangeet Natak Akademi Award mila. Woh Maithili lok-sangeet tatha Chhath parampara ko nayi peedhi tak pahunchane ka sabse bada madhyam rahi hain. Ushakiran Khan Maithili ki lekhika hain, Dr. Anamika Hindi ki kavi hain tatha Dulari Devi Mithila ki chitrakar hain, isliye woh sahi vikalp nahi hain. Exam point: 'Bihar Kokila' = Sharda Sinha, Chhath geet tatha Maithili lok-sangeet ki prasiddh gayika; Padma Bhushan 2018, janm Hulas (Supaul).

qe: Which Mithila (Madhubani) painter was the first artist of this style to receive the Padma Shri, in 1975?
qh: इस शैली की कौन-सी मिथिला (मधुबनी) चित्रकार 1975 में पद्म श्री पाने वाली पहली कलाकार थीं?
e: Madhubani ya Mithila painting Mithila kshetra ki deewar-chitrakala se nikli ek paramparik kala hai jisme bhitt-chitra (wall painting) ki tarah chaton tatha kagaz par bhi chitran hota hai. Is shaili me aam taur par shakti-symbolon, Radha-Krishna, Ram-Sita tatha prakriti ke roop - machhli, phool, mor - bhare jaate hain. Jagdamba Devi Mithila chitrakala ki pehli aisi kalakar maani jaati hain jinko 1975 me Padma Shri mila; unhe 1970 me National Award bhi mila tha. Unhone Jitwarpur (Madhubani) mein kala ko jeevan bhar jeevit rakha tatha peedhi-dar-peedhi sikhaya. Aage Mahasundari Devi (Padma Shri 2011), Sita Devi (Padma Shri 1981), Baua Devi (Padma Shri 2017), Ganga Devi (Padma Shri 1984), Godawari Dutta (Padma Shri 2019) tatha Dulari Devi (Padma Shri 2021) ne is kala ko vishwa-stariya pehchan dilai; 'Madhubani painting' ko GI tag bhi mila hai. Exam point: Mithila/Madhubani chitrakala me pehli Padma Shri = Jagdamba Devi (1975); baad me Sita Devi, Ganga Devi, Mahasundari Devi, Baua Devi tatha Dulari Devi ko bhi Padma Shri mila.

qe: Sujani embroidery, which got a GI tag, is traditionally associated with which district of Bihar?
qh: जीआई टैग प्राप्त सुजनी कढ़ाई परंपरागत रूप से बिहार के किस जिले से जुड़ी है?
e: Sujani embroidery ek paramparik kadhai (embroidery) kala hai jisme purane kapdon (jaise dhoti, sari) ki kaayi-kaayi par reta gaye taron se lambi-tedhi lines banti hain aur unme gaon ke drishya, jeevan-ghatnayein tatha prateek bhare jaate hain. Iska mukhya kendra Muzaffarpur jile ka Bhusra gaon maana jaata hai, jahan ki mahilayein peedhiyon se yah kala karti aayi hain; Chakreshwari Devi ko is kala ko pehchan dilane ka shrey diya jaata hai. 2006 ke aas-paas 'Sujani' ko GI (Geographical Indication) tag mila, isse is kala ke saath kshetra ka naam jud gaya tatha mahilaon ko aay ka naya srot mila. Bhagalpur silk tatha Gaya-Apparel ke liye jaana jaata hai, Darbhanga makhana tatha Mithila kala ke liye - isliye sujani ke sahi jile ke roop me Muzaffarpur hi sahi hai. Exam point: Sujani kadhai = Bhusra, Muzaffarpur; GI tag prapt; Chakreshwari Devi is kala ki pramukh kalakar; anya kalaon me Madhubani painting (GI), Tikuli art (Patna), Sikki art (Mithila).

qe: Which language, spoken mainly in Mithila, was added to the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution by the 92nd Amendment in 2003?
qh: मुख्यतः मिथिला में बोली जाने वाली कौन-सी भाषा 92वें संशोधन (2003) द्वारा संविधान की आठवीं अनुसूची में जोड़ी गई?
e: Maithili Mithila kshetra (Darbhanga, Madhubani, Samastipur, Saharsa, Supaul, Araria tatha Nepal ke kuch hisse) me boli jaane wali bhasha hai; ise 92vein Samvidhan Sanshodhan (2003) dwara athvein anusuchi (Eighth Schedule) me joda gaya, us sanshodhan se Maithili ke saath Bodo, Dogri tatha Santhali bhi athvein anusuchi me jodi gayi, yaani kul chaar bhashayein. Athvein anusuchi me sammilit hone ka arth hai ki bhasha ko rajya-bhasha ke vikas ke liye adhyayan, granth-rachana tatha parikshaon me protsahan milta hai tatha Sahitya Akademi us bhasha ke liye samman deti hai. Maithili ka apna prachin sahitya hai - Vidyapati ki Padavali, Kirtilata tatha aadhunik kal me Nagarjun tatha Surendra Jha 'Suman' ki rachnaein. Bihar ki anya lok-bhashayein Bhojpuri, Magahi tatha Angika hain, lekin 2003 me unhe athvein anusuchi me nahi joda gaya; Bihar ki rajya-bhasha Hindi hai tatha doosri rajya-bhasha Urdu (1989 se) hai. Exam point: Athvein anusuchi me 2003 (92vein sanshodhan) se Maithili; Bihar ki rajyabhasha Hindi, doosri rajyabhasha Urdu; Bhojpuri, Magahi tatha Angika abhi anusuchi me nahi.

qe: Bihar Diwas is celebrated every year on 22 March to mark which event?
qh: बिहार दिवस प्रतिवर्ष 22 मार्च को किस घटना के उपलक्ष्य में मनाया जाता है?
oe: Creation of a separate Bihar province by separation from Bengal in 1912
Formation of Bihar after separation from Jharkhand in 2000
Shifting of the state capital from Patna to Gaya in 1956
oh: 1912 में बंगाल से अलग करके पृथक बिहार प्रांत का गठन
2000 में झारखंड से अलग होकर बिहार का गठन
1956 में राजधानी का पटना से गया स्थानांतरण
e: 22 March 1912 ko British sarkar ne Bengal Presidency se alag kar Bihar tatha Orissa ko ek naya prant banaya; isi tariq se Bihar ko apni alag pehchan mili, isliye 22 March ko Bihar Diwas manaya jaata hai. Isi alag prant ki maang ke liye sachchidananda Sinha tatha Mahesh Narayan jaise netaon ne 'The Bihar Times' tatha anya patrakarita ke zariye lamba aandolan chalaya tha. Bihar Diwas ko 2012 se vishal roop se manaya jaane laga, jab iski 100vein varshgath aayi. Dhyaan rakhna zaroori hai ki 22 March 1912 ka prant alag tha, jabki 15 November 2000 ko ek doosri badi ghatna me Bihar se alag kar Jharkhand rajya banaya gaya; isliye dono tarikhein mila dena aam galti hoti hai. Patna Vishwavidyalaya 1917 me bana tha tatha rajdhani ka sthanantaran kabhi nahi hua. Exam point: Bihar Diwas = 22 March (1912 me Bengal se alag prant banne ki smriti), 2012 se badi roop se aayojit; 15 November 2000 = Bihar se Jharkhand alag.

qe: Chhath, the biggest festival of Bihar, is celebrated on which day of the Kartik month, and to whom is it dedicated?
qh: बिहार का सबसे बड़ा पर्व छठ कार्तिक मास की किस तिथि को मनाया जाता है तथा यह किसकी उपासना को समर्पित है?
oe: Kartik Shukla Shashthi; Surya and Chhathi Maiya
Kartik Krishna Ashtami; Chandra and Gauri
oh: कार्तिक शुक्ल षष्ठी; सूर्य तथा छठी मैया
कार्तिक कृष्ण अष्टमी; चंद्र तथा गौरी
e: Chhath Puja Kartik mahine ke shukla paksh ki shashthi tithi se juda hai; isliye ise 'Chhath' (chhatha tithi) kaha jaata hai tatha yah Surya dev tatha 'Chhathi Maiya' ki upasana ko samarpit hai. Yah Bihari samaj ka sabse bada tatha sabse kathin vrat manaa jaata hai, jisme log ghat par khade hokar 'arghya' dete hain - shaam ko dhalti (ast hone wali) surya ko arghya 'sandhya arghya' tatha subah ugti surya ko 'usha arghya' diya jaata hai. Vrat rakhne wale 'vrati' 36 ghante ka nirjala (bina paani) vrat rakhte hain tatha 'Nahay-Khay' tatha 'Kharna' ke rasmein pahle hoti hain; prasad me thekua, kheer, laddu tatha mausami phal chadhaaye jaate hain. Chhath me safai tatha pavitrata ka vishesh dhyan rakha jaata hai, isliye ghat, talab tatha nadiyan saaf ki jaati hain. Kartik krishna ashtami, Shravan purnima tatha Chaitra navami anya parv-tithiyaan hain, isliye woh is prashn ke sahi nahi. Exam point: Chhath = Kartik shukla shashthi, Surya tatha Chhathi Maiya ki upasana; nahay-khay tatha kharna ke baad sandhya arghya (dhalti surya) tatha usha arghya (ugti surya); prasad thekua; Bihar ka mahaparv.

qe: Jivitputrika or 'Jiutiya' vrat, observed mainly in Bihar, is kept by:
qh: मुख्यतः बिहार में मनाया जाने वाला जिवित्पुत्रिका या 'जिउतिया' व्रत कौन रखता है?
oe: Mothers, for the long life and well-being of their children
Sisters, for their brothers' long life
Newly married brides, for their husbands' health
oh: माताएँ, अपनी संतान की लंबी आयु तथा कुशलता के लिए
बहनें, अपने भाइयों की लंबी आयु के लिए
नवविवाहित वधुएँ, पति के स्वास्थ्य के लिए
e: Jivitputrika (aam bolchaal me 'Jiutiya') ek aisa vrat hai jo maayein apni santan ki lambi aayu, achhi sehat tatha khushhali ke liye rakhti hain; yah Ashwin mahine ke krishna paksh ki ashtami tithi ko aata hai. 'Jivit' ka arth hai jeevit tatha 'putrika' ka arth hai putr ya santan, yaani yah vrat santan ko jeevit tatha surakshit rakhne ki kamna se juda hai. Vrat rakhne wali maayein nirjala (bina paani) tatha bina anaj ka vrat rakhti hain, kyunki maana jaata hai ki yah sabse kathin vrat maa ki santan ke liye rakhti hain tatha iske phal se santan par aane wali vipdaayein tal jaati hain. Isi vrat ko Bihar ke kai hisson me 'Jiutiya' ya 'Jivitputrika' kaha jaata hai tatha iske saath 'Khurma' jaisa prasad tatha bail tatha anya pashuon ke saath judee rasm bhi judi hoti hai. Bhai-behen ka vrat Rakshabandhan tatha pati ke liye vrat Karva Chauth jaise parv alag hain, isliye woh sahi vikalp nahi. Exam point: Jivitputrika/Jiutiya = maayein santan ki lambi aayu ke liye rakhti hain, Ashwin krishna ashtami; Rakshabandhan bhai-behen tatha Karva Chauth pati ke liye hota hai.

qe: Sama-Chakeva, a festival of the brother-sister bond, is traditionally celebrated in which region of Bihar?
qh: भाई-बहन के स्नेह का पर्व सामा-चकेवा परंपरागत रूप से बिहार के किस क्षेत्र में मनाया जाता है?
e: Sama-Chakeva ka parv Mithila kshetra me Kartik mahine me bhai-behen ke prem tatha raksha ke prateek ke roop me manaya jaata hai. Isme mitti (clay) se 'Sama' tatha 'Chakeva' naam ke pichhu (pakshi) banaye jaate hain tatha unhe saja kar mahilaayein gaano ke saath puja karti hain; lok-katha me Chakeva (bhai) tatha Sama (behen) ka prem tatha Sama ko dur rahne wale bhai ki yaad is parv se judi hai. Mithila (Darbhanga, Madhubani, Samastipur, Saharsa) me yah vishesh roop se manaya jaata hai; Kartik shukla tithi tatha amavasya ke aas-paas puja hoti hai, aakhir me murtiyon ko talab tatha kuaan me le jaakar visarjan (visarjan) kiya jaata hai. Iske alava Mithila ke anya lok-parv Madhushravani tatha Sama-Chakeva dono gaon ki mahilaon ki parampara ka hissa hain. Magadh, Anga tatha Bhojpur kshetra ke apne lok-parv hain (jaise Bihula-Bishhari Anga me), isliye 'Mithila' hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: Sama-Chakeva = Mithila ka bhai-behen ka parv, Kartik mahine me mitti ke Sama-Chakeva pakshi-shilp puja tatha visarjan; yah Maithil lok-sanskriti ki vishesh pehchan hai.

qe: The Bihula-Bishhari festival, associated with the worship of the serpent goddess, is mainly celebrated in which region of Bihar?
qh: सर्प-देवी की उपासना से जुड़ा बिहुला-बिशहरी पर्व मुख्यतः बिहार के किस क्षेत्र में मनाया जाता है?
oe: Anga region including Bhagalpur, Banka and Munger
Saran region including Chapra and Siwan
Shahabad region including Buxar and Rohtas
oh: भागलपुर, बाँका तथा मुंगेर सहित अंग क्षेत्र
छपरा तथा सिवान सहित सारण क्षेत्र
बक्सर तथा रोहतास सहित शाहाबाद क्षेत्र
e: Bihula-Bishhari (jise Bihula ya Bishhari puja bhi kehte hain) Bihar ke Anga kshetra - mukhya roop se Bhagalpur, Banka, Munger tatha Saharsa ke kuch hisson me - Bhadra mahine ke shukla paksh ki panchami ko manaya jaata hai. Isme 'Bishhari' (Manasa devi, naag-devtaon ki devi) ki puja hoti hai; lok-katha me Bihula apne pati 'Balam' ki jeevan-raksha ke liye Bishhari devi ki stuti karti hain tatha naag ke kaatne se hone wali mrityu se raksha ki prarthna karti hain. Isi din log naag-devta ki mitti ki murti banakar puja karte hain tatha 'Bishhari' ke geet gaate hain; yah parv kheti tatha barsaat ke mausam se bhi juda hai, kyunki isi samay kheton me paani tatha nami hoti hai. Yah parampara sarp (snake) se hone wale khatron tatha unse bachav ki lok-maanyata par adharit hai; aisi puja ko 'nag-puja' ka lok-roop kaha ja sakta hai. Mithila, Saran tatha Shahabad kshetra ke lok-parv tatha paramparaayein alag hain, isliye sahi uttar 'Anga kshetra' hai. Exam point: Bihula-Bishhari = Anga kshetra (Bhagalpur, Banka, Munger), Bhadra shukla panchami, Bishhari/Manasa devi tatha Bihula-Balam ki katha se juda, nag-puja ka lok-parv.

qe: Madhushravani, a festival of newly married women, is a folk tradition of which region, celebrated in the month of Shravana?
qh: नवविवाहित महिलाओं का पर्व मधुश्रावणी किस क्षेत्र की लोक-परंपरा है, जो श्रावण मास में मनाई जाती है?
e: Madhushravani Mithila ki lok-parampara ka vrat hai jo Shravan mahine me nayi-nayi byaahi hui ladkiyan rakhti hain; 'Madhu' tatha 'Shravani' do shabdon se bana yah naam Shravan mas me madhu (madhumas) ki tarah manaye jaane wale parv ka suchak hai. Is samay nayi bahu apne maayke (parental home) jaakar vrat rakhti hai tatha mitti tatha phoolon se bane 'Gauri-Shiva' ke roopon ki puja karti hai; saath hi kudrat tatha kul-devta ki puja ka vidhan hota hai, jisse jeevansathi tatha dampatya jeevan ki khushhali ki kamna ki jaati hai. Iske geeton me Maithili bhasha tatha Mithila ki lok-kathaayein jhalakti hain; yah Mithila ki stri-shakti tatha unki rang-berang parampara ka prateek maana jaata hai. Magadh, Anga tatha Bhojpur kshetra ke apne lok-parv hain tatha unhe 'Madhushravani' nahi kehte, isliye 'Mithila' hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: Madhushravani = Mithila ka Shravan-mahine ka vrat, nayi byaahi ladkiyan Gauri-Shiva ki puja karti hain; yah Maithili lok-parampara tatha geeton se juda parv hai.

qe: The Malmas Mela, held once in about three years at the hot springs of Rajgir, is organised on which occasion?
qh: राजगीर के गर्म जल-कुंडों पर लगभग तीन वर्ष में एक बार लगने वाला मलमास मेला किस अवसर पर आयोजित होता है?
oe: The extra (adhik) month of the Hindu lunar calendar
The beginning of the harvest season
oh: हिन्दू चांद्र कैलेंडर का अधिक (अधिमास) मास
फसल कटाई के मौसम का आरंभ
e: Malmas ka doosra naam 'Adhik Mas' ya 'Mal Maas' hai; Hindu chandramaasiya (lunar) calendar me har do-teen varsh me ek extra mahina joda jaata hai, jise 'adhik maas' tatha lok-bhasha me 'malmas' kehte hain. Rajgir (Nalanda) me Brahmakund tatha anya garm jal-kund sthit hain; 'Malmas Mela' isi adhik maas ke dauran lagta hai, isliye yah har teen varsh me aate hain. Is avsar par kaha jaata hai ki shraddhalu Brahmakund me snan karke punya kamate hain, aur yahan bade melon ka aayojan hota hai jisme desh bhar se shraddhalu aate hain; yah mela dharmik tatha aarthik dono mahatva ka hai. Rajgir Hindu, Buddhist, Jain tatha Sufi charo paramparaon ke liye pavitra sthal hai, is karan Malmas Mela ka mahatva aur bhi badh jaata hai. Surya grahan tatha Kumbh Prayag ke melon ke aayojan alag hote hain tatha fasal-katai kisi dharmik mela ki tithi nahi hoti, isliye sahi uttar 'adhik maas' hai. Exam point: Malmas Mela = Rajgir (Nalanda) ke Brahmakund par, adhik maas ke avsar par har teen varsh me; Brahmakund ka paani lagbhag 87 degree Celsius tak garam hota hai tatha yah Hindu-Buddhist-Jain-Sufi charo ke liye pavitra sthal hai.

qe: Which of the following is the correct order of the main rituals of Chhath Puja?
qh: निम्नलिखित में छठ पूजा की मुख्य रस्मों का सही क्रम कौन-सा है?
oe: Nahay-Khay, Kharna, Sandhya Arghya, Usha Arghya
Sandhya Arghya, Kharna, Nahay-Khay, Usha Arghya
Usha Arghya, Sandhya Arghya, Kharna, Nahay-Khay
Kharna, Nahay-Khay, Usha Arghya, Sandhya Arghya
oh: नहाय-खाय, खरना, संध्या अर्घ्य, उषा अर्घ्य
संध्या अर्घ्य, खरना, नहाय-खाय, उषा अर्घ्य
उषा अर्घ्य, संध्या अर्घ्य, खरना, नहाय-खाय
खरना, नहाय-खाय, उषा अर्घ्य, संध्या अर्घ्य
e: Chhath Puja char dinon me poori hoti hai. Pehle din 'Nahay-Khay' hota hai, jisme vrati snan karke saaf-suthre kapde pehnte hain tatha chawal, kaddu tatha chane ki daal se bana shudh bhojan grahan karte hain; yeh 'shauch-safai' ka din maana jaata hai. Doosre din 'Kharna' hota hai, jisme vrati poora din upvaas karke shaam ko gud ki kheer tatha roti grahan karte hain; is din ke baad 36 ghante ka nirjala vrat shuru hota hai. Teesre din 'Sandhya Arghya' diya jaata hai, jab vrati ghat par khade hokar dhalti hui surya ko jal arghya diya jaata hai; jab surya ast hone ko hote hain, tab yahi arghya diya jaata hai. Chautha din 'Usha Arghya' hota hai, jisme subah ugte suraj ko arghya dene ke baad vrat khola jaata hai tatha prasad baanta jaata hai. Isi karan sahi kram 'Nahay-Khay, Kharna, Sandhya Arghya, Usha Arghya' hai; anya kram galat hain. Exam point: Chhath ka kram - Nahay-Khay (pehla din), Kharna (doosra din), Sandhya Arghya (teesra din), Usha Arghya (chautha din); vrat 36 ghante ka nirjala hota hai.

qe: Rajgir Mahotsav, a festival of classical dance, music and the heritage of Magadha, is organised in which district?
qh: शास्त्रीय नृत्य, संगीत तथा मगध की विरासत के उत्सव राजगीर महोत्सव का आयोजन किस जिले में होता है?
e: Rajgir Mahotsav Nalanda jile ke Rajgir kshetra me aayojit hone wala sanskritik mahotsav hai, jisme shastriya nritya, sangeet, lok-kala tatha Bihar ki hastshilp parampara ka pradarshan hota hai. Is mahotsav ka maqsad yah hai ki Bihar ki kala tatha paryatan-parampara ko desh-videsh ke saamne rakhe tatha Rajgir jaise aitihasik sthal ko log jan sakein. Rajgir ka itihas bahut samriddh hai - yah Magadha ki pehli rajdhani Rajagriha tha, yahan garm jal-kund, Cyclopean Wall, Vishwa Shanti Stupa tatha Son Bhandar ki gufayein hain, isliye yah mahotsav ek saath dharma, itihas tatha kala ka sangam ban jaata hai. Aise mahotsav rajya ke anya hisson me bhi hote hain, lekin Rajgir Mahotsav ka aayojan Nalanda jile me hota hai; Gaya me Pitrapaksha mela tatha Bodh Gaya ki dharmik yatraayein, Patna me anya sanskritik karyakram tatha Jehanabad me Barabar ki gufayein prasiddh hain. Isliye 'Nalanda' hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: Rajgir Mahotsav = Nalanda jila (Rajgir), shastriya nritya-sangeet tatha kala ka mahotsav; Rajgir Magadha ki pehli rajdhani Rajagriha tha tatha yahan garm jal-kund tatha Vishwa Shanti Stupa hain.

qe: Which Sikh Takht, one of the five holiest seats of Sikhism, marks the birthplace of Guru Gobind Singh in Patna?
qh: सिख धर्म के पाँच सर्वोच्च तख्तों में से कौन-सा तख्त पटना में गुरु गोबिंद सिंह की जन्मस्थली है?
oe: Takht Sri Harmandir Ji, Patna Sahib
Takht Sri Damdama Sahib, Talwandi Sabo
oh: तख्त श्री हरमंदिर जी, पटना साहिब
तख्त श्री दमदमा साहिब, तलवंडी साबो
e: Patna Sahib (aaj Patna City kshetra) me sthit Takht Sri Harmandir Ji sikh dharm ke paanch takhton me se ek hai; yahin 1666 me Guru Gobind Singh ka janm hua tha. Sikhon ke paanch takht is tarah hain - Sri Akal Takht (Amritsar), Takht Sri Kesgarh Sahib (Anandpur, Punjab), Takht Sri Damdama Sahib (Talwandi Sabo, Punjab), Takht Sri Hazur Sahib (Nanded, Maharashtra) tatha Takht Sri Patna Sahib (Bihar). Patna Sahib ka gurudwara safed sangmarmar tatha sone ki paryapt sajavat ke liye jaana jaata hai tatha Guru Gobind Singh ke bachpan se judi vastuein yahan sanrakshit hain. Bihar me iske alava Guru ka Bagh (Patna ke nikat) tatha Guru Gobind Singh ke janm-sthal se judi anya ghatnayein bhi yaad ki jaati hain; 1670 ke aas-paas Guru Tegh Bahadur Patna me rahe the. Exam point: Panch Takht - Sri Akal Takht (Amritsar), Kesgarh Sahib (Anandpur), Damdama Sahib (Talwandi Sabo), Hazur Sahib (Nanded) tatha Patna Sahib (Bihar); Patna Sahib me Guru Gobind Singh ka janm 1666 me hua.

qe: Pawapuri in Nalanda district is a major pilgrimage centre of which religion, and what does it mark?
qh: नालंदा जिले का पावापुरी किस धर्म का प्रमुख तीर्थस्थल है तथा वह किस घटना का प्रतीक है?
oe: Jainism; the place where Lord Mahavira attained nirvana
Buddhism; the place where Buddha was born
Sikhism; the place where Guru Nanak was born
Hinduism; the place where Lord Rama was born
oh: जैन धर्म; जहाँ भगवान महावीर को निर्वाण प्राप्त हुआ
बौद्ध धर्म; जहाँ बुद्ध का जन्म हुआ
सिख धर्म; जहाँ गुरु नानक का जन्म हुआ
हिन्दू धर्म; जहाँ भगवान राम का जन्म हुआ
e: Pawapuri Nalanda jile me sthit hai tatha Jain dharm ka sabse pavitra tirth-sthalon me se ek hai; yahin Bhagwan Mahavira (Jain dharm ke 24vein tirthankar) ko 527 ee. poo. me nirvana (moksha) prapt hua. Yahi ghatna ke kaaran yahan 'Jal Mandir' banaya gaya, jo ek sundar safed mandir hai tatha ek talab ke beech me sthit hai; kaha jaata hai ki nirvana ke samay bade sankhya me shraddhalu aaye the tatha unke pag chinh ke kaaran jo mitti udhi, usse talab ka nirman kar wahan mandir banaya gaya. Pawapuri Rajgir tatha Nalanda se kuch hi door hai, isliye Buddhist tirth-yatra karne wale bhi yahan aate hain; Bihar ki aarthik tatha sanskritik pehchan me yah ek mahatvapurn dharmik kendra hai. Buddha ka janm Lumbini (Nepal) me hua tha tatha Guru Nanak ka janm Nankana Sahib (aaj Pakistan) me - isliye woh vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Pawapuri (Nalanda) = Jain tirth, Bhagwan Mahavira ka nirvana (moksha); yahan ka Jal Mandir talab ke beech sthit hai; Rajgir-Nalanda ke nikat hone se yah ek pramukh tirth-sthal hai.

qe: The Ashokan pillars at Lauriya Nandangarh and Rampurva, both in West Champaran, are famous for which feature?
qh: पश्चिम चंपारण में स्थित लौरिया नंदनगढ़ तथा रामपुरवा के अशोक-स्तंभ किस विशेषता के लिए प्रसिद्ध हैं?
oe: Polished monolithic sandstone pillars with animal capitals and Ashokan edicts
Brick-built temple shikharas with gold plating
oh: पॉलिश किए गए एक-पत्थर के बलुआ-पत्थर स्तंभ, पशु-शीर्ष तथा अशोक के अभिलेखों सहित
स्वर्ण मंढित ईंटों से बने मंदिर-शिखर
e: Lauriya Nandangarh tatha Rampurva dono West Champaran jile me hain tatha Maurya samrat Ashoka ke stambhon (pillars) ke liye prasiddh hain. Ye stambh ek hi thos balua-patthar (sandstone) ko tarash kar banaye gaye tatha unki satah itni chamakdar (polished) hai ki aaj bhi sheeshe jaisi lagti hai; stambhon ke shirsh par sinh (lion) ya vrishabh (bull) jaisi pashu-aakritiyan bani hain. Ashoka ne in stambhon par apne 'Dhamma' (niti-updesh) ke abhilekh khudwaye, jisme ahinsa, satya, maa-baap tatha guru-janon ka aadar tatha sabhi dharmon ke prati sahanubhooti ke sandesh hain. Lauriya Nandangarh ke nikat ek bada stupa-tila bhi hai tatha Rampurva ke do stambhon me ek par sinh tatha doosre par vrishabh ki aakriti thi. Bihar me aise stambh Kolhua (Vaishali) tatha Lauriya-Areraj (East Champaran) me bhi mile hain. Iron pillar (jise rust nahi lagta) Delhi ke Mehrauli me hai tatha terracotta stupas anya sthalon ke hain, isliye woh vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Lauriya Nandangarh tatha Rampurva (West Champaran) = Ashoka ke polish kiye patthar ke stambh, pashu-shirsh tatha Dhamma abhilekh; Rampurva me sinh tatha vrishabh ki aakritiyan; Bihar me Ashokan stambh Vaishali (Kolhua) tatha Lauriya-Areraj me bhi.

qe: Rohtasgarh fort, built on the Kaimur hills near Sasaram, was captured by Sher Shah Suri from which ruler?
qh: सासाराम के निकट कैमूर पहाड़ियों पर बना रोहतासगढ़ किला शेरशाह सूरी ने किस शासक से जीता था?
oe: Raja Hari Krishan Rai of Rohtas
oh: रोहतास के राजा हरि कृष्ण राय
e: Rohtasgarh kila Kaimur pahadi par Sasaram ke nikat lagbhag 1,500 foot ki unchai par sthit hai; yah kila Bharat ke sabse puraane tatha majboot pahadi kilon me gina jaata hai. Sher Shah Suri ne is kila ko Rohtas ke Raja Hari Krishan Rai se jita tha; kaha jaata hai ki raja ko harane me unhe kai saal lag gaye. Is jite ke baad Sher Shah ne kila apne adhikari ke haath me diya tatha yahan se poore kshetra par nazar rakhi. Baad me Mughal kaal me Man Singh tatha anya adhikariyon ne is kila par raj kiya; aaj bhi kila ke andar mahal, darwaze tatha mandir ke khandaher milte hain tatha yah ek pramukh paryatan-sthal hai. Nawab Mir Qasim ka sambandh Munger kila se hai tatha Raja Jarasandha ka naam Rajgir ki lok-kathaon se juda hai, isliye woh sahi vikalp nahi hain. Exam point: Rohtasgarh kila (Kaimur pahadi, Sasaram ke nikat) Sher Shah Suri ne Raja Hari Krishan Rai se jita; baad me Mughal adhikariyon ke adheen raha; Munger kila Mir Qasim se juda hai.

qe: Munger fort, situated on the bank of the Ganga, served as the capital of which Nawab of Bengal who fought the British at Buxar in 1764?
qh: गंगा तट पर स्थित मुंगेर किला बंगाल के किस नवाब की राजधानी रहा, जिसने 1764 में बक्सर में अंग्रेजों से युद्ध किया?
e: Munger kila Ganga nadi ke dakshin kinare par ek uncha tila ban kar sthit hai; yah kila Kharagpur pahadi se nikle pattharon se banaya gaya maana jaata hai tatha iski deewarein bahut majboot hain. Bihar ko 'Bangal ka pravesh dwar' kehte hue is kila ko kabhi-kabhi 'Bangal ka dwar' bhi kaha jaata hai. 1760 ke aas-paas Mir Qasim bangal ke Nawab bane tatha unhone apni rajdhani Munger shift ki; woh ek swatantra soch wale shasak the, isliye unhone apni sena ko European tareeke se sanwara tatha apne kila-kshetra me top (guns) tatha golah (ammunition) banane ki factory vikasit ki. 1764 me Buxar ke yuddh me Mir Qasim, Awadh ke Nawab Shuja-ud-Daula tatha Mughal samrat Shah Alam II ne British East India Company ke viruddh sanyukt sena banai, par Hector Munro ke netritva me British jeet gaye; is jite ne bharat me british satta ko majboot kar diya. Siraj-ud-Daulah, Alivardi Khan tatha Mir Jafar is samay ke anya nawab the, isliye woh sahi vikalp nahi. Exam point: Munger kila = Ganga tat, Mir Qasim ki rajdhani; 1764 ke Buxar yuddh me Mir Qasim, Shuja-ud-Daula tatha Shah Alam II ko British ne (Hector Munro ke netritva me) haraya.

qe: The Sonepur cattle fair, one of the largest in Asia, is held at the confluence of the Ganga and which river?
qh: एशिया के सबसे बड़े पशु मेलों में एक सोनपुर पशु मेला गंगा तथा किस नदी के संगम पर लगता है?
e: Sonepur (Saran jila) ka pashu mela Bihar ki sabse badi pashu-mandi-mela parampara maana jaata hai tatha ise Asia ke sabse bade pashu melon me gina jaata hai. Yah mela Ganga tatha Gandak nadi ke sangam par bante 'Harihar Kshetra' me Kartik Purnima ke aas-paas shuru hota hai, jahan Hindu parampara me Vishnu (Hari) tatha Shiv (Har) ka sangam maana jaata hai; isi pavitra sthal ke kaaran yahan dev-darshan tatha mela dono ka nazara milta hai. Mela aam taur par November-December me lagta hai tatha isme hathi, ghode, bulbull, gaay, bhains, bakri tatha anya pashu bikte-aa jaate hain; pehle yahan hasti (elephant) vyapar zyada hota tha, lekin vanyajeev-suraksha kanoon ke baad woh kam ho gaya. Kosi, Son tatha Bagmati ke ghaton par aise pashu melon ka wahi purana tatha prasiddh sthan nahi hai, isliye 'Gandak' hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: Sonepur pashu mela = Saran jila, Ganga-Gandak sangam (Harihar Kshetra), Kartik Purnima ke aas-paas; Asia ke sabse bade pashu melon me ginti.

qe: The Pitrapaksha Mela, held for the shraddha of ancestors, is organised in which district of Bihar?
qh: पितरों के श्राद्ध के लिए आयोजित पितृपक्ष मेला बिहार के किस जिले में लगता है?
e: Pitrapaksha Mela Gaya jile me lagta hai tatha yah poori duniya me pitaron (ancestors) ke shraddha-tarpan ke liye prasiddh hai. Hindu parampara me maana jaata hai ki Gaya me pind-daan karne se pitaron ko moksha milta hai; isi liye Bhadrapad mahine ke krishnapaksh (pitrapaksha) me yahan lakhon shraddhalu aate hain tatha 'Falgu' nadi ke tat par pind-daan tatha tarpan karte hain. Mela pura mahine chalta hai tatha ise Gaya ka bada sanskritik-tirth ka aayojan maana jaata hai; isi kshetra me shilas (pathar) par pitaron ke naam bhi khudwaye jaate hain. Kaha jaata hai ki Bhagwan Buddha ne bhi Gaya kshetra me tapasya ke baad gyan prapt kiya, tatha Bodh Gaya yahi jila hai; isliye Gaya ka dharmik mahatva pitrapaksha tatha buddh dharm dono se juda hai. Patna, Saran tatha Bhagalpur anya mahatvapurn shahar hain, lekin Pitrapaksha Mela ke liye Gaya hi prasiddh hai. Exam point: Pitrapaksha Mela = Gaya jila, pind-daan ke liye vishwa-prasiddh, krishnapaksh me lagta hai; Gaya jile me hi Bodh Gaya (UNESCO site) bhi sthit hai.

qe: The Cyclopean Wall, an ancient stone fortification said to be built by King Jarasandha, encircles which hill town of Bihar?
qh: राजा जरासंध द्वारा निर्मित बताई जाने वाली प्राचीन पाषाण-प्राचीर 'साइक्लोपियन वॉल' बिहार के किस पर्वतीय नगर को घेरे हुए है?
e: Rajgir (Nalanda jila) ko prachin kal me 'Rajagriha' ya 'Girivraj' kaha jaata tha; Magadha ki pehli rajdhani ke roop me yah nagar panch pahadiyon - Vaibhargiri, Ratnagiri, Vipulgiri, Songiri tatha Udaygiri - se ghira hua tha. Shahar ke charon taraf bade-bade patharon se bani ek prachin deewar hai jise 'Cyclopean Wall' kaha jaata hai; kaha jaata hai ki yah deewar Jarasandha ke samay me bani tatha baad me Maurya kal me ise sabal kiya gaya. Deewar ki lambai lagbhag 40 kilometre maani jaati hai tatha yah 'elephant jaw' jaisi bheetar ki taraf mudti hui pathar ki chunai ka udaharan hai. Rajgir ke kshetra me Vishwa Shanti Stupa (Ratnagiri par, 1969), Son Bhandar ki gufayein tatha garm jal-kund (Brahmakund) bhi sthit hain. Bodh Gaya, Kesariya tatha Pawapuri ko aisi suraksha-deewar ke liye nahi jaana jaata, isliye 'Rajgir' hi sahi uttar hai. Exam point: Cyclopean Wall = Rajgir (Nalanda), prachin pathar ki suraksha-deewar, Jarasandha se juda; Rajgir panch pahadiyon se ghira hai tatha yahin Magadha ki pehli rajdhani Rajagriha thi.

qe: Goga Bil (Gogabil) wetland in Katihar district, a Ramsar site, holds which record for Bihar?
qh: कटिहार जिले का गोगाबिल आर्द्रभूमि (रामसर साइट) बिहार के लिए कौन-सा रिकॉर्ड रखता है?
oe: Bihar's first Community Reserve, notified in August 2019
oh: अगस्त 2019 में अधिसूचित बिहार का पहला कम्युनिटी रिजर्व
e: Goga Bil (Gogabil) Katihar jile me Ganga-Mahananda floodplain par bani oxbow (chhaadan) jheel hai; yah ek praachin nadi-marg ke chhoot jaane se bani tatha barsaat me iska aakar kaafi badh jaata hai. August 2019 me ise Bihar ka pehla 'Community Reserve' ghoshit kiya gaya - 'community reserve' woh sanrakshit kshetra hota hai jahan aas-paas ke samuday (community) khud jungle, jheel tatha vanyajeevon ke sanrakshan me bhaag lete hain tatha unhe iska adhikar milta hai. Iske aas-paas lagbhag 90 se adhik prakar ke pakshi aate hain, isliye ise 'Important Bird Area' (IBA) bhi maana jaata hai; kuch samay baad ise Ramsar site ka darja bhi mila. Bihar ka pehla rashtriya udyan tatha pehla tiger reserve Valmiki (West Champaran) hai tatha pehla zoo safari Rajgir (Nalanda) me 2022 me khula, isliye woh vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Goga Bil (Katihar) = Bihar ka pehla Community Reserve (August 2019), oxbow wetland, Important Bird Area tatha Ramsar site; pehla national park/tiger reserve = Valmiki, pehla zoo safari = Rajgir (2022).

qe: The Golghar, the beehive-shaped grain store of Patna built after the famine of 1770, was constructed in 1786 under the supervision of which engineer?
qh: 1770 के अकाल के बाद बना पटना का मधुमक्खी-छत्ते जैसा अनाज-भंडार गोलघर 1786 में किस इंजीनियर की देखरेख में बनाया गया?
e: Patna ka Golghar 1786 me Captain John Garstin ki nigrani me bana. Ise 1770 ki bhayankar akal ke baad anaj surakshit rakhne ke liye banwaya gaya; iska aakaran gol tatha madhumakkhi ke chhatte jaisa hai, jiski deewarein kaafi moti hain tatha andar charhne ke liye gol ghoomti (spiral) seedhi bani hui hai. Aisa bhandar banane ki soch is baat se nikli ki akal ke samay khane ka anaj na hone par hazaaron logon ki maut hui thi; isliye sarkar ne aage ke liye bada anaj-bhandar khada kiya, taaki vipatti me anaj ka stock rahe. Aaj Golghar Patna ka prasiddh sthal hai tatha isse Ganga tatha poore shahar ka nazara dikhta hai. Robert Barker tatha Hector Munro sainik adhikari the tatha Colonel Forde ne Bedara ki ladai ladi thi. Isliye sahi uttar Captain John Garstin hai. Exam point: Golghar, Patna = 1786, Captain John Garstin dwara anaj-bhandar ke roop me banaya gaya; iski pehchan gol (beehive) aakaran tatha andar ki gol-ghoomti seedhi; yah 1770 ki akal ke baad surakshit anaj-raksha ki soch ka parinaam hai.

qe: Agam Kuan at Patna, a very deep well linked with popular worship, is identified in Buddhist tradition with which feature of Ashoka's reign?
qh: पटना का अगम कुआँ, जो लोक-पूजा से जुड़ा अत्यंत गहरा कुआँ है, बौद्ध परंपरा में अशोक के शासनकाल की किस विशेषता से जोड़ा जाता है?
oe: The 'hell' or torture chamber of Ashoka
Ashoka's hospital for birds and animals
A water tank of the Mauryan army
e: Agam Kuan Patna ka ek bahut gehra kuan ya gadda hai, jise parampara me Ashoka ke us narak ya yatana-grih se joda jaata hai, jiska zikr saatvin sadi ke cheeni yatri Hiuen Tsiang ne kiya tha. Unke varnan me is yatana-grih ka zikr hai: ek Bauddh bhikshu ko us yatana-grih me daala gaya, lekin woh jal nahi paaya tatha kamal ke phool par baitha mila; yah dekh kar raja ka hriday badla tatha woh Bauddh dharm ka anuyayi ban gaya. Isi katha ka ek roop Jain parampara me bhi milta hai, jahan us bhikshu ka naam Sudarsan bataya jaata hai tatha kaha jaata hai ki raja ne use riha kar apne paas basa liya. Aaj bhi log is kuen ko dukh aur narak se joda maante hain, iska paani peete nahi, tatha Asarh ke aathve din hone wale 'Agam Mela' me ek lakh se zyada log phool tatha anya bhent chadhaate hain tatha chechak (smallpox) se bachaav ki prarthana karte hain; isi kshetra me Bulandi Bagh naam ke sthal se mila ek patthar ka slab log Buddha ke us aakhri kadam se jodte hain, jo unhone Ganga paar karne se pehle rakha tha. Isliye sahi uttar Ashoka ke narak ya yatana-grih wala hai. Exam point: Agam Kuan = Ashoka ke 'narak' (torture chamber) se joda jaane wala kuan; Hiuen Tsiang ke varnan me is sthal ka zikr; Asarh ke aathve din Agam Mela me ek lakh se zyada log phool chadhaate hain tatha chechak se bachaav ki prarthana karte hain.

qe: When the Chinese pilgrim Hiuen Tsiang visited Pataliputra around 640 AD, he found the ancient capital in what condition?
qh: जब चीनी यात्री ह्वेनसांग ने 640 ईस्वी के आसपास पाटलिपुत्र का दौरा किया, तब उन्हें प्राचीन राजधानी किस हाल में मिली?
oe: In ruins, with only two or three monasteries still intact
A flourishing city of lakhs of people
Rebuilt as a new Gupta capital
oh: खंडहरों में, जहाँ केवल दो-तीन विहार ही बचे थे
नदी की बाढ़ में दबा हुआ
गुप्तकालीन नई राजधानी के रूप में पुनर्निर्मित
e: 640 AD ke aas-paas jab cheeni yatri Hiuen Tsiang bharat aaye tatha Pataliputra ka daurra kiya, tab unhe yah shahar khandharon me mila. Hiuen Tsiang ne likha ki yah purana shahar lambe samay se ujaad pada tha tatha bachi-khuchi sirf purani neev tatha deewarein thi. Vihar, mandir tatha stupa saikdon ki sankhya me the, lekin unme se keval do ya teen hi poore tatha sahi halat me bache the. Is daur tak Pataliputra ki chamak khatm ho chuki thi, kyunki panchvin-chhatvin sadi ke Huna hamlon tatha Sasanka ke aakraman se shahar ki sthiti bigdi thi tatha Bauddh sansthaon ko bhaari nuksan hua tha. Purane mahal ke uttar me Ganga ke kinare basa bacha-khucha shahar ek chhota kasba tha, jisme lagbhag ek hazaar ghar the; is daur tak Pataliputra ki chamak khatm ho chuki thi, kyunki chhatvin sadi ke Huna hamle ke baad Sasanka ke aakraman se shahar ujad gaya, uske pavitra avshesh nasht hue tatha Bauddh bhikshu bikhar gaye. Aise varnan yatree-sahitya se milte hain, isliye woh prachin Bihar ke itihas ke mahatvapurn pramaan maane jaate hain. Exam point: Hiuen Tsiang ne 640 AD me Pataliputra ko ujaad tatha khandharon me paiya; keval do-teen vihar hi bache the; Huna hamle tatha Sasanka ke aakraman se shahar ki avnati hui.

qe: The large bell of the old church at Patna, known as Padri ki Haveli, was presented in 1782 by Bahadur Sah, who was the son of which ruler?
qh: पटना के पुराने गिरजाघर, जिसे 'पादरी की हवेली' कहा जाता है, की बड़ी घंटी 1782 में बहादुर साह ने भेंट की थी, जो किस शासक के पुत्र थे?
e: Patna ke purane girjaghar ko log Padri ki Haveli kehte hain. Is imarat ki banawat ka shrey ek jaane-maane architect Tiretto ko diya jaata hai, jinhone ise 1772 me design kiya. Isi girjaghar ki badi ghanti 1782 me Bahadur Sah ne bhej kar bhent ki thi; woh Nepal ke Raja Prithvi Narain ke putra the. Nepal ke ek rajkumar dwara Patna ke girjaghar ko ghanti bhent karna dikhata hai ki us daur me Patna tatha Nepal ke seemant kshetra ke beech dharmik tatha vyaparik sambandh kitne ghanishth the. Padri ki Haveli Patna ka sabse purana girjaghar maana jaata hai, jo aaj bhi Patna City kshetra me sthit hai tatha dekhne layak dharohar hai. Awadh ke Nawab, Tirhut ke Raja tatha Darbhanga ke Maharaja ka is ghanti se seedha sambandh nahi hai. Exam point: Padri ki Haveli (Patna) ki imarat ka design 1772 me architect Tiretto ne banaya; iski badi ghanti 1782 me Nepal ke Raja Prithvi Narain ke putra Bahadur Sah ne bhent ki; yah Patna ka sabse purana girjaghar maana jaata hai.

qe: The mosque at Patna built in 1499 by Allauddin Husain Shah, Sultan of Gaur, and later repaired by Begu Hajjam in 1654, is famous for what feature?
qh: 1499 में गौड़ के सुल्तान अलाउद्दीन हुसैन शाह द्वारा बनवाई तथा 1654 में बेगू हज्जाम द्वारा मरम्मत कराई गई पटना की मस्जिद किस विशेषता के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
oe: A marble minaret taller than the Qutub Minar
A courtyard paved with glazed tiles of Gaur
oh: कुतुब मीनार से ऊँची संगमरमर की मीनार
गौड़ की चमकीली टाइलों से बना प्रांगण
e: Patna ki yah masjid Gaur ke Sultan Allauddin Husain Shah ne 1499 me banwai thi tatha lagbhag dedh sau saal baad 1654 me Begu Hajjam ne iski marammat karai. Is masjid ka sabse khaas hissa iska prangan hai, jise Gaur ki chamkili tatha rangeen tile-kaari wale pattharon se banaya gaya hai. Aise tile tatha patthar ka kaam us daur ki pehchan hai, jab Gaur ke sultanat ka prabhav Bihar ke ek bade hisse tak phaila hua tha. Yah masjid ab dekh-rekh ki kami ke karan kharab halat me hai, isliye ise puratatv tatha dharohar ki drishti se mahatvapurn maana jaata hai. Ek hi lakdi ka gumbad, kutub minar se unchi sangmarmar minar tatha bhoomigat namaz-kaksh is masjid ki visheshataen nahi hain. Exam point: 1499 ki yah masjid Gaur ke Sultan Allauddin Husain Shah ne banwai tatha 1654 me Begu Hajjam ne marammat karai; iski pehchan Gaur-style glazed tiles ka prangan tatha tarashe patthar ka darwaza hai.

qe: Sher Shah's mosque at Patna, built between 1540 and 1545 near the eastern gate of the old city, has how many domes in all?
qh: पुराने शहर के पूरबी दरवाज़े के पास 1540 से 1545 के बीच बनी शेरशाह की मस्जिद पर कुल कितने गुंबद हैं?
oe: Three domes in a single row
Five - one large in the centre and four small at the corners
oh: पाँच - बीच में एक बड़ा तथा कोनों पर चार छोटे
e: Sher Shah Suri ne 1540 se 1545 ke beech Patna City ke purabi darwaze ke paas ek masjid banwai, jise Sher Shah ki masjid kaha jaata hai. Yah ent (brick) se bani hui hai; iski banawat dekhne me saadi magar mazboot hai, jiske beech me ek bada gumbad tatha chaaron konon par ek-ek chhota gumbad hai, is tarah kul paanch gumbad dikhte hain. Masjid ke bahar kai kabrein bhi hain, jinme sabse purani kabar Ashraf Ali Khan ki hai, jo Mughal badshah Muhammad Shah ke doodh-bhai (foster brother) the. Sher Shah ne poore desh me sadak tatha sarai ki vyavastha se yatra-vyapar ko aasan kiya tha, isliye unke kaal ki imaratein saadi tatha majboot hone ke bawajood apni pehchan banati hain. Isliye sahi uttar paanch gumbad hai. Exam point: Sher Shah ki masjid = Patna City ke purabi darwaze ke paas, 1540-1545 ke beech bani, paanch gumbad (ek bada beech me tatha chaar chhote konon par), ent ki mazboot banawat; bahar sabse purani kabar Ashraf Ali Khan ki.

qe: Pathar ki Masjid of Patna, standing on the bank of the Ganga, was built in 1621 by which prince who served as governor of Bihar?
qh: गंगा के तट पर स्थित पटना की 'पत्थर की मस्जिद' 1621 में बिहार के गवर्नर रहे किस शहज़ादे ने बनवाई थी?
oe: Dara Shikoh, son of Shah Jahan
Murad Baksh, son of Shah Jahan
e: Patna ki Pathar ki Masjid Ganga kinare par sthit ek purani tatha bhavya masjid hai. Ise 1621 me Shahzade Parvez Shah ne banwaya tha, jo Mughal badshah Jahangir ke putra the tatha apne pita ke samay Bihar ke gavarnar ke roop me yahan rehte the. Naam se hi saaf hai ki is masjid me patthar ka bada upyog hua hai; iski saadgi tatha mazbooti ise Patna ke mahatvapurn Mughal-kaaleen sthalon me shamil karti hai. Mughal shahzade jab kisi sube ke gavarnar hote the, tab woh wahan masjid, bagh tatha imaratein banwate the, jisse shahar ki shobha badhti thi tatha unki apni pehchan banti thi. Azim-us-Shan ke naam par Patna ka purana naam Azimabad pada tha, lekin Pathar ki Masjid ka nirman Parvez Shah se juda hai; Dara Shikoh tatha Murad Baksh is sthal ke nirmata nahi hai. Exam point: Pathar ki Masjid (Patna) = 1621, Jahangir ke putra Parvez Shah dwara banwai gayi; woh us samay Bihar ke gavarnar the; Patna ka purana naam Azimabad Azim-us-Shan se juda hai, masjid ke nirman se nahi.

qe: Patna's fort on the Ganga, which gave the city strategic importance in the 16th century, was built in 1541 by which ruler?
qh: गंगा के किनारे पटना का किला, जिसने 16वीं सदी में शहर को सामरिक महत्व दिया, 1541 में किस शासक ने बनवाया?
e: Patna me Ganga ke kinare kila 1541 me Sher Shah Suri ne banwaya; isi ke baad shahar tezi se mahatvapurn ban gaya. Sher Shah ke kila banane ke lagbhag 45 saal baad, 1586 me, angrej vyapari Ralph Fitch ne Patna ko ek bade shahar ke roop me dekha, jahan afim (opium) tatha suti kapde (cotton cloth) ka bada vyapar hota tha; shahar purab se pashchim tak lagbhag dedh mile tatha uttar se dakshin tak teen-chauthai mile tak phaila hua tha. Sher Shah ne sadak tatha sarai ki vyavastha se yatra-vyapar aasan kiya tha, isliye Ganga-kinare shahron jaise Patna ka vyapar bhi badha. Aage 18vein sadi ke shuru me shahar ki purani deewar ke bahar bhi basti phaili tatha suraksha ke liye khai tatha deewar ki marammat karani padi. Babur, Allauddin Husain Shah tatha Islam Shah is kila-nirman ke liye jaane nahi jaate. Exam point: Patna ka kila = 1541, Sher Shah Suri dwara; 1586 me Ralph Fitch ne Patna ko afim tatha suti kapde ke bade vyapar wala shahar bataya; Sher Shah ki sadak-sarai vyavastha ne yatra tatha vyapar badhaya.

qe: Shaista Khan's mosque and Katra, and the Ambar Mosque built by his nazim Khwaja Ambar, stand in which old part of Patna?
qh: शाइस्ता खान की मस्जिद तथा कटरा, और उनके नाज़िम ख्वाजा अंबर द्वारा बनवाई अंबर मस्जिद, पटना के किस पुराने हिस्से में स्थित हैं?
oe: The Chauk, the main city street
e: Purane Patna ke Chauk kshetra me Shaista Khan ki masjid tatha katra bani hui hai. Shaista Khan Bangal ke subedar the tatha yah masjid unke samay, 17vein sadi ke ant me, banwayi gayi maani jaati hai. Unke nazim Khwaja Ambar ne 1688-89 me Ambar Masjid banwai, isliye yah bhi Chauk kshetra ki pehchan hai. Isi ilaake me Allauddin Husain Shah ki 1499 ki masjid tatha uske paas Makhd-ud-daula ki masjid bhi sthit hai, jo 1731 se 1736 ke beech Patna ke gavarnar rahe. Katra ka arth hota hai ek aisi bazar-basti, jo bade dharmik ya vyaparik sansthan ke saath basai jaati thi; isliye masjid ke saath katra banwana us daur ki vyaparik soch dikhata hai, jab dharmik sthal ke aas-paas bazar tatha karkhane bhi base. Bankipore maidan, Digha tatha Kumrahar alag kshetra hain. Exam point: Shaista Khan ki masjid tatha katra, Khwaja Ambar ki Ambar Masjid (1688-89), Allauddin Husain Shah ki 1499 ki masjid tatha Makhd-ud-daula ki masjid - sab Chauk kshetra, Patna me sthit hain; katra = dharmik sthal ke saath basai gayi bazar-basti.

qe: On the surface of the hill under the fort at Giriak, towards the east, lay an image representing a female killing a buffalo, exactly like which images of the Gaya country?
qh: गिरियक के किले के नीचे पूर्व की ओर पहाड़ी की सतह पर पड़ी एक मूर्ति में भैंसे को मारती हुई देवी दिखाई जाती है, जो गया क्षेत्र की किन मूर्तियों के बिल्कुल समान थी?
e: Giriak ke teele par jo patthar bikhire the, unme zyadatar Panchanan nadi ke doosri or ki pahadi se laye gaye quartz ya hornstone ke kacche tukde the, lekin kuch murtiyan tatha pot stone ke tukde bhi bikhre the. Do murtiyan lagbhag poori thi, chahe bahut ghis gayi thi. Ek murti pahadi ki satah par kila ke niche purb ki or padi thi, jisme ek stri bhainse ko maar rahi thi; yah Kewadoi ki Jagadamba murtiyon ke bilkul saman thi. Uske paas ek sundar chauk paaya gaya tha, jispar paanch murtiyan khadi thi, lekin unke keval pair bache the tatha murtiyan gayab ho gayi thi. Exam point: Giriak me pahadi ki satah par mili bhainse ko marne wali devi ki murti Kewadoi ki Jagadamba murtiyon ke saman thi; uske paas ek chauk mila, jispar paanch murtiyan khadi hone ke keval pair bache the.

qe: The other nearly entire image at Giriak, leaning against the wall of a small modern temple of Siva, showed a male with four arms leaning on two small personages; by what name did the people call it?
qh: गिरियक की दूसरी लगभग पूरी मूर्ति, जो शिव के एक छोटे आधुनिक मंदिर की दीवार से टिकी थी, उसमें चार भुजाओं वाला एक पुरुष दो छोटी आकृतियों पर झुका दिखता है; लोग उसे किस नाम से पुकारते थे?
e: Giriak ke teele ke uttar ki or do chhote dher the; unme sabse uttari dher par Shiv ka ek chhota adhunik mandir tha tatha uski deewar se ek murti tiki hui thi. Is murti me char bhujaon wala purush do chhoti aakritiyon - ek purush tatha ek stri - par jhuka hua dikhta hai; niche do chhoti murtiyan pranam ki mudra me hain tatha upar do devdoot haathon me pushp-mala liye mandra rahe hain. Uske sir par unchi topi tatha purana raj-mukut hai. Logon ne is murti ko Lakshmi-Narayan kaha tatha kaha ki yah Gaya ki sabse aam murtiyon me se ek jaisi hai, jo Pauya me prachalit roop se isi naam se jani jaati hai. Exam point: Giriak ke Shiv mandir ki deewar se tiki murti ko log Lakshmi-Narayan kehte the; yah Gaya ki aam murtiyon jaisi thi tatha Pauya me prachalit usi naam wali murti ki tarah thi.

qe: A larger temple of the same shape on the face of the hill at Giriak was built over what, the marks being small and like real impressions, being excavated and not elevated like the feet of the Jain?
qh: गिरियक में पहाड़ी के किनारे उसी आकार का एक बड़ा मंदिर किस चिह्न के ऊपर बना था, जिसके निशान छोटे तथा असली पद-चिह्न जैसे हैं - खुदे हुए, जैन पद-चिह्नों की तरह उभरे हुए नहीं?
e: Pahadi ki satah par ek sthal se doosre sthal jaate hue sarvekshak ek bade mandir tak pahuncha, jo pahle wale ke hi aakar ka tha tatha sambhavtah chhah foot vargakar tha. Yah mandir Krishna ke charanon ke chinh ke upar banaya gaya tha; in nishanon ke baare me kaha gaya ki woh chhote tatha asli pad-chinh jaise hain - khude hue, jain pad-chinhon ki tarah ubhre hue nahi. Nawada me inhi nishanon ko Ram ke charanon ka chinh kaha jaata tha. Mandir ke andar ek murti ke itne tukde pade the ki yah pata nahi chalta tha ki kaunsi murti thi; paas hi ek sanyasi ki samadhi thi, jo wahan ke pujari ki poorv-adhikari thi. Exam point: Giriak ki pahadi ke kinare bana bada mandir Krishna ke charanon ke chinh par bana tha, jinke nishan khude hue the tatha Nawada me unhe Ram ke pad-chinh kaha jaata tha.

qe: Under a tree on the east side of the large heap at Giriak lay a fragment of the human form which the Musalmans had placed upon a heap of bricks and worshipped as what?
qh: गिरियक के बड़े टीले के पूर्व की ओर एक पेड़ के नीचे मानव-आकृति का टुकड़ा पड़ा था, जिसे मुसलमानों ने ईंटों के ढेर पर रख कर किस रूप में पूजना शुरू किया था?
oe: As the idol of a Jain Tirthankar
As a relic of the Prophet
As one of their saints or devils
oh: किसी जैन तीर्थंकर की प्रतिमा के रूप में
पैगंबर की निशानी के रूप में
अली की मूर्ति के रूप में
उनके किसी पीर या भूत के रूप में
e: Giriak ke teele par bikhire pattharon ke beech purani murtiyon ke tukde tatha pot stone ke tukde bhi mile. Bade teele tatha nadi ke beech ek ped ke niche anek tukde pade the - ling ke purush-bhaag, Ganesa ka ek hissa tatha char-bhuja wali purush-murti ke do tukde. Bade teele ke uttari chhor par usi purush-murti ka ek tukda tatha uske sir par mandrate devdoot me se ek bhi mila. Bade teele ke purb ki or ped ke niche mili manav-aakriti ke tukde ko Musalmanon ne eenton ke dher par rakh kar apne kisi pir ya bhoot ke roop me pujna shuru kar diya tha. Yah dikhata hai ki purani murtiyon ke tukde samay ke saath nayi puja-paddhatiyon me kaise shamil ho jaate the. Exam point: Giriak me purani murtiyon ke kai tukde bikhre the; bade teele ke purb ki or ped ke niche mili manav-aakriti ko Musalmanon ne eenton ke dher par rakh kar apne pir ya bhoot ke roop me pujna shuru kiya tha.

qe: The pillars of the ruins on the ridge at Giriak consisted of a very fine grey granite with white felspar and quartz and black mica; what proved that they had been brought from a distance?
qh: गिरियक की कटक पर स्थित खंडहरों के स्तंभ बहुत उत्तम धूसर ग्रेनाइट के थे, जिसमें सफ़ेद फेल्स्पार, क्वार्ट्ज़ तथा काला अभ्रक था; यह किस बात से सिद्ध होता था कि वे दूर से लाए गए थे?
oe: They were carved in a foreign style of ornament
They bore the name of a distant king
No such stone existed on the hill
They were too heavy to be carried up a slope
oh: उनकी नक्काशी विदेशी शैली की थी
उन पर किसी दूर के राजा का नाम खुदा था
पहाड़ी पर ऐसा पत्थर कहीं नहीं मिलता था
वे इतने भारी थे कि ढलान पर चढ़ाए नहीं जा सकते थे
e: Giriak ki pahadi ke kinare-kinare ek chaudi patthar ki sadak ya seedhi jaati thi, jo lagbhag barah foot chaudi thi tatha pahadi se kate pattharon ke kacche tukdon se bani thi. Uske ek sthal par pahunch kar sarvekshak ne imarat ke khandaar dekhe, jinke ek kone me granit ke paanch khambhe aur anyatra teen khambhe khade mile. Ye khambhe lagbhag das foot unche tatha chaukor the; inme se keval ek hi kinare par madhur-nakashi ki gayi thi, isliye anuman lagaya gaya ki ye aangan ke charon or ek corridor banate the tatha nakkashi wala hissa sabse zyada dikhne wali or moda gaya tha. Ye khambhe bahut uttam dhushar granit ke the, jinme safed felspar, quartz tatha kala abhrak th a; chunki pahadi par aisa patthar kahin nahi milta tha, isliye ye spasht tha ki khambhe door se laye gaye the. Exam point: Giriak ke khandaar ke granit khambhe (safed felspar, quartz tatha kala abhrak wale) door se laye gaye the, kyunki pahadi par aisa patthar nahi milta tha; ve lagbhag das foot unche chaukor khambhe the tatha ek kinare par nakashi ki gayi thi.

qe: Immediately west of the ruined building at Giriak stood a conical mass of brick on a square basis with no cavity in its summit; it was probably what kind of structure?
qh: गिरियक की खंडहर इमारत के ठीक पश्चिम में एक वर्गाकार आधार पर ईंटों का शंक्वाकार ढेर था, जिसके शिखर पर कोई कोटर नहीं था; वह संभवतः किस प्रकार की संरचना थी?
oe: A deep well for the fortress
A solid temple like that of the Buddhists
A dwelling house of the priests
oh: बौद्धों के मंदिर जैसा ठोस मंदिर
e: Giriak ke khandaar me ek aangan tatha uske charon or banayi gayi deewar ke chinh mile, jisse lagta hai ki ek tarace ya chabutara bana tha. Uske thoda pashchim me ek vargakar aadhar par eenton ka shankvakar dher tha, jiske shikhar par koi kotar nahi thi; isliye anuman lagaya gaya ki yah ek thos mandir tha, jaise Bauddhon ke stoop ya thos mandir hote the. Us thos dher ke uttar ki or ek chhota kaksh bhi dikha, jo kam se kam kuch bhaag me granit se bana tha. Aage tarace ka pashchim chhor bahut tezi se girta tha tatha chattan ko kaat kar uspar dhal banayi gayi thi, jisse malba nikalne me aasani hui hogi. Exam point: Giriak me vargakar aadhar par bana eenton ka shankvakar dher, jiske shikhar par kotar nahi thi, sambhavtah Baudh mandiron jaisa thos mandir tha; uske uttar ki or granit se bana ek chhota kaksh bhi mila.

qe: The circular base of a fine column on a square pedestal at Giriak, the most entire part of the ruin and a solid building without any cavity, was called the Enitaki or what?
qh: गिरियक में वर्गाकार चौकी पर खड़े एक सुंदर स्तंभ का गोल आधार, जो खंडहर का सबसे साबुत भाग था तथा बिना किसी कोटर की ठोस इमारत थी, किस नाम से जाना जाता था?
oe: The throne of the Hangsa Rajah
e: Giriak me pahadi ki choti par khandaar ke bache hue hisson me ek bahut hi saabut ang bacha tha - vargakar chauki par khade ek sundar stambh ka gol aadhar, jiski paridhi panch foot thi tatha jise Enitaki yaani Jarasandha ka aasan kaha jaata tha. Yah ek thos imarat thi, jisme koi kotar nahi thi; iska pata iski pashchim disha ki or ki gayi gehri khudai se chalta hai, jo sambhavtah khazane ki khoj me ki gayi thi. Yah stambh badi eenton se bana tha, jo chikni mitti me jami thi; bahar ki eentein jahan pahunch ho saki, hata li gayi thi, lekin upar ka kuch bhaag apni mool moulding ke saath bacha hua tha tatha uski bahari satah chhini se chamkayi gayi thi. Exam point: Giriak me panch foot paridhi wale stambh ke gol aadhar ko Enitaki yaani Jarasandha ka aasan kaha jaata tha; yah bina kotar ki thos imarat thi tatha uski pashchim or khazane ki khoj me khudai ki gayi thi.

qe: The building towards the west at Giriak was called Hangsa Pur by a sanyasi, but all other persons were ignorant of that name; what did both parties nevertheless admit about it?
qh: गिरियक में पश्चिम की ओर स्थित इमारत को एक संन्यासी हंसपुर कहता था, पर अन्य सभी लोग उस नाम से अनजान थे; फिर भी दोनों पक्ष इसके बारे में क्या मानते थे?
oe: That it was a temple of Siva
That it was a Buddhist monastery
That it was the tomb of a Maga king
That it was the house of Jarasandha
oh: वह किसी मग राजा की समाधि थी
e: Giriak ke pashchim wali imarat ko ek sanyasi, jo do adhunik mandiron ka pujari tha, Hangsa Pur kehta tha; lekin anya sabhi log is naam se anjaan the. Phir bhi dono paksh yah maante the ki yah Jarasandha ka ghar tha. Sarvekshak ne yah maanna galti batayi, kyunki aisi jagah par koi raja nahi reh sakta tha tatha imarat spasht roop se mandir thi; uske saamne khadi us stambh ki upyogita spasht nahi thi. Sarvekshak ka vichar tha ki stambh ya to mandir ka sajaawat wala ang tha, ya us raja ki samadhi - aur yahi sabse sambhavit maana gaya, kyunki Jarasandha ke baare me kaha jaata hai ki woh Rajgir ke paas char koses pashchim me mara gaya tha. Exam point: Giriak ki pashchim wali imarat ko ek sanyasi Hangsa Pur kehta tha, lekin sabhi log ise Jarasandha ka ghar maante the; sarvekshak ne ise mandir bataya tatha stambh ko sambhavtah Jarasandha ki samadhi maana.

qe: What was the size of the cave at Giriak, whose floor rose inwards with a steep ascent and which was said to be an usual haunt of bears?
qh: गिरियक की उस गुफा का आकार क्या था, जिसका फ़र्श भीतर की ओर तेज़ ढलान के साथ उठता था तथा जो भालुओं के आम ठिकाने के रूप में जानी जाती थी?
oe: About 100 feet in diameter and 30 feet high
About 20 feet in diameter and 5 feet high
About 40 or 50 feet in diameter and 10 or 12 feet high
About 10 or 12 feet in diameter and 40 or 50 feet high
oh: व्यास में लगभग 100 फुट तथा ऊँचाई में 30 फुट
व्यास में लगभग 20 फुट तथा ऊँचाई में 5 फुट
व्यास में लगभग 40 या 50 फुट तथा ऊँचाई में 10 या 12 फुट
व्यास में लगभग 10 या 12 फुट तथा ऊँचाई में 40 या 50 फुट
e: Sarvekshak ne ek bahut unchi aur khadi chattan ke niche se guzarte hue ek badi gufa ka muh paya. Gufa ka muh chauda tha, lagbhag 40 ya 50 foot vyas ka tatha jahan sabse uncha tha, wahan 10 ya 12 foot unchai ka tha. Gufa ka farsh bhitar ki or bahut tez dhal ke saath uthta tha tatha bahut khurdara tha; chhat dekhne me khatarnak lagti thi tatha uski dararon me jangli suar panah lete the. Gufa poori tarah sookhi thi tatha munh ke paas thandi tatha hawa-dar thi; kaha jaata tha ki yah bhaloun ka aam thikana hai. Aise varnan se pata chalta hai ki Buchanan ke sarvekshan me sthal ki bhugol tatha prachin avshesh dono ka vivran diya gaya. Exam point: Giriak ki gufa ka muh lagbhag 40 ya 50 foot vyas tatha 10 ya 12 foot uncha tha; uska farsh bhitar ki or tez dhal ke saath uthta tha, gufa sookhi tatha hawa-dar thi tatha bhaloun ka thikana maani jaati thi.

qe: At Tapaban, where a mela had been held two days before the surveyor's visit and was supposed to have been attended by eight or ten thousand people, the Brahmans who came to receive contributions called themselves what?
qh: तपोबन में, जहाँ सर्वेक्षक के दौरे से दो दिन पहले एक मेला लगा था और जिसमें आठ-दस हज़ार लोगों के आने का अनुमान था, वहाँ दान-चंदा लेने आए ब्राह्मण स्वयं को क्या कहते थे?
e: Tapaban ek aisa sthal tha, jahan sarvekshan se do din pehle ek mela laga tha tatha anuman tha ki usme aath se das hazaar log aaye honge. Yah sthal Rajagriha ke pavitra sthalon ka ek hissa mana jaata tha; isi karan Rajgir se kuch Brahman yahan chanda tatha daan lene aaye the.
