Ve svayan ko Magaiya Srotriya kehte the, lekin yah bhi batate the ki ve asal me Maharashtra ke Brahman hain, jinhe ek aise raja ne yahan basaya tha, jiska naam Krishna ke pita ke naam jaisa tha. Aise vivran se pata chalta hai ki mela aur tirath-sthalon ke aas-paas pujariyon tatha pandon ka poora samuday bas gaya tha, jo yatrion se daan pa kar apna nirvah karta tha. Exam point: Tapaban me lage mela me aath-das hazaar logon ke aane ka anuman tha; Rajagriha se aaye Brahman svayan ko Magaiya Srotriya kehte the tatha apne Maharashtra ke Brahman hone ki baat batate the.

qe: The easternmost of the five holy kunds at Tapaban, about 110 feet square and three feet deep at the time of the survey, had which name?
qh: तपोबन के पाँच पवित्र कुंडों में सबसे पूर्वी, जो सर्वेक्षण के समय लगभग 110 फुट चौकोर तथा तीन फुट गहरा था, का नाम क्या था?
e: Tapaban ke pavitra sthal paanch kund yaani talabon ke roop me the, jinke paas paani ke chhote chashme the; yah kund pahadi ke niche ek kataar me bane hue the tatha inka paani yahan ke kheton ki upjaau shakti badhane ke liye moda jaata tha. Inme sabse purab wala kund Chuadakosi kehlata tha tatha yah sabse badi talab thi - karib 110 foot chaukor tatha us mausam me teen foot gehra. Uske kinare eenton ki phast wali deewar bani thi, jo paani tak usi tarah jhukti thi; deewar ke ek taraf seedhiyan thin tatha samne ki taraf ek chhota darwaza, jo ek chhote mandir me khulta tha. Us mandir me ek murti thi, jo Giriak ke Shivalaya ki murti jaisi thi tatha yahan use Vasudeva kaha jaata tha. Exam point: Tapaban ke paanch kundon me sabse purab wala tatha sabse bada kund Chuadakosi tha, jo karib 110 foot chaukor tatha us mausam me teen foot gehra tha; uske kinare phast wali eenton ki deewar, seedhiyan tatha ek chhota mandir tha, jisme Giriak jaisi murti, jo Vasudeva kehlati thi.

qe: At the west side of the Tapaban tank several small images had been gathered, mostly defaced; fragments of five or six images called Vasudeva were admitted to belong to the Buddhists on account of what feature?
qh: तपोबन की तालाब के पश्चिमी छोर पर कई छोटी मूर्तियाँ इकट्ठी की गई थीं, जो अधिकतर खंडित थीं; वसुदेव कही जाने वाली पाँच-छह मूर्तियों के टुकड़े किस विशेषता के कारण बौद्धों की मानी जाती थीं?
oh: उनके अत्यधिक बड़े तथा फैले हुए कान
e: Tapaban ke kund ke pashchim ki or kai chhoti murtiyan ikattha ki gayi thin, jo adhiktar khandit yaani toot-phoot gayi thin. Inme paanch-chhah murtiyon ke tukde aisi murtiyon ke the, jinhe Vasudeva kaha jaata tha; unke kaan itne faile hue tatha bade the ki vivran-karta ne maana ki yah murtiyan Bauddhon ki hain, kyunki itne bade kaan Bauddh murti-kala ki pehchan maane jaate hain. Wahan do aisi deviyan bhi milin, jo sinh par baithi dikhayi gayi thin, tatha do Gauri-Sankar tatha teen ling bhi mile. Iske alawa eenton tatha patthar ka ek chabutara bhi tha, jiske bare me kaha jaata tha ki use kisi puraane shasak ne banwaya tha. Yah vivran dikhata hai ki us sthal par alag-alag dharmon tatha sampradayon ki murti-kala ek saath mili hui thi. Exam point: Tapaban me mili Vasudeva kehlane wali murtiyon ke tukde unke had se adhik bade tatha faile hue kaanon ke karan Bauddh maane gaye; wahan sinh par baithi do deviyan, Gauri-Sankar tatha teen ling bhi mile.

qe: At Narawat, said to have been the residence of a Nol Raja who lived in the Tritayog and is celebrated in legend, what did the surveyor find near the village besides brick heaps and scattered defaced images?
qh: नरावत, जिसे त्रितयोग में रहने वाले तथा किंवदंती में प्रसिद्ध 'नोल राजा' का निवास कहा जाता था, में सर्वेक्षक को ईंटों के ढेरों तथा बिखरी खंडित मूर्तियों के अलावा क्या मिला?
oe: A stone gateway with golden pinnacle
A large stupa covered with lime plaster
A marble throne with Persian inscriptions
Pillars of granite resembling those on the Giriak hill
oh: स्वर्ण शिखर वाला पत्थर का प्रवेश-द्वार
चूने की परत से ढका बड़ा स्तूप
फ़ारसी अभिलेखों वाला संगमरमर का सिंहासन
गिरियक पहाड़ी जैसे ग्रेनाइट के स्तंभ
e: Narawat ke bare me kaha jaata tha ki purane samay me yah Nol Raja ka nivash sthal tha, jo Tritayog me raha karta tha tatha kathao tatha kivdantiyon me prasiddh hai. Sarvekshak ne paya ki is ilaqe ki zameen kuch sau saal tak banjar padi rahi thi tatha yahan eenton ke kai dher the, jinme sabse bada dher karib das bigah me faila tatha lagbhag chaukor tha; in dheron ki unchai bahut kam thi, isliye nishchay nahi ho paata tha ki yah ati prachinata ka parinam hai ya yahan ki imaratein shuru se hi chhoti thin. In dheron ke aas-paas bahut si murtiyan bikhi thin, jo adhiktar toot-phoot gayi thin, tatha granit ke kai stambh bhi the, jo bahut kacche the tatha Giriak ki pahadi par mile stambhon jaise the; kuch stambh khandaharon se bahar nikal kar khade the tatha kuch unke upar pade the. Exam point: Narawat me eenton ke dheron tatha khandit murtiyon ke saath granit ke kai stambh mile, jo bahut kacche the tatha Giriak ki pahadi ke stambhon jaise the; sabse bada dher karib das bigah me faila tatha lagbhag chaukor tha.

qe: On the most considerable brick heap at Narawat, about fifty or sixty years before the survey, a barber was killed by a tiger and his ghost became the terror of the neighbourhood; what was done to appease it?
qh: नरावत के सबसे बड़े ईंटों के ढेर पर, सर्वेक्षण से करीब पचास-साठ वर्ष पूर्व, एक नाई को बाघ ने मार डाला था और उसका भूत आसपास के इलाक़े का आतंक बन गया; उसे शांत करने के लिए क्या किया गया?
oe: A small temple was built to his memory
A fair began to be held every year
A stone pillar was set up with an inscription
The heap was levelled and ploughed
oh: उसकी स्मृति में एक छोटा मंदिर बनाया गया
अभिलेख वाला पत्थर का स्तंभ लगाया गया
ढेर को समतल करके जोत दिया गया
e: Narawat ke sabse bade eenton ke dher par, sarvekshan se karib pachaas-saath saal pehle, ek nai ko bagh ne maar diya tha; uske baad uska bhoot aas-paas ke ilaqe ke liye aatank ban gaya. Jab logon ne is bhoot ko shant karne ka upay socha, to uski smriti me ek chhota mandir banaya gaya. Us mandir me ek Buddh ki nichli aadhi murti rakhi gayi tatha darwaza ek purane ghise hue lintel yaani darwaze ke upari patthar par tikka hua tha; us lintel par ek baithi hui murti ke dono or devdooton jaisi aakritiyan bani thin, jo Mongeer yaani Munger me mili aakritiyon jaisi thin. Mandir ke paas ek stambh bahar nikal kar khada tha tatha chaar Shiv linge bhi rakhe the, jo haal hi me banaye gaye the, lekin kaha jaata tha ki ve isi sthal par mile the; thodi door do aur stambh bhi bahar nikalte the. Exam point: Narawat ke bade eenton ke dher par bagh se mare nai ke bhoot ko shant karne ke liye uski smriti me ek chhota mandir banaya gaya; usme ek Buddh ki nichli aadhi murti tatha Munger jaisi aakritiyon wala purana lintel rakha gaya.

qe: Near the present village at Narawat were standing two granite pillars with several long stones lying near them, together with which images?
qh: नरावत के वर्तमान गाँव के पास दो ग्रेनाइट स्तंभ खड़े थे तथा उनके निकट कई लंबे पत्थर पड़े थे, इनके साथ कौन-सी मूर्तियाँ थीं?
oe: A Buddha with five disciples and a lion capital
A large Linga, three Gauri Sankars with very high diadems, two fragments of Vasudeva, a Navagraha and a Dasavatar
A Ganesa and a Saraswati with a vina
oh: पाँच शिष्यों तथा सिंह-शीर्ष वाले एक बुद्ध
एक बड़ा लिंग, बहुत ऊँचे मुकुटों वाली तीन गौरी-शंकर, वसुदेव के दो टुकड़े, एक नवग्रह तथा एक दशावतार
एक गणेश तथा वीणा लिए एक सरस्वती
e: Narawat ke vartaman gaon ke paas do granit stambh khade the tatha unke paas kai lambe patthar pade the, jahan kai murtiyan bhi thin - ek bada ling yaani Shiv ka prateek, bahut oonche mukuton wali teen Gauri-Sankar murtiyan, Vasudeva ke do tukde, ek Navagraha yaani nau grahon ka patt tatha ek Dasavatar. Vaise murtiyan adhiktar khandit thin. Yin murtiyon ke adhyayan se vivran-karta ne yah bhi bataya ki kisi ek patthar ke tukde par do Jain murtiyan tatha ek Buddh ki murti bani thi; Jain murtiyon ki pehchan unke haath god me cross hone se hoti hai, jabki Buddh ke haath pranam ki mudra me jude hote hain. Isi vishay par Ramajani ne yah bhi kaha ki is pehchan par poora bharosa nahi kiya ja sakta, kyunki Nepal ke kai Buddh murtiyon me bhi dono haath god me cross hote hain. Exam point: Narawat ke paas do granit stambhon ke saath ek bada ling, oonche mukuton wali teen Gauri-Sankar, Vasudeva ke do tukde, Navagraha tatha Dasavatar ki murtiyan thin; Jain tatha Buddh murtiyon ki pehchan haath ki mudra se ki jaati thi, jinpar poora bharosa nahi kiya ja sakta.

qe: Near Narawat, under a tree, lay a fragment of a small Gauri Sankar, while the Goyalas who form the chief population worship under the name of Goraiya objects carved on one stone; what were these?
qh: नरावत के पास एक पेड़ के नीचे एक छोटी गौरी-शंकर का टुकड़ा पड़ा था, जबकि मुख्य आबादी बनाने वाले गोयाले 'गोरैया' नाम से जिनकी पूजा करते थे, वे एक पत्थर पर उत्कीर्ण क्या थे?
oe: A row of nine planetary deities
Four Jains with their hands crossed on their laps
oh: गोद में हाथ रखे चार जैन
e: Narawat ke paas ek ped ke niche ek chhoti Gauri Sankar murti ka tukda bahut hi upekshit halat me pada tha, jise koi vishesh mahatva nahi diya ja raha tha. Us kshetra ki mukhya aabadi Goyala yaani maalik kaha jaane wale log thin, jo Goraiya naam se ek vishesh puja karte the; unki is puja me ek patthar ka vishesh mahatva tha, jis par god me cross kiye hue haath wale chaar Jain utkirn the. Us patthar ke bare me anuman tha ki yah pehle kisi darwaze ka upari patthar yaani lintel tha tatha us par isi tarah ki aur bhi murtiyan rahi hongi. Uske ek sire par ek thos mandir bana hua tha, jo Bauddhon ke mandiron jaisa hota hai, Jain mandiron jaisa nahi; isse vivran-karta ke is mat ki pushti hoti hai ki us patthar ki murtiyan Bauddh parampara ki hain. Us kshetra ke bare me kaha jaata tha ki purane samay me yahan Kol logon ka rajya tha, jo pashchim me Son nadi tak faila hua tha, jiske aage Cheru logon ka ilaqa shuru hota tha; aaj ke zyadatar nivasi Goyak the. Exam point: Narawat ke paas Goyala logon ki Goraiya puja me ek patthar ka vishesh sthan tha, jis par god me cross kiye haath wale chaar Jain utkirn the; uske ek sire par Bauddhon jaisa thos mandir bana tha, jisse vivran-karta ne ise Bauddh parampara ka maana.

qe: Which mosque of Patna was built in 1629-30 by the governor Saif Khan, husband of Malik Banu, a sister of the famous Mumtaz Mahal?
qh: पटना की कौन-सी मस्जिद 1629-30 में गवर्नर सैफ खान द्वारा बनवाई गई थी, जो मशहूर मुमताज महल की बहन मलिक बानू के पति थे?
e: Chimni Ghat se thoda niche purb ki or Madrasa Mosque sthit hai, jo A.H. 1039 yaani 1629-30 A.D. me governor Saif Khan ne banwayi thi. A.H. yaani hijri san, Islami chandravarshiya calendar ka san hai. Saif Khan Malik Banu ke pati the, jo mashhoor Mumtaz Mahal ki behen thin. Is masjid ke saath pehle ek madrasa bhi juda hua tha, jo ab maujood nahi hai; lekin jo avshesh bache hain, woh is baat ki gawahi dete hain ki iska mool design kitna bhavya tha. Madrasa yaani woh sthan jahan Islami dharm granthon ki shiksha di jaati hai. Yah masjid Patna ke un purane dharmik dhanchon me se hai, jo Ganga ke kinare ki shahar-kataar me bane. Exam point: Madrasa Mosque A.H. 1039 (1629-30 A.D.) me governor Saif Khan ne banwayi thi, jo Mumtaz Mahal ki behen Malik Banu ke pati the; iske saath juda madrasa ab maujood nahi hai.

qe: The great mosque near Pir Damaria's tomb at Patna was supported by altamgha grants dating back over three hundred years; altamgha grants were permanent grants made by whom?
qh: पटना में पीर दमड़िया की मजार के पास स्थित बड़ी मस्जिद तीन सौ साल से भी पुराने अल्तमगा अनुदानों पर चलती थी; अल्तमगा अनुदान स्थायी अनुदान थे, जो किसके द्वारा दिए जाते थे?
e: Patna ke Ganga-tat par Danish Factory se sau gaz niche Pir Damaria ki mazar hai tatha uske paas ek bada masjid hai. Is masjid ka kharch altamgha grants se chalta tha, jo teen sau saal se bhi purane the. Altamgha grant yaani Mughal badshah dwaara mahaan muhar lagakar diya gaya sthayi yaani permanent grant; aise grants pradesh ke governoron dwaara diye gaye kharid jama grants se alag maane jaate the. In grants ka ullekh malguzari-mukt dawaon ki jaanch ke samay bhi milta hai, jab bade-bade kshetra aise grants ke naam par dava kiye gaye the. Usi nadi-kinare kshetra me aage Kadam Rasul masjid hai, jise 17vin sadi ke aarambh me banwaya gaya tha. Exam point: Pir Damaria ki mazar ke paas wali badi masjid teen sau saal se purane altamgha grants par chalti thi, jo Mughal badshah dwaara mahaan muhar lagakar diye gaye sthayi grants the.

qe: The Kadam Rasul mosque, founded at the beginning of the seventeenth century, stands below which tomb on the river-front of Patna?
qh: सत्रहवीं सदी के आरंभ में बनी कदम रसूल मस्जिद पटना के नदी-तट पर किस मजार के नीचे स्थित है?
e: Patna ke nadi-tat par masjidon ki ek lambi shrinkhla hai. Danish Factory se sau gaz niche Pir Damaria ki mazar tatha ek badi masjid hai, jise purane altamgha grants ka sahara tha. Uske niche Kadam Rasul masjid hai, jise 17vin sadi ke shuruwat me banwaya gaya tha. Kadam Rasul ka matlab hai paigambar ke qadam ki nishani, isliye aisi masjidon me unke qadam ke nishan ka ehtram kiya jaata hai. Isi tarah Patna me Mirza Masum masjid, Pathar ki Masjid tatha Makhdum-ud-daula ki masjid bhi sthit hain, jo alag-alag dauron me bani tatha shahar ke dharmik jeevan ka hissa rahin. Exam point: Kadam Rasul masjid, jo 17vin sadi ke aarambh me banwayi gayi thi, Pir Damaria ki mazar wali badi masjid ke niche nadi-tat par sthit hai tatha iska naam paigambar ke qadam ki nishani se juda hai.

qe: Mirza Masum's mosque at Patna, built in the reign of Jahangir in 1025 A.H. (about 1616 A.D.), has its steps and gateway made of finely carved stone of which colour, evidently taken from some older building?
qh: पटना में मिर्ज़ा मासूम की मस्जिद, जो जहाँगीर के शासनकाल में 1025 हिजरी (लगभग 1616 ई.) में बनी, उसकी सीढ़ियाँ तथा प्रवेश-द्वार किस रंग के सुंदर तराशे पत्थर के बने हैं, जो स्पष्टतः किसी पुराने भवन से लिए गए हैं?
e: Pachhim Darwaza se shahar me pravesh karne par mukhya sadak ke dakshin kinare, Khan Bahadur Saiyid Muhammad Ismail ke ghar se lagti hui Mirza Masum ki masjid hai. Yah masjid Jahangir ke raaj ke 1025 hijri yaani lagbhag 1616 A.D. me bani thi tatha aaj bhi achhi halat me surakshit hai. A.H. yaani hijri san, Islami chandravarshiya calendar ka san hai. Is masjid ke aangan me jaane wali seedhiyan tatha pradvesh-dwaar ek bahut hi sundar tarashe hue kaale basalt patthar ke bane hain, jo saaf taur par kisi purane bhavan se liye gaye hain. Basalt ek kala, kathor agni-shila patthar hai. Purane bhavan ka saamaan naye dhanchon me lagana us daur me aam baat thi. Exam point: Mirza Masum ki masjid 1025 hijri (lagbhag 1616 A.D.) me Jahangir ke raaj me bani, jiske aangan ki seedhiyan tatha dwaar sundar tarashe hue kaale basalt patthar ke bane hain, jo kisi purane bhavan se liye gaye the.

qe: An inscription on the eastern face of the Stone Mosque (Pathar ki Masjid) at Patna records that it was built from the stone and wood of a fort and temple dismantled at which place?
qh: पटना की पत्थर की मस्जिद के पूर्वी भाग पर लगे एक अभिलेख के अनुसार वह किस स्थान पर ढाए गए किले तथा मंदिर के पत्थर और लकड़ी से बनाई गई थी?
e: Ganga ke kinare par sthit Pathar ki Masjid ko Jahangir ke putra Prince Parvez Shah ne banwaya tha. Sadak par is masjid se thoda aage jaane par iske purb wale chehre par ek abhilekh milta hai, jisme likha hai ki yah masjid Majhauli me dhahaye gaye ek kila tatha mandir ke patthar aur lakdi se banayi gayi thi. Abhilekh yaani patthar ya dhatu par khudi hui likhai, jo kisi nirman ya ghatna ka record rakhti hai. Is prakar ek dhwast dhanche ke malbe se banayi gayi yah masjid us daur ki rajniti ka bhi parichay deti hai, jab vijeta apni shakti dikhane ke liye haraaye gaye sthanon ki imaraton ka saamaan naye bhavan me lagata tha. Masjid ke thoda aage Duchess of Teck Hospital tatha Bhawani Puri ka math sthit hai. Exam point: Pathar ki Masjid ke purbi chehre ke abhilekh ke mutabik yah masjid Majhauli me dhahaye gaye kila tatha mandir ke patthar aur lakdi se banayi gayi thi.

qe: In a lane running south from the main road at Patna is the Vaishnavite monastery of Bhawani Puri; south of it are the remains of a large Buddhist stupa, now converted into what?
qh: पटना की मुख्य सड़क से दक्षिण जाने वाली एक गली में भवानी पुरी का वैष्णव मठ है; उसके दक्षिण में एक बड़े बौद्ध स्तूप के अवशेष हैं, जिन्हें अब किस रूप में बदल दिया गया है?
e: Mukhya sadak se dakshin ki or jaane wali ek gali me Bhawani Puri ka math hai, jo Vaishnav sampraday ka ek mandir-numa ashram hota hai. Is math ke dakshin me ek bade Buddhist stupa ke avshesh hain. Stupa yaani Buddh dharm ka woh gol dhancha, jisme dhatu ya smriti-chinh rakhe jaate hain tatha jiski parikrama ki jaati hai. Ab yah avshesh ek Muhammadan qabristan me badal diya gaya hai. Isse pata chalta hai ki Patna me vibhinn dharmon ki imaratein ek hi sthan par kaise badalti rahin - pehle Buddh dharm ka bada dhancha, phir usi jagah par Musalman samaj ka qabristan. Isi kshetra me Pathar ki Masjid, Duchess of Teck Hospital tatha purani afim factory ki lambi deewar bhi hai. Exam point: Bhawani Puri ke math ke dakshin me ek bade Buddhist stupa ke avshesh hain, jinhe ab Muhammadan qabristan me badal diya gaya hai, jo Patna me dharmik dhanchon ke badlav ka udaharan hai.

qe: The Padri ki Haveli at Patna, standing on the site of an older church built in 1713, was designed in 1772 by which well-known architect?
qh: पटना की पादरी की हवेली, जो 1713 में बने एक पुराने चर्च के स्थान पर खड़ी है, 1772 में किस प्रसिद्ध वास्तुकार द्वारा डिज़ाइन की गई थी?
e: Padri ki Haveli ke naam se mashhoor purana Roman Catholic church, jise Blessed Virgin Mary ka church kaha jaata hai, mukhya sadak se thoda aage uttar ki or sthit hai. Yah ek purane church ke sthan par bana hai, jo 1713 me banaya gaya tha tatha 25 June 1763 ke upadravon me nast ho gaya, jab Ellis ne shahar par kabza kiya tatha use kho diya. Naye bhavan ko 1772 me mashhoor architect Tiretto ne design kiya tha; iska Ionian facade yaani prachin Greek shaili ke stambhon wala saamne ka bhag iski bada-khoobi hai tatha aaj bhi dekhne layak hai. Is church ka bada ghanta 1782 me Nepal ke Raja Prithwi Narain ke putra Bahadur Sah ne bheint kiya tha. Exam point: 1713 me bane purane church ke sthan par khadi Padri ki Haveli ko 1772 me Tiretto naam ke mashhoor architect ne design kiya tha tatha iska Ionian facade prasiddh hai; iska bada ghanta 1782 me Nepal se bheint hua tha.

qe: The site of the Patna massacre of 1763 was the house and compound of which brother of Alivardi Khan and father of Zainuddin?
qh: 1763 के पटना हत्याकांड का स्थल अलीवर्दी खान के किस भाई तथा ज़ैनुद्दीन के पिता का घर और आँगन था?
e: Patna ke Charitable Dispensary tatha Patna qabristan ke do compound us ghar tatha aangan ke sthan par hain, jo Haji Ahmad ka tha. Haji Ahmad Alivardi Khan ke bhai tatha Zainuddin ke pita the. Yahi 1763 ke Patna hatyakand ka sthal tha, jisme angrezi kaidiyon ko jaan se maara gaya. Patna ke dobara kabze ke baad Haji Ahmad ka ghar apne kabze me liya gaya tatha gira diya gaya; uske sthan par European qabristan banaya gaya tatha us kuve par ek smarak-stambh yaani memorial obelisk khada kiya gaya, jisme hatyakand ke shikaron ko fenka gaya tha. Vartaman obelisk 1880 me bana, us obelisk ke badle jo Captain Watson ki nigrani me 1765 me banaya gaya tha. Isi qabristan me Captain Kinloch ki bhi qabr hai, jinhone 1767 me Nepal ki muhim ka netritva kiya tha. Exam point: Patna hatyakand ka sthal Haji Ahmad ka ghar tha, jo Alivardi Khan ke bhai tatha Zainuddin ke pita the; uske sthan par European qabristan tatha kuve par obelisk banaya gaya, jiska vartaman roop 1880 ka hai.

qe: In the Sikh temple at Patna, built at the spot where Guru Govind Singh was born, a beautifully embroidered copy of the holy book of the Sikhs is said to have been presented by whom?
qh: पटना के उस सिख मंदिर में, जो गुरु गोविंद सिंह के जन्म-स्थल पर बना है, सिखों के पवित्र ग्रंथ की सुंदर कढ़ाई वाली प्रति किसके द्वारा भेंट की गई मानी जाती है?
e: Harmandir Lane me sthit Sikh mandir Patna ke sabse pavitra sthanon me se ek hai; yah us sthan par bana hai, jahan Guru Govind Singh ka janm hua tha. Yahan Guru ka jhula, joote, talwarein tatha teer rakhe hue hain. Isi mandir me Sikhon ke pavitra granth ki ek bahut hi sundar kadhai ki hui copy bhi surakshit hai, jise Guru Govind Singh ne khud is mandir ko bheint kiya maana jaata hai. Kadhai yaani kapde par dhaage se ki gayi kala, jo yahan dharmik granth ki copy par ki gayi hai. Patna ka yah takht Sikh dharm ke paanch pramukh takhton me shamil hai tatha yah purane mohallon me sthit hai, jahan Guru ke baalak-kal ki smritiyan jude hue hain. Exam point: Patna ke Sikh mandir me Sikhon ke pavitra granth ki kadhai ki hui copy hai, jise Guru Govind Singh ne khud mandir ko bheint kiya maana jaata hai; yahan unka jhula, joote, talwarein tatha teer bhi rakhe hue hain.

qe: The mosque of Makhdum-ud-daula, a Governor of Patna, originally had five hemispherical domes; how many of them exist now?
qh: पटना के एक गवर्नर मखदूम-उद-दौला की मस्जिद पर मूल रूप से पाँच अर्धगोलाकार गुंबद थे; अब इनमें से कितने बचे हैं?
e: Patna ki mukhya sadak par Allauddin Shah ki masjid se do sau gaz aage Makhdum-ud-daula ki masjid hai, jo Patna ke governor the. Gunbad yaani masjid ke upar bana aadha-gol chhat wala dhancha, jise hemispherical dome kaha jaata hai. Is masjid ke baare me ek dilchasp baat likhi milti hai - mool roop me is masjid par paanch gol gunbad the, lekin ab inme se sirf teen hi bache hain. Isi tarah Patna ki sadak par bane anya purane bhavan bhi dikhate hain ki samay ke saath kitni imaratein khatm ho gayin tatha kitni badal gayin. Unnisvin sadi ke ant tatha beesvin sadi ke shuru me bane kaun-kaun se dhanche aaj bhi khade hain, yah shahar ke itihas ko samajhne ka ek mahatvapurna sadhan hai. Exam point: Makhdum-ud-daula ki masjid par mool roop me paanch gunbad the, jinme se ab sirf teen bache hain; yah masjid Allauddin Shah ki 1499 wali masjid se do sau gaz aage sthit hai.

qe: The Patna Museum, established in 1915, was first housed in the northern annexe of which building?
qh: 1915 में स्थापित पटना संग्रहालय पहले किस इमारत के उत्तरी एनेक्सी में रखा गया था?
e: Patna Museum 1915 me sthapit hua tatha uski shuruwati jagah nayi rajdhani ke High Court yaani ucch nyayalay ki imarat ka uttari hissa yaani northern annexe thi. Sangrahalay yaani museum woh jagah hoti hai, jahan purane avshesh, moortiyan, sikke tatha abhilekh sambhal kar rakhe jaate hain tatha aam janta unhe dekh sakti hai. Yahan puraatatvik mahatva ki kai cheezein rakhi gayi thin - Didarganj ki moorti, halki-patli mitti se bane avshesh jinme Patna ki wo mitti ki moorti bhi shamil hai, Bodh-Gaya mandir ka chitra dikhane wali votive plate jispar Kharoshthi lipi ka abhilekh hai, kaanch ke mohar, ek achhi mudrika tatha Bulandibagh se mila rath-chakra. Iske alawa Basarh ke utkhanan se mile purane avshesh tatha Orissa ke Bhanja rajaon ke tamrapatra bhi yahan rakhe gaye; sikke wale bhaag me purane sikkon ka achha sangrah tatha bhootatva bhaag me Bihar tatha Orissa ki chattanon tatha khanijon ka sangrah tha. Exam point: Patna Museum 1915 me High Court ki imarat ke northern annexe me sthapit hua; yahan Didarganj ki moorti, rath-chakra tatha Bhanja rajaon ke tamrapatra jaise sangrah rakhe gaye.

qe: The Anglican church of the Holy Saviour stands at the far corner of the maidan on the north of the road at Bankipore; in which year was it built?
qh: बांकीपुर में मैदान के दूर वाले कोने पर मार्ग के उत्तर में एंग्लिकन गिरजाघर होली सेवियर स्थित है; यह किस वर्ष बनाया गया था?
e: Bankipore ke civil station ka roop bade maidan se aur sunder lagta hai. Us maidan ke uttari-purbi kone me Anglican church of the Holy Saviour sthit hai, jise 1857 me banaya gaya. Anglican church un girja-gharon ko kehte hain jo England ke church ki parampara se jude hain; girja-ghar Isai dharm ke upasana-sthal hote hain. Yah saal 1857 isliye bhi mahatvapurna hai ki usi saal desh me bade badlav ki shuruwat hui; Patna me bhi us saal kai ghatnayein hui. Rasta aage badhte hue sookh chuki Barkerganj nala ko cross karta hai, jahan purani sainik mandi yaani military bazar thi. Iske baad marg mukhya city street ban jaata hai. Is kshetra ke aas-paas purani brigade ki chhawniyon ke avshesh tatha Henry Douglas ke lagwaye purane pedon ki kataar bhi milti hai, isliye yah poora ilaka Bankipore ke puraane roop ki yaad dilata hai. Exam point: Bankipore ke maidan ke uttari-purbi kone me sthit Anglican church of the Holy Saviour 1857 me bana; iske aage sookha hua Barkerganj nala padta hai tatha marg aage chalkar mukhya city street ban jaata hai.

qe: The fort of Bihar stands on a natural plateau and was surrounded by a great moat of what width, which has long since been brought under cultivation?
qh: बिहार का किला एक प्राकृतिक पठार पर स्थित है तथा उसके चारों ओर कितनी चौड़ी बड़ी खाई थी, जिसे बहुत पहले खेती के अधीन कर लिया गया?
oe: About four hundred to six hundred feet
About a hundred to a hundred and fifty feet
oh: लगभग चार सौ से छह सौ फुट
लगभग सौ से डेढ़ सौ फुट
e: Bihar nagar ki pyari virasat me uska purana kila shamil hai. Kila aaj khandaar halat me hai, lekin uski deewaron tatha prachiron ke nishan abhi bhi bache hain. Yah kila ek qudrati pathaar par bana hai, jo aas-paas ki zameen se kaafi uncha hai tatha lagbhag teen sau barah acre me faila hai. Iska aakaar ek bade aniyamit pentagon yaani panchbhuj jaisa hai - uttar se dakshin tak aatthai sau foot tatha purb se pashchim tak ekkees sau foot. Kile ke chaaron or ek bahut moti deewar thi, jiski motai atharah se bees foot tatha unchai pacchis se tees foot thi; yah deewar aas-paas ki pahadi se kaate gaye bahut bade pattharon se bani thi. Deewar ke saath gol burj the tatha uttari darwaza uncha minaron se ghira tha. Poore sthal ke chaaron or ek badi khai thi, jiski chaurai chaar sau se chhah sau foot thi; yah khai bahut pehle hi khudai kar li gayi tatha kheton me badal di gayi. Exam point: Bihar ka kila lagbhag 312 acre ke qudrati pathaar par bana hai tatha uska aakaar aniyamit pentagon jaisa hai; uski deewar 18 se 20 foot moti tatha 25 se 30 foot unchi thi tatha khai 400 se 600 foot chaudi thi, jo ab kheton me badal chuki hai.

qe: The dargah of Kadir Kumaish stands in the centre of the fort of Bihar; the modern tomb is composed almost entirely of the remains of what ancient building?
qh: कादिर कुमैश की दरगाह बिहार के किले के मध्य में स्थित है; यह आधुनिक मजार लगभग पूरी तरह किस प्राचीन इमारत के अवशेषों से बनी है?
oe: The great vihara or Buddhist monastery
A Hindu temple of the Gupta period
The palace of a Pala king
e: Bihar ke kila ke andar kai teele hain, jo purani imaraton ke sthal dikhate hain. Kila ke kendra me Kadir Kumaish ki dargah hai; yah dargah aadhunik hai, lekin bani hui lagbhag poori tarah purane vihar yaani Bauddh math ke avsheshon se hai. Dargah ka farsh purane chaitya tatha stambhon se bana hai, yaani purani imarat ke tukde hi is nayi imarat me lag gaye. Is dargah ke muntazim yaani custodian in avsheshon ki bahut hifazat karte hain tatha un logon se fees lete hain jo daant dard ya nadiyon ke dard se aaram paane ki aasha me in pattharon ko chhoote hain. Kile ke uttar me Togani naam ke maidan me ek aur vihar ke chinh milte hain tatha uske thoda purb me Makhdum Shah Ahmed Charamposh ki dargah hai, jiske prachin darwaze ke baare me kaha jaata hai ki yah kila ke purane maha-vihar ka pravesh-dwar tha. Exam point: Bihar kila ke kendra me sthit Kadir Kumaish ki dargah aadhunik hai lekin lagbhag poori tarah purane Bauddh vihar ke avsheshon se bani hai; uska farsh purane chaitya tatha stambhon ka hai tatha custodian log inhe chhoone ki fees lete hain.

qe: The Jama Masjid at Bihar was built in the time of Akbar by which officer, the vakil of Said Khan, Governor of Bihar from 1595 to 1601?
qh: बिहार की जामा मस्जिद अकबर के समय में किस अधिकारी ने बनवाई, जो 1595 से 1601 तक बिहार के गवर्नर सैयद खाँ के वकील थे?
e: Bihar nagar me kai mahatvapurna masjidain bani. Jama Masjid Akbar ke samay me banai gayi; us samay Bihar ke governor Said Khan the, jo 1595 se 1601 tak is pad par rahe. Jama Masjid ke nirman ka shrey unke vakil Ikhtiyar Khan ko diya jaata hai, jo Said Khan ke neeche kaam karne wale adhikari the. Iske alawa Habib Khan ki masjid bhi yahan hai, jo Sur khandan ke Afghan the tatha jinki masjid 1637 me banwayi gayi; unki masjid lagbhag poori tarah Bauddh samagri se banai gayi thi, yaani usme purane Bauddh vihar tatha stupon ke patthar tatha eentein lagai gayi thin. Aise nirman dikhate hain ki madhyakaleen Bihar me purani Bauddh imaraton ka maal nayi imarat banane me khul kar istemal hota tha. Exam point: Bihar ki Jama Masjid Akbar ke samay me governor Said Khan (1595-1601) ke vakil Ikhtiyar Khan ne banwayi tatha Habib Khan, jo Sur khandan ke Afghan the, ki masjid 1637 me lagbhag poori tarah Bauddh samagri se banai gayi.

qe: Two tombstones with inscriptions in the Armenian character stood outside the northern gate of the old fort at Bihar; in which year were they taken to the Indian Museum, and what dates did they bear?
qh: बिहार के पुराने किले के उत्तरी द्वार के बाहर आर्मेनियन लिपि में शिलालेख वाली दो कब्रगाहें थीं; वे किस वर्ष भारतीय संग्रहालय ले जाई गईं तथा उन पर कौन-सी तिथियाँ अंकित थीं?
e: Bihar me unnisvin sadi ke aakhir tatha beesvin sadi ke shuru me purani imaraton par kaam hua. Purane kila ke uttari darwaze ke bahar kuch Isai kabrein thin; inme se do pattharon par Armenian lipi me shilalekh the. Armenian ek prachin bhasha tatha lipi hai, jise Armenia desh ke log istemal karte the; aise shilalekh dikhate hain ki Bihar me alag-alag deshon ke vyapari tatha yatri aa kar base the. In dono pattharon ko 1891 me Indian Museum yaani Bharatiya Sangrahalay le jaaya gaya. Wahan ki jaanch se pata chala ki in par 1646 tatha 1693 ki tareekhein khudi hui thin. Bihar me ek bahut purani mazar bhi hai, jise Bihar ke sabse purane makbaron me gina jaata hai; us par 1336 saal ka shilalekh hai. Is tarah Bihar nagar ki kabrein tatha mazarein vibhinn samudayon ki upasthiti ki gawahi dete hain. Exam point: Bihar ke purane kila ke uttari darwaze ke bahar Armenian lipi wale do shilalekh 1891 me Indian Museum le jaaye gaye tatha unpar 1646 tatha 1693 ki tareekhein thi; Bihar ki sabse purani mazaron me ek par 1336 saal ka shilalekh milta hai.

qe: Bayley Sarai, the huge inn at Bihar containing two large blocks of buildings with spacious courtyards and an elaborately designed clock tower in front, is named after an officer who was Commissioner of Patna from 1872 to 1877; what was his full name?
qh: बिहार का विशाल सराय बेली सराय, जिसमें विशाल आंगनों वाले दो बड़े खंड तथा सामने एक भव्य घड़ी-मीनार है, उस अधिकारी के नाम पर है जो 1872 से 1877 तक पटना के आयुक्त थे; उनका पूरा नाम क्या था?
e: Bihar nagar ki sabse ullekhniya imaraton me ek vishal sarai hai, jo karib assi saal pehle banayi gayi thi tatha Bayley Sarai kahlati hai. Yah naam Sir Steuart Bayley ke naam par pada, jo Patna ke Commissioner 1872 se 1877 tak the tatha aage Bengal ke Lieutenant-Governor (1887 se 1890 tak) bane. Sarai me do bade bhavan-khand hain, jinke andar khule-chaure aangan hain; sarai ke saamne bahut hi sundar design wali ek ghadi-minar khadi hai. Aaj is imarat me dispensary yaani davakhana chal raha hai, isliye yah vyavsayik tatha sarvajanik kaam, dono ke liye istemal hoti rahi. Dhyan rahe ki Sir Charles Bayley Bihara tatha Orissa prant ke pehle Lieutenant-Governors me the tatha unhone Chajju Bagh house ko Government House ke roop me istemal kiya tha; dono naam milte-julte hain, lekin sarai Sir Steuart Bayley ke naam par hai. Exam point: Bihar ki Bayley Sarai Sir Steuart Bayley ke naam par hai, jo 1872 se 1877 tak Patna ke Commissioner the tatha aage Bengal ke Lieutenant-Governor (1887-90) bane; is sarai me do bade bhavan-khand, aangan tatha saamne ek ghadi-minar hai tatha aaj isme dispensary chal raha hai.

qe: Near the Cutchery railway station at Bihar is a curious structure, formerly a Muhammadan nobleman's summer house, which came to be called nauratan because it contained how many chambers?
qh: बिहार में कचहरी रेलवे स्टेशन के पास एक विचित्र इमारत है, जो पहले एक मुस्लिम अभिजात की ग्रीष्मकालीन कोठी थी तथा जिसे नौरतन कहा जाने लगा क्योंकि उसमें कितने कक्ष थे?
e: Bihar nagar me Cutchery railway station ke paas ek bahut hi rochak imarat hai. Yah pehle kisi Muhammadan amir yaani nobleman ki garmi ke mausam me rehne wali kothi thi tatha ise nauratan kaha jaata hai. Nauratan naam isi karan pada ki isme nau kamre yaani chambers the - ek beech me, ek har kone par tatha ek har kinare par. Is tarah se nau kamron ki vyavastha imarat ko vishesh banati hai. In kamron ki chhat eenton se bani hui mehrabdar hai tatha andar ki deewaron par picturebani ki gayi thi. Lekin chhat ki unchai kam hona tatha darwazon ka chhota hona imarat ke saamanya prabhav ko kam kar deta hai. Is tarah ke garmi-ghar un vaqt ke amir logon ke aaram tatha mehman-nawazi ke liye banaye jaate the tatha aaj yah imarat madhyakaleen nagar-vastukala ke ek anokhe namune ke roop me dekhi jaati hai. Exam point: Bihar me Cutchery railway station ke paas sthit nauratan naam ki imarat pehle ek Muhammadan amir ki garmi ke mausam wali kothi thi; isme nau kamre the - ek beech me, ek har kone par tatha ek har kinare par - tatha iski chhatain mehrabdar eenton ki thin.

qe: The Victoria Memorial Hall at Bihar, used as a reading room, was opened in which year?
qh: बिहार का विक्टोरिया मेमोरियल हॉल, जो वाचनालय के रूप में प्रयोग होता था, किस वर्ष खोला गया?
e: Bihar nagar me vibhinn sarvajanik upyog ki imaratein bhi bani. Inme Victoria Memorial Hall bhi shamil hai, jise 1903 me khola gaya. Yah hall ek reading room yaani vachanalay ke roop me istemal hota tha, jahan log akhbaar tatha alag-alag vishayon ki saamagri padh sakte the. Vachanalay aise sthal hote hain, jahan gramin tatha shahri logon ko sasta tatha saral tareeke se padhne tatha sabha-charcha karne ka mauka milta tha tatha nayi soch failane me inka bada yogdan hota tha. Isi nagar me ek bada sarai bhi bani, jise ek Commissioner ke naam par Bayley Sarai kaha gaya, tatha uske saamne ek ghadi-minar banaya gaya. Is tarah Bihar me padhai, vyapar tatha dharmik jeevan ke kendra saath-saath bante rahe tatha nagar ka samajik jeevan samriddh hota raha. Exam point: Bihar me Victoria Memorial Hall 1903 me khola gaya, jo ek vachanalay yaani reading room ke roop me istemal hota tha; isse padhne tatha sabha-charcha ki suvidha badhi tatha nagar ka sarvajanik jeevan samriddh hua.

qe: The Habib Khan mosque at Bihar, built in 1637, is specially notable because it was built almost entirely of what material?
qh: बिहार की 1637 में बनी हबीब खाँ की मस्जिद इस कारण विशेष रूप से उल्लेखनीय है कि वह लगभग पूरी तरह किस सामग्री से बनी थी?
oe: Burnt bricks of the Gupta period
e: Bihar nagar me kai masjidain tatha mazarein bani, jinke liye aas-paas ki purani imaraton ka maal istemal hua. Habib Khan, jo Sur khandan ke Afghan the, ne 1637 me ek masjid banwayi. Yah masjid lagbhag poori tarah Bauddh samagri se banai gayi thi, yaani uske nirman me purane Bauddh viharaon tatha stupon ke patthar tatha eenton ka istemal hua. Is kaaran se yah masjid madhyakaleen Bihar ke us tareeke ki gawah hai, jisme nayi imaratein banane ke liye purani khandaar imaraton ka maal kaam me liya jaata tha. Isi tarah kila ke bhitar Kadir Kumaish ki dargah bhi purane maha-vihar ke avsheshon se bani hui hai tatha uske farsh me purane chaitya tatha stambh lagaye gaye hain; isse pata chalta hai ki yah vyavastha keval ek jagah nahi, balki Bihar ke kai smarakon me dikhai deti hai. Exam point: Sur khandan ke Afghan Habib Khan ki 1637 ki masjid lagbhag poori tarah Bauddh samagri se bani thi, yaani usme purane Bauddh viharaon tatha stupon ke patthar tatha eentein lagai gayi thin; isi tarah Kadir Kumaish ki dargah bhi purane vihar ke avsheshon se bani hai.

qe: The small cave known as Gidhadwari near Giriak is 10 feet broad and 17 feet high at the mouth; popular belief holds that it communicates with Jarasandha's tower, but there is only a natural fissure running upwards for what distance?
qh: गिरियक के पास स्थित गिद्धद्वारी नामक छोटी गुफा मुँह पर 10 फुट चौड़ी तथा 17 फुट ऊँची है; लोक-विश्वास के अनुसार यह जरासंध की मीनार से जुड़ी है, परंतु वास्तव में ऊपर की ओर केवल एक प्राकृतिक दरार कितनी दूर तक जाती है?
e: Giriak ke pahadi kshetra me ek chhoti gufa hai, jise Gidhadwari kaha jaata hai. Rajgir ki do pahadi-shreniyon ko alag karne wali ghati ki or utarte hue yah gufa milti hai. Iska pravesh kuch bahut hi khadi chattanon ko phalang kar pahunchta hai; pravesh ke paas ek chhota chabutara hai, jiski lambai karib bees foot hai tatha jo purani chunai hui deewar par tika hua hai. Gufa khud mukhe par das foot chaudi tatha satrah foot unchi hai. Logon ka vishwas hai ki yah gufa Jarasandha ki minar se judi hui hai, lekin asal me yahan minar tak koi rasta nahi jaata; sirf ek qudrati darar yaani fissure upar ki or athatanve foot tak jaati hai. Yah gufa apne sthal tatha roop ke karan Hiuen Tsiang ke varnan wali us gufa se milti hai, jise Indra dwara Buddha se prashn poochne ka sthal bataya gaya tha, isliye yah sthal Bauddh itihas me mahatvapurna maana jaata hai. Exam point: Giriak ke paas sthit Gidhadwari gufa mukhe par 10 foot chaudi tatha 17 foot unchi hai; lok-vishwas ke mutabik yah Jarasandha ki minar se judi hai, lekin asal me sirf ek qudrati darar 98 foot tak upar jaati hai tatha yah gufa Hiuen Tsiang ke varnan wali gufa se milti hai.

qe: The dargah of Shah Juman Madari at Hilsa is a simple square brick building covered by one dome and containing how many tombs, of which the westernmost is said to be that of the saint?
qh: हिलसा में शाह जुमन मदारी की दरगाह एक साधारण वर्गाकार ईंट की इमारत है, जिस पर एक गुंबद है तथा जिसमें कितनी मजारें हैं, जिनमें सबसे पश्चिमी मजार संत की बताई जाती है?
e: Hilsa me Shah Juman Madari ki dargah door-door tak prasiddh hai. Yah imarat ek saadharan vargakar eenton ki bani hui hai tatha uspar ek hi gumbad hai. Is dargah ke andar saat mazarein hain, jinme sabse pashchimi mazar sant ki batayi jaati hai. Dargah ke darwaze par ek shilalekh laga hai, jisme likha hai ki Sher Shah ke samay Miran Saiyid Juman Madari ki mazar ki marammat karwayi gayi; yah kaam Mian Sheikh Alam naam ke ek aadmi ke kehne par hua tha tatha kharch Daria Khan Zangi uthaya tha, jo body-guard yaani rakhi-dal ka ek adhikari tha. Isse pata chalta hai ki asli imarat 1548 se purani hai, lekin bahut purani bhi nahi ho sakti, kyunki Madari silsile ke sansthapak Shah Madar, Jaunpur ke Ibrahim Shah ke samakalin bataye jaate hain, jinka shasan 1400 Isvi se shuru hua maana jaata hai. Exam point: Hilsa me Shah Juman Madari ki dargah ek saadharan vargakar eenton ki imarat hai, jispar ek gumbad hai tatha jisme saat mazarein hain; sabse pashchimi mazar sant ki maani jaati hai tatha darwaze ke shilalekh se pata chalta hai ki Sher Shah ke samay iski marammat karwayi gayi thi.

qe: Among the other remains at Giriak is an extensive round of ruins on the east side of the Panchana, with a small mud fort in the middle; how long is this round of ruins and how many paved ascents are there in all?
qh: गिरियक के अन्य अवशेषों में पंचाना के पूर्वी किनारे पर एक विस्तृत खंडहर-वलय है, जिसके बीच में एक छोटा मिट्टी का किला है; यह खंडहर-वलय कितना लंबा है तथा कुल कितने पक्के चढ़ाव हैं?
oe: Two miles long, with ten paved ascents
A quarter mile long, with two paved ascents
Half a mile long, with five paved ascents
One mile long, with three paved ascents
oh: दो मील लंबा, दस पक्के चढ़ाव
चौथाई मील लंबा, दो पक्के चढ़ाव
आधा मील लंबा, पाँच पक्के चढ़ाव
एक मील लंबा, तीन पक्के चढ़ाव
e: Giriak kshetr me Bauddh smarakon ke alava kai anya avshesh bhi mile hain. Panchana nadi ke purb kinare par ek vistrit khandaar-valay yaani round of ruins hai, jo lagbhag aadhe meel lamba hai tatha jiske beech me ek chhota mitti ka kila hai. Is kila ka matlab yah hai ki yahan kisi samay me suraksha ke liye eenton tatha mitti ki chhoti chauki bani thi. Is teele ki nadi wali taraf do pakke chadhav yaani paved ascents ke avshesh hain tatha teele ke doosri or aise teen aur chadhav the; is tarah kul milakar paanch pakke chadhav the, jinse log upar aate-jaate the. Aise chadhav tatha paved raste dikhate hain ki yahan bade puraatatvik sthalon ka ek jaal tha, jisme pahadi, nadi tatha math saath-saath jude hue the. Is kshetr ke avshesh aaj bhi yah batate hain ki Magadha kshetra me Bauddh tatha anya dharmik sansthaon ka kitna failav tha. Exam point: Giriak me Panchana ke purb kinare par lagbhag aadha meel lamba khandaar-valay hai, jiske beech me ek chhota mitti ka kila hai; nadi wali or do pakke chadhav tatha doosri or teen, is tarah kul paanch pakke chadhav ke avshesh yahan milte hain.

qe: A faithful illustration of the shrine of Shah Daulat at Maner, dating from about 1796, is found among the drawings of which artist?
qh: मनेर में शाह दौलत की दरगाह का लगभग 1796 का एक सुंदर तथा प्रामाणिक चित्र किस चित्रकार के चित्रों में मिलता है?
e: Maner me sthit Shah Daulat ki mazar apni banawat ke liye poori Bihar me mashhoor hai. Iski deewaron par bahut halki tatha saaf kaam ki naqashi hai, yah ek unche chabutare par khadi hai, iske kono par patle tatha sundar minar hain tatha upar ek bada gumbad hai; chhat par Quran ki aayatein khudi hui hain. Yah shaili Jahangir ke shasan-kaal ki vastukala ki visheshata batati hai, isliye is mazar ko Bengal kshetra me Mughalon ka sabse uttam smarak maana jaata hai. Thomas Daniell naam ke prasiddh chitrakar ne is dargah ka bahut hi sudar tatha sateek chitra banaya tha, jo lagbhag 1796 ka hai. Aise chitra un dino me deshi tatha videshi drishyon ko logon tak pahunchane tatha unhe sambhal kar rakhne ka pramukh zariya hote the, kyunki camera ki suvidha tab nahi thi. Exam point: Maner me Shah Daulat ki mazar par bani naqashi Jahangir ke daur ki vastukala ki visheshata batati hai tatha use Bengal kshetra ka sabse uttam Mughal smarak maana jaata hai; is dargah ka lagbhag 1796 ka sateek chitra Thomas Daniell ke chitron me milta hai.

qe: Pawapuri, a village in the Bihar subdivision three miles north of Giriak, is sacred to the Jains; the name is a corruption of which word, meaning the pure or sinless town?
qh: बिहार अनुमंडल में गिरियक से तीन मील उत्तर स्थित पावापुरी गाँव जैनों का पवित्र स्थल है; इसका नाम किस शब्द का अपभ्रंश है, जिसका अर्थ है पवित्र या पापरहित नगर?
e: Pawapuri Bihar subdivision me sthit ek gaon hai, jo Giriak se teen meel uttar me tatha Giriak se Bihar jaane wale raste ke purb me hai. Yah sthal Jain dharm ke logon ke liye bahut pavitra hai, kyunki kaha jaata hai ki yahin Jain dharm ke sansthapak Mahavira ka dehant hua. Ek doosri katha ke mutabik unka dehant Rajgir ki Vipulagiri pahadi par hua tha tatha unka shareer jalane ke liye yahan laaya gaya. Pawapuri naam asal me Apapapuri shabd ka apabhransh hai, jiska arth hai pavitra ya paap-rahit nagar; apabhransh ka arth hai kisi shabd ka badla hua roop, jo bolne me badal jaata hai. Is tarah naam se hi pata chalta hai ki is sthal ko prachin kal se paap se mukt teerth maana jaata raha hai, jahan shraddhalu apne paap dhone ke liye aate the. Exam point: Giriak se teen meel uttar sthit Pawapuri ka naam Apapapuri ka apabhransh hai, jiska arth hai pavitra ya paap-rahit nagar; yah sthal Jain dharm ke sansthapak Mahavira ke dehant tatha unke shareer ke dah-sanskar se juda hua hai.

qe: At Pawapuri, which temple stands on the spot where Mahavira died, the Jal-Mandar being the place of his cremation?
qh: पावापुरी में कौन-सा मंदिर उस स्थान पर स्थित है जहाँ महावीर का निधन हुआ था, जबकि जल-मंदिर उनके दाह-संस्कार का स्थान है?
e: Pawapuri gaon ek bade talab se thoda uttar me sthit hai. Talab ke theek beech me Jainon ka pavitra mandir Jal-Mandar khada hai. Yah talab har or se chauthai meel se thoda adhik chaura hai tatha iske uttar taraf ek pul hai, jo beech wale 104 foot chaukor tapu tak le jaata hai; is mandir ka bahari roop chaud deta hai tatha andar gehri andhkaar hoti hai, tatha pravesh ek itne neeche darwaze se hota hai ki dekhne wale ko jhuk kar andar jaana padta hai. Talab ke uttar me ek purana mandir hai, jise Thal-Mandar kaha jaata hai; pujariyon ke mutabik yah us sthal par bana hai, jahan Mahavira ka dehant hua, jabki Jal-Mandar unke dah-sanskar yaani shareer jalane ka sthal maana jaata hai. Kaha jaata hai ki tab yah talab maujood nahi thi; deh-sanskar ke samay itni badi bheed aayi ki har vyakti ne thodi mitti utaar kar maathe par tilak lagaya, tatha mitty ki isi utaar se ek bada gaddha bana, jo aage talab ke roop me bhar gaya. Exam point: Pawapuri me Mahavira ke dehant wale sthal par Thal-Mandar bana hai tatha unke dah-sanskar ka sthal Jal-Mandar hai, jo talab ke beech 104 foot chaukor tapu par sthit hai; talab us mitti se bani thi jo deh-sanskar me aayi bheed ne utaar li thi.

qe: At Pawapuri, between Thal-Mandar and the lake, a circular mound rises by four successive broad steps to a platform 82 feet in diameter, bearing a miniature temple only 3 feet 4 inches in diameter which contains what?
qh: पावापुरी में थल-मंदिर तथा तालाब के बीच एक वृत्ताकार टीला चार चौड़ी सीढ़ियों से ऊपर उठकर 82 फुट व्यास के चबूतरे तक जाता है, जिस पर केवल 3 फुट 4 इंच व्यास का छोटा मंदिर है, जिसमें क्या रखा है?
e: Pawapuri me Thal-Mandar tatha talab ke beech ek rochak vrittakar teela hai. Yah teela chaar chaudi seedhiyon ya charanon se uncha hota jaata hai tatha athasi foot vyas ke chabutare par pahunchta hai. Is chabutare par aath foot vyas ki ek chhoti vrittakar jagah hai, jispar ek bahut hi nanha mandir bana hai, jiska vyas keval teen foot chaar inch hai. Is nanhe mandir me Mahavira ke pad-chinh yaani footprints rakhe hue hain. Is poore nirman ko Samosaran kaha jaata hai. Kaha jaata hai ki yah woh sthal hai, jahan Mahavira apne shishyon ko updesh dene ke liye baithe the tatha unke shishya unke charon or ekagr-chitt ho kar ghere hue the. Samosaran ka arth hai woh sabha ya sansad, jahan dharm ki deshna di jaati thi. Aise sthal dikhate hain ki Jain parampara me teerthankar ke updesh dene wale sthal ko kitna pavitra maana jaata hai tatha unpar bane smarak bhakton ki shraddha ke kendra bane rehte hain. Exam point: Pawapuri me Thal-Mandar tatha talab ke beech wala vrittakar teela chaar seedhiyon se uncha hota hai tatha 82 foot vyas ke chabutare par 8 foot ki vrittakar jagah hai; uspar keval 3 foot 4 inch vyas wale nanhe mandir me Mahavira ke pad-chinh rakhe hain tatha ise Samosaran kaha jaata hai.

qe: At Pawapuri, as at all Jain places where no living thing is killed, numerous snakes are found all about the lake; how are the fish of the lake treated by man?
qh: पावापुरी में, जैसा कि सभी जैन स्थलों पर होता है जहाँ किसी जीव की हत्या नहीं की जाती, तालाब के चारों ओर बहुत से साँप रहते हैं; तालाब की मछलियों के साथ मनुष्य कैसा व्यवहार करते हैं?
oe: They are fed on grain by the pilgrims
They are caught for the temple kitchen
They are removed and left on the dry bank to die
They are not molested by man, and when they die their bodies are carefully brought ashore and buried
oh: मंदिर की रसोई के लिए उन्हें पकड़ा जाता है
उन्हें हटाकर सूखे किनारे पर मरने के लिए छोड़ दिया जाता है
मनुष्य उन्हें नहीं सताते, तथा मरने पर उनके शरीर सावधानी से किनारे लाकर दफना दिए जाते हैं
e: Pawapuri Jain dharm ka ek mahatvapurna teerth hai tatha Jain dharm ke niyam ke mutabik kisi bhi jeev ki hatya nahi ki jaati. Isi karan yahan talab ke aas-paas bahut se saanp rehte hain tatha unhe koi nuksan nahi pahunchaya jaata. Machhliyan ek doosre ko kha sakti hain, lekin manushya unhe nahi satata; jab machhliyan mar jaati hain, to unke shareer savdhani se kinare par la kar dafna diye jaate hain. Ahimsa yaani kisi jeev ko na maarna Jain dharm ka mool siddhant hai tatha iska asar sthal ki prakriti tatha jeev-jantuo par saaf dikhai deta hai. Isi tarah ke niyam-dharm se prachin kal me aise sthal jeev-jantuo ke liye surakshit ashray-sthal ban gaye, jahan unki sankhya badhi tatha woh nirbhay ho kar rehne lage. Exam point: Pawapuri me ahimsa ke siddhant ke karan talab ke aas-paas bahut se saanp rehte hain tatha machhliyon ko manushya nahi satata; machhliyon ke marne par unke shareer savdhani se kinare la kar dafna diye jaate hain.

qe: In the third or fourth building on the Nalanda site two structural caves of brick were erected with corbelled entrances and vaulted roofs, apparently in imitation of the rock-cut caves at which place, the work being pre-Muhammadan and one of the earliest arches in India?
qh: नालंदा स्थल की तीसरी या चौथी इमारत में ईंट की दो संरचनात्मक गुफाएँ बनाई गई थीं, जिनके प्रवेश-द्वार कोरबेल वाले तथा छतें मेहराबदार थीं, जो स्पष्टतः किस स्थान की चट्टान-कटित गुफाओं की नकल थीं, यह कार्य मुस्लिम-पूर्व काल का तथा भारत में सबसे प्राचीन मेहराबों में एक माना जाता है?
e: Nalanda ki khudai ke dauran pata chala ki samay ke saath math ki imaratein tooti tatha phir usi jagah nayi imaratein banti rahin. Khudai me saaf dikha ki ek purani imarat ke upar nayi chunai se samtal bana kar nayi imarat khadi ki gayi. Is tarah kaam karne se aangan ka star tatha bahari zameen ka star alag ho gaya, isliye ek bada seedhi wala raasta aangan tak jaane ke liye banaya gaya. Site ki teesri ya chauti imarat me eenton ki do aisi gufaayein bani thin, jinke pravesh-dwar mehrabdar yaani corbel style ke the tatha chhaten vault yaani mehrab jaisi odhi hui thin. Yah banawat Barabar sthit chattan-katit gufaon ki nakal lagti hai; Barabar ki gufaayein Bihar me Gaya ke paas sthit prachin shila-alekhon wali gufaayein hain. Khudai ke mutabik yah kaam Muhammadan ke aane se pehle ka hai tatha ise Bharat ke sabse purane mehrabon yaani arches me gina jaata hai. Baad ki imaraton me mandir ke mukhya dwar ke beech me chunai kar di gayi thi tatha uske dono or chhote darwaze chhod diye gaye the. Exam point: Nalanda site ki teesri ya chauti imarat me eenton se bani do gufaayein thi, jinke pravesh corbel style ke tatha chhaten vault wali thin; yah Barabar ki chattan-katit gufaon ki nakal lagti hain tatha yah Muhammadan-poorv kaam Bharat ke sabse purane mehrabon me gina jaata hai.

qe: A broken image found on the ground before entering Singhani differed from the image called Vasudeva or Narayan in having what?
qh: सिंघानी में प्रवेश करने से पहले ज़मीन पर मिली एक टूटी प्रतिमा वासुदेव या नारायण नाम की प्रतिमा से किस बात में भिन्न थी?
oe: A wheel carved on the palm of the hand
A lion throne below the feet
A seven-hooded serpent canopy over the head
Two small figures on each side in place of one
oh: हाथ की हथेली पर बना चक्र
सिर पर सात फनों वाला सर्प-छत्र
एक के स्थान पर दोनों ओर दो-दो छोटी आकृतियाँ
e: Singhani gaon ke paas zameen par kuchh tooti-phooti moortiyan mili thi. Unme se ek moorti Vasudeva ya Narayan naam ki moorti se ek khaas baat me alag thi. Vasudeva ya Narayan ki moorti me aam taur par devta ke dono aur ek-ek chhota aakriti hoti hai; is moorti me dono aur do-do chhoti aakritiyan thi. Baaki ek toota hua tukda kisi dev-moorti ka singhasan lagta tha, jiske upar ek baithi hui Buddha ki aakriti thi, jo ek khade do-bhuja purush ke sir par bani thi; yah tarah dikhati hai ki us samay Vaishnav aur Bauddh aakritiyon me mail-jol kaisa raha. Aise chhote-chhote chinh moorti-shilp ke bhi pata dete hain, aur yah bhi batate hain ki kis tarah ek hi sthal par alag-alag upasana-dharaon ki moortiyan banti rahin. Exam point: Singhani ke paas mili moorti Vasudeva ya Narayan se is baat me alag thi ki usme dono aur ek ke badle do-do chhoti aakritiyan thi.

qe: An image built into the wall of the reservoir at Rajgir showed both hands in the lap, lotus flowers on the soles of the feet and lions on the throne; what else did it carry?
qh: राजगीर के कुंड की दीवार में जड़ी एक प्रतिमा में दोनों हाथ गोद में, चरणों के तलवों पर कमल और सिंहासन पर सिंह थे; उस पर और क्या था?
oe: A wheel carved on the palm
e: Rajgir ke ek kund ki deewar me ek moorti jadi hui mili, jo Buddha ya Jain ki moorti maani gayi. Usme dono haath god me rakhe the, pairon ke talvon par kamal ke phool banaye the aur singhasan par sher ki aakritiyan thi; iske alava us par ek chhota abhilekh bhi tha. Abhilekh yaani stone par khuda hua likha, jo moorti ke daan tatha samay ke baare me jaankari deta hai. Aise chinh - god me haath, talvon par kamal aur singhasan par sher - aksar Buddha tatha Jain parampra ki moortiyon me milti hain, isliye bina abhilekh ke pakka karna mushkil hota hai ki moorti kis dharm ki hai. Inhi chinhon aur abhilekh se is kshetra me moortikala ka itihas samajhne me madad milti hai. Exam point: Us moorti par ek chhota abhilekh bhi khuda hua tha, jise dekh kar uski parampra tatha samay ka anuman lagaya jata hai.

qe: A carved octagonal stone lying at Rajgir, containing four images of Buddhas, belonged to an ornamental type said to be very common at which place?
qh: राजगीर में पड़ा एक अष्टकोणीय तराशा पत्थर, जिसमें बुद्ध की चार प्रतिमाएँ हैं, किस स्थान पर बहुत सामान्य बताई गई बनावट का है?
e: Rajgir me ek aise kund ke paas, jahan se sabse saaf aur tez dhaar wala jharana nikalta hai, do tarashi hui patthar ki cheezein padi mili. Ek Ganesa ki moorti thi aur doosri ek ashtkoniya yaani aath kone wali alankrit patthar, jisme Buddha ki char moortiyan bani thi. Aisi ashtkoniya alankaran-vastu us samay Bodh Gaya me bahut aam thi, jahan Mahabodhi ke aas-paas aise patthar lage hote the. Rajgir me is prakar ki cheezon ka milna dikhata hai ki Bodh Gaya ki kalashaili ka asar aas-paas ke kshetron par bhi pada, aur yeh vastu apne sthapatiyon tatha kala ke kendra se juda hua kshetra tha. Exam point: Ashtkoniy alankrit patthar, jisme Buddha ki char moortiyan thi, Bodh Gaya me bahut samanya banawat ka bataya gaya hai.

qe: A carved slope at Baiturmi ghat near Rajgir, apparently the throne of an image, carried rows of seated figures with hands in different positions; what did this show?
qh: राजगीर के पास बैतुरनी घाट पर तराशी हुई एक ढलान, जो संभवतः किसी प्रतिमा का सिंहासन थी, पर अलग-अलग मुद्राओं वाली बैठी आकृतियाँ बनी थीं; इससे क्या सिद्ध हुआ?
oe: Nothing about the sect could be decided from the position of the hands
All the figures belonged to the Jain faith
The figures were all images of the Buddha
The stone had served as a stupa drum
oh: हाथों की मुद्रा से किसी धार्मिक परंपरा का निर्णय नहीं किया जा सकता
सभी आकृतियाँ जैन परंपरा की थीं
सभी आकृतियाँ बुद्ध की प्रतिमाएँ थीं
वह पत्थर स्तूप का भाग था
e: Baiturmi naam ke ek chhote ghat par, jo us gol teele se thoda upar, pashchim ki taraf hai, patthar par tarashi hui ek dhalan padi mili; yah sambhavtah kisi badi moorti ka singhasan tha. Us par kai darren thi, jinme baithi hui aakritiyan bani thi - kisi ke haath upar uthaye hue the, kisi ke dono haath god me kisi bali ki vastu ke saath the, aur kisi ka ek haath ghutne par tha. Sravak logon ka kehna tha ki jinke dono haath god me hain woh devta hain aur baaki manushya, lekin aakritiyon ki mudrayen is vichar ka samarthan nahi karti thi. Isliye yah nateeja nikla ki sirf haath ke aakaron se kisi moorti ya moorti-samuh ki dharmik parampra tay nahi ki ja sakti. Exam point: Baiturmi ghat ki tarashi dhalan se yah siddh hua ki haathon ki mudra se moortiyon ki dharmik parampra tay nahi ki ja sakti.

qe: On a small conical mound near Rajgir stood a broken image with three heads and eight hands, holding serpents, and it was supposed to be the source of Jarasandha's power; by what name did the Brahmans call it?
qh: राजगीर के पास एक छोटे शंक्वाकार टीले पर बनी टूटी प्रतिमा के तीन सिर और आठ हाथ थे, जिसमें सर्प थे और जिसे जरासंध की शक्ति का स्रोत माना जाता था; ब्राह्मण उसे क्या कहते थे?
e: Rajgir ke paas, jharna do dhaaron me batne wali jagah ke beech, mitti aur pattharon ka ek chhota shankvakar teela hai. Us par ek chhota aadhunik mandir hai, lekin uske neeche ek purane aur thode bade mandir ke chinh bhi milte hain. Yahan ki tooti hui moorti, jo ek chhote patthar par tarashi hui hai, teen siron aur aath haathon wali hai, kavach pehne hue hai, aur uske haathon me do sarp, vinash ke kai hathiyar tatha ek manushya ka sir hai. Ise dekhne wale ne purush mana aur kaha ki yah Elephanta ki gufao ke mukhya pratima jaisi hai; lekin yahan ke Brahmanon ne ise stri maan kar Jamdevi kaha, aur manyata thi ki Jarasandha ki saari shakti isi ki pooja se aayi thi. Exam point: Rajgir ke paas mili teen-sir-aath-hath wali tooti moorti ko Brahman Jamdevi kehte the, aur Jarasandha ki shakti ka srot isi ki pooja ko mana jata tha.

qe: Inside the Sonbhandar cave at Rajgir a small quadrangular pyramidal mass of rock was left in the middle, on each side of which is carved what?
qh: राजगीर की सोनभंडार गुफा के बीच में चट्टान का एक छोटा चौकोर पिरामिड-जैसा भाग छोड़ा गया है, जिसके हर ओर क्या तराशा गया है?
oe: An erect man with two arms
oh: खड़ा हुआ दो भुजाओं वाला पुरुष
e: Sonbhandar gufa ke bhitar, beech me, chattan ka ek chhota chaukor piramid jaisa hissa chhod diya gaya hai, jiske har ek or ek khada hua do bhujaon wala purush tarasha gaya hai. Mukhya aakriti charon or ek hi hai, lekin har or uske saath alag-alag chinh bhi bane hue hain. Gufa ki deewar par ek chhota abhilekh ek aisi lipi me hai jo aam taur par samajh me nahi aati; andaaza hai ki usme kisi yatri ka naam likha hoga. Is gufa ka dwar chhota hai, lekin usme ek khidki bhi hai, jisse hawa aur roshni andar aati hai; Barabar ki gufao me aisi roshni nahi hoti. Iske bhitar ki chattan kamzoor aur dararon wali hai, isliye usme paani tapakta hai aur kuchh hissa gir bhi chuka hai. Exam point: Sonbhandar gufa ke beech chhode gaye chaukor piramid jaisa patthar ke har or ek khada do-bhuja purush tarasha gaya hai, jiske saath har or alag-alag chinh bhi bane hain.

qe: On a brick mound in the centre of the valley between the five hills at Rajgir stands a small Jain temple built in 1780 and called what?
qh: राजगीर की पाँच पहाड़ियों के बीच घाटी के केंद्र में ईंटों के टीले पर 1780 में बना एक छोटा जैन मंदिर है, जिसे क्या कहते हैं?
e: Rajgir ghati ke beech, paanch pahadiyon ke kendra me, lagbhag bees feet ooncha ek eenton ka teela hai. Is teele ke upar ek chhota Jain mandir hai, jise Maniar Math kaha jata hai aur jo 1780 me banwaya gaya tha. Bauddh itihas ke is bade kendra me Jain mandir ka bana hona dikhata hai ki samay ke saath Rajgir me Jain dharm ka bhi prabhav badha. Isi teele ke paas 1908-9 me ki gayi khudai se ek eenton ka dhancha mila, jise Sir John Marshall ne ek vishal linga maanne ki or jhukav dikhaya. Is tarah ek hi kshetra me Bauddh, Jain tatha Shaiv teeno paramparaon ke chinh ek saath milte hain. Exam point: Rajgir ghati ke kendra me eenton ke teele par 1780 me bana chhota Jain mandir Maniar Math kehlata hai.

qe: The excavations at Rajgir in 1908-9 disclosed a brick structure which Sir John Marshall was inclined to consider as what?
qh: 1908-9 में राजगीर की खुदाई से मिली ईंटों की एक संरचना को सर जॉन मार्शल क्या मानने की ओर झुके थे?
oe: The base of a Jain temple
e: Dr. T. Bloch ne Rajgir me 1908-9 me khudai karayi, jisme ek eenton ka dhancha mila. Is dhanche ko Sir John Marshall ek vishal linga maanne ki or jhuke the. Linga Shiv ka pratirup hota hai, jiski pooja Shaiv parampara me hoti hai. Is dhanche ke aadhar ke charon taraf das stucco yaani chune ke plastar ki moortiyan niches me lagi thi, jinhe pilasters yaani chhote stambh alag-alag karte the; inhe Dr. Bloch ne aarambhik Gupta kaal ka bataya. In moortiyon me Siva aur Ganesa ke saath Banasura tatha ek linga tha, aur chhah nagis yaani sarpa-devtaayein thi, jinhe aas-paas ki pahadiyon par pooja jane wali devtaayein mana gaya. Exam point: Rajgir me 1908-9 ki khudai se mile eenton ke dhanche ko Sir John Marshall ek vishal linga maanne ki or jhuke the.

qe: How many stucco images, arranged in niches divided by pilasters, stood round the base of the brick structure found at Rajgir in 1908-9?
qh: 1908-9 में राजगीर से मिली ईंटों की संरचना के आधार के चारों ओर पिलास्टरों से बँटी दीवारगीरों में कितनी स्टक्को प्रतिमाएँ थीं?
e: Us eenton ke dhanche ke aadhar ke charon taraf das stucco moortiyan thi, jo niches yaani deewar me bane chhote khanchon me rakhi gayi thi aur pilasters yaani chhote stambh in khancho ko alag karte the. Stucco ek tarah ka chuna-plastar hota hai, jise geele rahne par dhal kar tarasha ja sakta hai; isliye aisi moortiyan pathar ki tulna me jaldi banti thi, lekin bahut nazuk bhi hoti thi. Yahi kaaran hai ki khudai ke samay yah moortiyan bahut achhi halat me thi, par baad me lagbhag poori tarah toot-phoot gayin. In moortiyon me Siva, Ganesa, Banasura, ek linga tatha chhah nagis shamil thi, jinhe aarambhik Gupta kaal ka bataya gaya. Exam point: Rajgir ke eenton ke dhanche ke aadhar ke charon taraf das stucco moortiyan thi, jinhe aarambhik Gupta kaal ka bataya gaya.

qe: The artificial cave at Rajgir called Sonbhandhar, whose interior is chiselled to a steely polish, closely resembles which other group of caves?
qh: राजगीर की सोनभंडार नाम की कृत्रिम गुफा, जिसका भीतरी भाग इस्पात जैसी चमक तक तराशा गया है, किस अन्य गुफा-समूह से बहुत मिलती है?
e: Sonbhandhar ka matlab hai sone ka khazana. Yah Rajgir me purane nagar aur naye nagar ke beech ki ghati me Paibhar pahadi ke dakshin charan par thos chattan ko kaat kar banayi gayi ek krtrim gufa hai, jiska bhitar itna chamkaya gaya hai ki woh ispat jaisa chamakta hai. Apni isi banawat ke kaaran yah Barabar ki gufaon se bahut milti hai, isliye iska nirman bhi usi kaal ka mana jata hai, kyunki Maurya kal me Barabar me aisi chamki hui gufayein banayi gayi thi. Lekin yahan ka patthar Barabar se bahut ghata hua hai aur jagah-jagah dararon se kata hua hai, isliye iska kuchh hissa gir chuka hai. Yah gufa Jain logon ke liye poojya sthal hai. Exam point: Sonbhandhar gufa apni chamki hui banawat ke kaaran Barabar ki gufao se milti hai, isliye ise usi kal ka nirman mana jata hai.

qe: A stone with two footprints and a short inscription in relief near Rajgir, called by the Brahmans the feet of an avatar of Vishnu, was shown by the inscription to belong to whom?
qh: राजगीर के पास मिला वह पत्थर, जिस पर दो पद-चिह्न और उभरे अक्षरों में एक छोटा अभिलेख है और जिसे ब्राह्मण विष्णु के अवतार के चरण बताते हैं, अभिलेख के अनुसार किसका निकला?
e: Rajgir ke paas ek purane math ke khandahar me ek patthar mila, jis par do charan-chinh bane the aur unke saath ubhare hue aksharon me ek chhota abhilekh tha. Ubhare akshar yaani relief ka matlab hai woh likhai jo patthar ki satah se thodi unchi utkari gayi ho, jo aam taur par khudai wali lipi se alag hoti hai. Yahan ke Brahman is patthar ko Vishnu ke ek avatar ke charan batate the, lekin abhilekh ke shuru ke akshar un takniki shabdon me the jo Jain log Ganesh ke naam se pehle lagate the. Isse saaf hua ki yah patthar Bauddh ya Vaishnav nahi, balki Jain parampara se juda hai. Aise udaaharan dikhate hain ki abhilekh tatha lipi ki jaankari ke bina purane chinh ki dharmik pehchan karna bhool ho sakti hai. Exam point: Brahmanon dwara Vishnu ke avatar ke charan bataye jane wale patthar ka abhilekh use Jain parampara se jodta tha.

qe: An image called a Sahasra Linga, found among the old images at Rajgir, implies what?
qh: राजगीर की पुरानी प्रतिमाओं में मिली सहस्र लिंग नाम की प्रतिमा किस बात का प्रतीक है?
e: Rajgir ke purane mandiron me kai prachin moortiyan mili thi, jinme ek pithika par baitha hua Buddha tatha uske niche khada ek manushya, ek Gauri Shankar, ek Vasudeva, do Sahasra Ling tatha ek sinh ki aakriti shamil thi. Sahasra ka matlab ek hazaar hota hai, isliye Sahasra Ling ka matlab ek hazaar ling hota hai; aisi moorti me ek hi patthar par chhote-chhote hazaaron ling khode hote the, jo Shiv ki anant shakti tatha unke anek roopon ka prateek the. Isi jagah ek sinh ki chap wali moorti bhi mili, jise Gautam Buddha ka ek alankaran bataya gaya. Is prakar ek hi sthal par Shiv, Vishnu, Buddha tatha Devi ki moortiyan milna Rajgir ke dharmik mail-jol ko dikhata hai. Exam point: Sahasra Ling pratik ek hazaar ling ka hota hai, aur Rajgir me aisi moorti Shiv ki anant upasana ka chinh hai.

qe: A figure of eight females sitting on different animals, oxen, elephants, swine, peacocks and geese, was seen built into the wall of a Jain temple at Rajgriha; a similar figure at Gaya is called what?
qh: राजगृह के एक जैन मंदिर की दीवार में आठ स्त्रियों की आकृति देखी गई, जो बैल, हाथी, सूअर, मोर और हंस जैसे अलग-अलग पशु-पक्षियों पर बैठी हैं; गया में ऐसी आकृति को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Rajgir ki do nazdiki pahadiyon par khudi hui likhaiyon ko dekhne ke liye bheje gaye karmachari ne bataya ki pashchimi pahadi par paanch naye Jain mandir hain. Inme se char mandiron me paduka yaani Tirthankar ke charan-chinh rakhe hain, aur unme se teen par likhai bhi hai; do jagah kuchh moortiyan deewar me jad di gayi hain. Ek mandir me Das Avatar ki moorti tatha ek abhilekh hai, aur ek anya mandir me aath striyan alag-alag pashu-pakshiyon par baithe hue dikhai gayi hain - bail, hathi, suar, mor tatha hans. Gaya kshetra me aisi hi aakriti ko Naugraha yaani nau grahon ka chinh kaha jata tha, aur wahan us par ek abhilekh bhi mila hai. Ek anya mandir me ek Jain khade hue hain, jinke dono hatheliyan aage ki or gumi hui hain aur unke saath abhilekh hai. Exam point: Aath striyon wali yah aakriti, jo alag-alag pashu-pakshiyon par baithi hain, Gaya me Naugraha ke naam se jani jati hai.

qe: The great seated Buddha image on the Yogespur mound at Rajgir, carved under a jamun tree, was worshipped by two Brahman priests who called it what, disregarding its sex?
qh: राजगीर के योगेशपुर टीले पर जामुन के पेड़ के नीचे बनी बैठे बुद्ध की बड़ी प्रतिमा की पूजा दो ब्राह्मण पुजारी करते थे, जो उसके लिंग का विचार न करते हुए उसे क्या कहते थे?
e: Rajgir se lagbhag do mile dakshin me, ek chhote sookhe talab ke pashchim kinare par eenton ka ek teela hai, jise Yogespur kaha jata hai. Is teele par kai moortiyan hain, jinme sabse pehle drishti ek badi Buddha ki moorti par jaati hai, jo jamun ke ped ke niche baithi hui hai, uska ek haath ghutne par rakha hua hai, aur uske aas-paas patthar par kai aakritiyan bani hain; is moorti par ek chhota abhilekh bhi hai. Is moorti ki pooja do Brahman pujari karte the, jo ise Jagadamba yaani Devi kehte the, kyunki woh moorti ke purush ya stri hone ka koi vichar nahi karte the. Isi teele par eenton me aadhi dhui hui ek anya Buddha moorti, do chhoti Buddha moortiyan jinme se ek par abhilekh hai, tatha khade purush ki moorti bhi mili. Exam point: Yogespur ki badi Buddha moorti ko uske pujari Jagadamba yaani Devi kehte the, uske ling ka vichar kiye bina.

qe: The stone for the mosque at Silao, whose foundation is even by the local Muslims ascribed to Vikramaditya, was wholly obtained from what kind of buildings?
qh: सिलाव की मस्जिद, जिसकी नींव स्थानीय मुसलमान भी विक्रमादित्य से जोड़ते हैं, के लिए पत्थर किस प्रकार की इमारतों से लिया गया था?
oh: राजगीर की पहाड़ियों की खानों से
e: Silao me do makbark tatha ek masjid hai, jiski dewaron aur farash par Persian aur Arabic lipi me kai abhilekh khude hain. Yah masjid patthar aur chune se bani hai, aur uske samne ka farash patthar se pura hua hai. Sabse mahatvapurna baat yah hai ki is masjid ka saara patthar Hindu ya Bauddh imaraton ko tod kar liya gaya tha; farash to goya khambon ka ek dhair hai, jisse saaf pata chalta hai ki patthar dene wali purani imaratein bahut zyada tatha vishal thi. Silao ki sthapna ka shrey bhi Vikramaditya ko diya jata hai, aur yahan ki mithaiyan tatha bhuni chawal ki prasiddhi unhi ke bithaye halwaiyon se jodi jati hai. Exam point: Silao ki masjid ka saara patthar Hindu ya Bauddh imaraton se liya gaya tha, aur uska farash khambon se hi bana hua tha.

qe: The ancient name Tailadhaka is found written in characters of which period on a stone now used as a lintel over the door of the stone mosque at Telarha?
qh: तेलाढ़ा की पत्थर की मस्जिद के दरवाज़े पर अब चौखट की तरह लगे एक पत्थर पर प्राचीन नाम तैलधक किस काल की लिपि में लिखा मिला?
e: Telarha ke purane vihar ke patthar baad me yahan ki masjidon tatha makbaron me lag gaye, aur inhi pattharon par purani likhai ke chinh bach gaye. Isi prakar ek patthar, jo ab masjid ke darwaze par chaukhat ke roop me laga hua hai, uspar is sthal ka purana naam Tailadhak likha mila hai. Yah likhai aath sau se barah sau Isvi tak ke Pal kaal ki lipi ke aksharon me hai, isliye yah sthal ki itihasik pehchan ka mahatvapurna pramaan mana jata hai. Iske alava is masjid ko log Sangi Masjid yaani patthar ki masjid kehte hain, aur yah ek Bauddh mandir ke sthal par banayi gayi thi. Is tarah purane pattharon par mili likhai hi un imaraton ke itihas ko jodne me sahayak hoti hai. Exam point: Tailadhak naam mashid ke darwaze par lage patthar par Pal kaal yaani 800-1200 Isvi ki lipi me khuda mila.

qe: The largest temple at Daphtu, though called Parswanath, seems to have belonged to the Jains because its very fine lintel showed what?
qh: दफ्तू का सबसे बड़ा मंदिर पार्श्वनाथ कहलाता था, पर वह जैनों का लगता है क्योंकि उसकी बहुत सुंदर लिंटेल यानी दरवाज़े के ऊपर का पत्थर क्या दिखाती थी?
oe: A bull with a trident and a drum carved on it
A lion rampant at each end with a female figure in the middle
A row of Tirthankara figures with a wheel above them
Two snake figures with a human head beneath them
oh: उस पर खुदा हुआ त्रिशूल और डमरू वाला बैल
दोनों सिरों पर उछलता हुआ सिंह तथा बीच में एक स्त्री-प्रतिमा
ऊपर चक्र के साथ तीर्थंकरों की कतार
नीचे मनुष्य के सिर के साथ दो सर्प-आकृतियाँ
e: Daphtu ke toote teele par sabse bada mandir tha, jise Parswanath ke naam se jana jata tha; Parswanath Jain parampara ke ek Tirthankar hain, isliye naam se yah mandir Jain lagta hai. Lekin uski bachi hui sundar lintel yaani darwaze ke upar rakhe jane wale patthar par do khaas chinh the - lintel ke dono siro par ek-ek sinha yaani sher uchhalta hua bana tha tatha iske beech me ek stri ki moorti baithi hui thi, jiski mudra Bauddh moortiyon ki sadharan mudra jaisi thi. Yah mishrit chinh dikhate hain ki yah mandir sambhavtah Bauddh tha, lekin baad me Jain ke roop me jana gaya, ya dono paramparaon ka is par adhikar raha. Isi sthal par granite ke bade pattharon wala ek ped bhi tha, jise ek Pir ki dargah bataya jata tha. Exam point: Daphtu ke Parswanath naam ke sabse bade mandir ki lintel par dono siro par uchhalta hua sinha tatha beech me Bauddh mudra me baithi stri ki moorti bani thi, isliye yah mandir Bauddh tatha Jain, dono se juda mana gaya.

qe: The stone lying near the Baitok Bhairab at Baragang contained which sculptured subject, such as was also found at Rajagriho?
qh: बारागंग में बैतोक भैरव के पास पड़ा पत्थर किस मूर्तिकला-विषय को दिखाता था, जैसा राजगृह में भी मिला था?
oe: A Naga couple under serpent hoods
A scene of a monkey and his wife
oh: बंदर और उसकी पत्नी का दृश्य
e: Baragang me Baitok Bhairab naam ke sthal ke paas ek patthar pada tha, jispar Buddhon ki ek mandali yaani samuh bana hua tha; isi tarah ka patthar Rajgriho me bhi mila tha. Aise pattharon par kai Buddha-moortiyan ek saath banayi jaati hain, jisme mukhya Buddha ke saath unke shishya ya chhote Buddha bhi dikhaye jate hain, isliye ek hi shila par poora dharmik drishya bana hua dikhta hai. Baitok yaani baithak, prachin parampara me kisi raja ke baithne ka chabutra hota tha, tatha Bhairab Shiv ke ek ugra roop ka naam hai. Rajgir kshetra me Bauddh tatha Shiv-upasana, dono ke chinh ek hi jagah milte hain, isliye aise patthar purani saanskritik paramparaon ke mel ko darshate hain. Exam point: Baitok Bhairab ke paas pada patthar Buddhon ki ek mandali yaani samuh dikhata tha, jaisa patthar Rajgriho me bhi mila tha; aise shila-patthar ek hi jagah kai Buddha-moortiyan darshate hain.

qe: The three Sesanag figures found on the Yogespur mound at Rajgir represented what?
qh: राजगीर के योगेशपुर टीले पर मिली तीन सेसनाग आकृतियाँ किस बात को दर्शाती थीं?
oe: A single snake coiled round a stone pillar
A seated Buddha protected by one Naga hood
Two many-headed Nagas, each with a human figure under the hoods
A Naga king worshipping a Siva Linga
oh: पत्थर के स्तंभ पर लिपटा हुआ एक सांप
एक नाग-छत्र से ढका बैठा हुआ बुद्ध
दो बहु-मुख नाग, जिनमें से हर एक के फन के नीचे एक मानव-आकृति
e: Yogespur ke teele par teen Sesanag naam ki moortiyan mili thin, jo apni banawat ke liye kaafi anokhi mani gayi. Sesanag yaani sesh-naag, yaani sarp-raja, jispar hindu parampara me bhagwan Vishnu tatha anya devata ko baithaya dikhaya jata hai. In moortiyon me do Naga ek doosre se lipte hue Naga-yugal ke roop me banaye gaye the; unke kai siron wale phan ke niche manushya ki ek aakriti dikhayi gayi thi, tatha yeh aakritiyan niche saanp ki poonchh me badal jaati hain. Is tarah ki Naga-moortiyan prachin Bharatiya kala me paani, upjau shakti tatha raksha ke prateek mani jati hain tatha Rajgir ke dharmik sthalon se judi rahti hain. Exam point: Yogespur ke teen Sesanag shilp me do bahu-mukh wale Naga dikhaye gaye, jinme har ek ke phan ke niche ek manushya ki aakriti thi tatha niche yah aakritiyan saanp ki poonchh me badal jaati thin.

qe: The Siva Linga found under a tree at Daphtu was remarkable for bearing four human faces on its sides; how were these faces made up?
qh: दफ्तू में एक पेड़ के नीचे मिला शिवलिंग अपनी बगलों पर बने चार मानव-मुखों के लिए उल्लेखनीय था; ये मुख किस प्रकार के थे?
e: Daphtu me ek ped ke niche ek Shiv Ling mila tha, jispar char manushyakrit chehre bane hue the. Yeh chehre do purushon tatha do striyon ke the. Ling yaani Shiv ka poojya chinh, jiski pooja ling-roop me ki jaati hai; aise lingon par ek ya adhik chehre banna kam milta hai, isliye yah moorti us sthal ki kala tatha dharmik vicharon ke liye mahatvapurna hai. Yah bhi dhyan dene yogya hai ki chehron ko purush tatha stri, dono roopon me dikhaya gaya, jisse ling ke saath stri-tatva tatha purush-tatva, dono ke mel ka sanket milta hai. Isi ped ke niche kai anya moortiyan bhi rakhi thin, jinme ek nritya-mudra wali moorti tatha ek sinha par khadi devi bhi shamil thi. Exam point: Daphtu me mile Shiv Ling par char manushyakrit chehre bane the - do purush tatha do stri; aise char mukh wale ling bahut kam milte hain tatha yah sthal ki kala ki khaas pehchan hai.

qe: The most entire temple at Daphtu, that of Surjo, consisted of which two parts?
qh: दफ्तू का सबसे अच्छी हालत में बचा मंदिर, जो सूर्य का था, किन दो भागों से बना था?
oe: A two-storeyed outer hall and a circular shrine
A pillared outer hall and a rock-cut shrine
A flat-roofed outer hall and a pyramidal shrine
A domed outer hall and a square shrine
oh: दो मंजिला बाहरी मंडप तथा गोल गर्भगृह
स्तंभों वाला बाहरी मंडप तथा चट्टान में कटा गर्भगृह
सपाट छत वाला बाहरी मंडप तथा पिरामिड जैसा गर्भगृह
गुंबद वाला बाहरी मंडप तथा चौकोर गर्भगृह
e: Daphtu me sabse acchi halat me bacha hua mandir surya ka mandir tha, jise Surjo ka mandir kaha jata tha. Yah do bhagon se bana tha - ek sapata chhat wala bahari mandap, jise nat mandir kehte hain, tatha doosra piramidal yaani piramida ke aakar wala garbhagriha, jise mandir kaha jata tha. Nat mandir yaani mandir ke aage ka khula mandap, jahan shraddhalu ikatthe hote the tatha nritya-gayan hota tha; garbhagriha yaani mandir ka woh andaruni kaksh, jahan main moorti sthapit hoti hai. Is mandir ki chhat lambi shilaon se bani thi, jo patthar ke shahbalon par tiki thin tatha unhe khambon ka sahara tha; bahari kataaron ke beech ke khaali hisse eenton se bhare gaye the. Isi tarah mandir ki banawat me patthar tatha eenton, dono ka istemal hua tha, lekin iska darwaza patthar ka tatha kaafi alankrit tha. Exam point: Daphtu ke surya mandir me sapata chhat wala bahari mandap tatha piramidal garbhagriha shamil the; chhat lambi shilaon tatha patthar ke shahbalon se bani thi.

qe: The granite pillar which gave the village of Lat its name lies half sunk in the earth; its shaft was remarkable for having how many plain sides?
qh: जिस ग्रेनाइट स्तंभ के कारण लाट गाँव का नाम पड़ा, वह आधा ज़मीन में धंसा पड़ा है; उसका शीर्ष कितनी सपाट भुजाओं वाला था?
e: Jile me ek gaon ka naam Lat yaani khambha isliye pada, kyunki wahan ek bahut bada tatha sundar granite-stambh pada hua tha. Yah stambh ek hi patthar ka bana tha, jisme nichla aadhaar yaani pedestal, beech ka shirsh yaani shaft tatha upar ka shirsh-bhag yaani capital, teenon ek hi tukde me the. Iski lambai lagbhag teis foot thi, tatha iske shirsh me solah sapata bhujayein yaani plain pahal banayi gayi thi; capital tatha base chaukor the tatha unke aakaar alag-alag the. Stambh pura sidha khada nahi, balki khadi khet ki zameen ke beech aadha zameen me dhansa hua leta tha tatha aas-paas kisi imarat ya talab ka koi chinh nahi tha. Isi tarah khade-lethe patthar ke aise stambh purani kala tatha aane-jaane ki kathao ke gawah ban jate hain. Exam point: Lat gaon ke granite stambh ko sabse alag banane wali baat iska solah sapata bhujaon wala shirsh tha; aadhaar, shirsh tatha capital ek hi patthar me the.

qe: At the temple of Surjo at Daphtu the brickwork had clearly been renewed several times, but which portion seemed of much greater antiquity?
qh: दफ्तू के सूर्य मंदिर की ईंट की चिनाई स्पष्ट रूप से कई बार नवीकृत की गई थी, पर कौन-सा भाग बहुत अधिक प्राचीन लगता था?
oe: The roof beams of long stone
The stone door and the stonework of the outer temple
The platform and the flight of steps
oh: लंबे पत्थरों से बनी छत की शहबलें
पत्थर का दरवाज़ा तथा बाहरी मंदिर की पत्थर की चिनाई
e: Daphtu ke surya mandir ki banawat dekh kar ek saaf baat samne aati thi - mandir ki patthar ki chizen purani thin, jabki eenton ki chinayi samay-samay par nayi ki gayi thi. Mandir ka darwaza tatha bahari mandir ki patthar ki chinayi bahut adhik purani lagti thi, jabki garbhagriha poori tarah eenton se bana tha tatha uski chinayi baar-baar kisi ne dobara lagayi thi. Patthar ke darwaze par sundar khudai tatha alankaran the, isliye yah bina badle apni jagah bana raha, lekin eenton ki deewarein mausam tatha barish se jaldi kharab hokar nayi karni padti thin. Isi kaaran purani imaraton me patthar ke bhag lambe samay tak bache rehte hain tatha eenton wale bhag baar-baar naye kiye jate hain. Aise varnan se mandir ke purane hisson tatha baad me jode gaye hisson ko alag-alag pehchanne me sahayata milti hai. Exam point: Daphtu ke surya mandir me patthar ka darwaza tatha bahari mandir ki patthar ki chinayi bahut adhik purani thi, jabki eenton wala bhag samay-samay par naya kiya gaya tha.

qe: Local tradition said that the great granite pillar at Lat was being carried by two gods from Nepal to which place, where it was to be set up?
qh: स्थानीय कथा के अनुसार लाट का महान ग्रेनाइट स्तंभ दो देवता नेपाल से कहाँ ले जा रहे थे, जहाँ इसे लगाया जाना था?
e: Lat gaon ke bade granite stambh ke baare me ek lok-katha prachalit thi. Katha ke mutabik is stambh ko do devata Nepal se utha kar le ja rahe the. Stambh ke base tatha capital me jo gaddhe dikhte hain, unhe log in devataon ke siron se bane nishan batate the; kaha jata tha ki pedon ko kaat kar banaye gaye in gaddhon ka upyog chawal ko kootne tatha garam karne ke lie hota tha. Anuman lagaya gaya ki yah stambh Barabar ki pahadiyon me kaata gaya tha tatha ise Baragang le jaaya ja raha tha, lekin raaste me logon ka dhairya toot gaya ya kaam poora nahi ho saka. Lat gaon ka naam bhi isi stambh ke kaaran pada, tatha yah stambh aage chalkar pooja ka vishay ban gaya tatha ek Brahman pujari ko iske liye vaarshik wasooli mili. Exam point: Katha ke mutabik Lat ka granite stambh do devata Nepal se utha kar Baragang le ja rahe the; aagman ke nishan uspar bane gaddhon ke roop me batate hain.

qe: The ruined temple standing immediately north of the temple of Surjo at Daphtu had contained what?
qh: दफ्तू के सूर्य मंदिर के ठीक उत्तर में खड़े टूटे मंदिर में क्या रखा था?
oe: A stone basin for ritual bathing
oh: स्नान के लिए पत्थर का कुंड
e: Daphtu ke surya mandir ke thoda uttar me ek anya mandir tha, jo lagbhag poori tarah toot chuka tha. Us mandir ke andar ek bahut bada ling tha, yaani Shiv ka poojya chinh; ling ke aage ek moorti rakhi thi, jise pujari Gauri Shankar kehta tha, lekin asal me woh purush ki moorti thi tatha uske saath do stri-moortiyan thin. Iske thoda uttar me Kanaiya ka mandir tha, jisme keval ek kaksh tha tatha jiski chhat stambhon par tiki thi; uske eenton ki chinayi toot chuki thi aur phir uske daada ke samay nayi ki gayi thi. Isi kshetra me surya, Shiv tatha Kanaiya tatha Parswanath ke mandir aas-paas hone se Daphtu ek bahudha dharmik sthal ka roop dhaaran karta tha. Exam point: Daphtu me surya mandir ke turant uttar wale toote mandir me ek bahut bada ling tha, jiske aage pujari ke Gauri Shankar kehne wali purush-moorti do stri-moortiyon ke saath rakhi thi.

qe: When the lintel of the Kanaiya temple at Daphtu was broken, the side of a door taken from which temple was put in its place?
qh: दफ्तू के कनैया मंदिर की लिंटेल टूट जाने पर किस मंदिर के दरवाज़े का एक पार्श्व उसकी जगह लगाया गया था?
oe: The temple with the great linga
