e: Daphtu me Kanaiya ka mandir surya mandir ke thoda uttar me sthit tha tatha isme keval ek hi kaksh tha, jiski chhat stambhon par tiki thi. Iske eenton ki chinayi toot chuki thi tatha uske daada ne iski marammat karayi thi, lekin phir woh kaafi kharab ho gayi. Mandir ka darwaza patthar ka tatha kaafi alankrit tha; uske dono paksh bache hue the, lekin darwaze ke upar ki lintel toot gayi thi. Isliye tooti lintel ki jagah Parswanath mandir ke darwaze ka ek pashva lagaya gaya, tatha tooti hui purani lintel darwaze ke paas hi padi rahi. Lintel yaani darwaze ke upar rakhi jane wali lambi patthar ki patti, jo chaukhat ko sahara deti hai. Purane tod-phod wale sthalon par aise patthar tatha darwaze ek mandir se doosre mandir me lag jaana aam baat thi. Exam point: Kanaiya mandir ki tooti lintel ki jagah Parswanath mandir ke darwaze ka pashva lagaya gaya tha, jabki purani tooti lintel darwaze ke paas padi rahi thi.

qe: During the period 1757-1947, there was hardly any single small region in India where so much Sanskrit writing was done as in which part of Bihar, where the literature produced covered more than a dozen subjects?
qh: 1757-1947 की अवधि में भारत के किसी भी छोटे क्षेत्र में इतना संस्कृत लेखन शायद ही हुआ हो जितना बिहार के किस भाग में हुआ, जहाँ की रचनाएँ एक दर्जन से अधिक विषयों को समेटती थीं?
e: 1757 se 1947 tak ke do sau varshon me Bihar me Sanskrit sahitya ki rachna lagatar hoti rahi, vishesh roop se Mithila kshetra me. Kaha ja sakta hai ki Bharat me shayad hi koi aisa chhota kshetra ho, jahan is avadhi me Mithila jitna Sanskrit lekhan hua ho. Wahan ki rachnaon me ek darjan se adhik alag-alag vishay sammilit the tatha likhai ka star bhi nimn nahi tha. Mithila me Sanskrit lekhan ki yah parampara wahan ki Sanskrit vidya ki samriddh virasat tatha har kathinai ke bawajood chalti rahi padhai tatha adhyayan ki parampara ka parinaam thi. Isi parampara ke karan Mithila ke vidvan Sanskrit me alag-alag vishayon par vyakhya, kavya tatha shastra-granth likhte rahe, jisse Bihar ke bauddhik jeevan ki ek mazboot neenv bani. Exam point: 1757-1947 ke dauran Mithila Bharat ka woh kshetra raha, jahan Sanskrit lekhan sabse adhik hua; wahan ki rachnaen ek darjan se adhik vishayon ko sametati thin.

qe: During 1757-1947, the tradition of Sanskrit learning and authorship in Bihar was practically confined to which community, some of whom served even the court of Jammu and Kashmir?
qh: 1757-1947 के दौरान बिहार में संस्कृत अध्ययन और लेखन की परंपरा व्यावहारिक रूप से किस समुदाय तक सीमित थी, जिनमें कुछ जम्मू-कश्मीर के दरबार तक पहुँचे?
e: Is daur me Bihar me Sanskrit seekhne aur likhne ki parampara sirf Maithil panditon tak seemit thi. Ve Bihar me rahte the ya door-door ke durbaron me kaam karte the, yahan tak ki Jammu aur Kashmir ke durbar tak. Doosre vargon ne angrezi shiksha apna li thi, isliye Sanskrit se unka nata kam ho gaya. Isliye Mithila hi Sanskrit ka mukhya kendra bani rahi. Exam point: 1757-1947 ke dauran Bihar me Sanskrit parampara mukhyatah Maithil panditon dwara jeevit rahi.

qe: Around the middle of the 18th century, the Maithili language and its literature showed which combination?
qh: अठारहवीं सदी के मध्य के आसपास मैथिली भाषा और उसके साहित्य में कौन सा संयोजन दिखा?
oe: The language decayed while new forms flourished
The language was replaced by Bengali in writing
The language progressed but literary forms remained old and stereotyped
Both the language and its forms were entirely new
oh: भाषा क्षीण हुई और नए रूप फले-फूले
लेखन में भाषा के स्थान पर बंगला आ गई
भाषा आगे बढ़ी, पर साहित्य के रूप पुराने और रूढ़ बने रहे
भाषा और उसके रूप दोनों पूरी तरह नए थे
e: Maithili ke bare me kaha jata hai ki us daur me bhasha ke roop aage badhe, yaani logon ki bol-chal ki bhasha me sudhar hua, lekin sahitya ke roop purane aur rukhe (stereotyped) rahe. Yaani likhne ke tarike badle nahi, chahe bhasha aage badhi. Isi wajah se purane aur naye lekhakon me antar dikhne laga. Isi daur me Manabodha jaise sudharak lekhak aage aaye, jo aam logon ki bhasha me likhne lage, jabki purane lekhak apne hi tarike par tikay rahe. Exam point: Aathrahvi sadi ke madhya me Maithili bhasha aage badhi, par sahitya ke roop purane aur rukhe rahe.

qe: Apart from poetry and general literature, which three subjects predominated in the Sanskrit writing of Bihar during this period?
qh: इस दौर के बिहार के संस्कृत लेखन में काव्य और सामान्य साहित्य के अलावा कौन से तीन विषय प्रमुख थे?
e: Is daur ki Sanskrit rachnaon me kavya ke alawa teen vishay zyada the: Dharmashastra (dharm aur achar ke niyam), Jyotisha (khagol, ganit aur jyotish) aur Tantra (devi-upasana aur mantra-sadhana se jude granth). Ye teen vishay Mithila me bahut lokpriya the, kyunki yahan tirth, shraddha aur puja ki parampara gehri thi. Isi karan in vishayon par likhe granth Bihar ke itihas ke mahatvapurn saadhan mane jate hain. Exam point: Is period me Dharmashastra, Jyotisha aur Tantra par sarvadhik Sanskrit rachnayen likhi gayin.

qe: The Kirtaniya dramas of Maithili, popular in the 17th-18th centuries, had which legend as their theme and used which languages besides Maithili?
qh: 17वीं-18वीं सदी में लोकप्रिय मैथिली की कीर्तनिया नाट्य-शैली का विषय कौन सी कथा थी और मैथिली के अलावा किन भाषाओं का प्रयोग होता था?
oe: The Krishna legend, with abundant use of Sanskrit and Prakrit
The Rama legend, with use of Pali
The Shiva legend, with use of Apabhramsha
The Ganesha legend, with use of Persian
oh: कृष्ण की कथा, संस्कृत और प्राकृत के भरपूर प्रयोग के साथ
राम की कथा, पालि के प्रयोग के साथ
शिव की कथा, अपभ्रंश के प्रयोग के साथ
गणेश की कथा, फ़ारसी के प्रयोग के साथ
e: Kirtaniya natya ek Maithili gaayan-natya shaili thi, jisme Krishna ki katha ka gungan hota tha. In dramon me Sanskrit aur Prakrit ke shabd khulkar istemal hote the. Ye parampara 18th sadi me chalti rahi aur 19th sadi me bhi jaari rahi. Pali, Apabhramsha aur Parsi is parampara se jude nahi hain. In natyon me gaayan ke saath abhinay bhi hota tha, isliye inhe gaayan-natya bhi kaha jata hai. Aaj bhi Mithila me aise natya manchit kiye jate hain. Exam point: Kirtaniya dramas ka vishay Krishna ki katha tha aur inme Sanskrit aur Prakrit ka bharpur prayog hua.

qe: The Sanskrit literature produced in Bihar between 1757 and 1947 is best described by which statement?
qh: 1757 और 1947 के बीच बिहार में रचा गया संस्कृत साहित्य किस कथन से सबसे अच्छी तरह वर्णित होता है?
oe: Only poetry was written and no prose at all
Only translations from Persian were prepared
Production was ample but originality was generally lacking
Production was very small and completely imitative
oh: केवल काव्य लिखा गया, गद्य नहीं
रचना बहुत हुई, पर मौलिकता सामान्यतः कम रही
रचना बहुत कम हुई और पूरी तरह नकल थी
e: Is daur me Sanskrit me bahut likha gaya, chhote-bade, mool aur tika-granth sab. Lekin inmein maulikta (originality) kam thi, yaani zyadatar rachnayen purane granthon ki tika, vivaran ya unhi ke aadhar par likhi gayi. Isliye kaha jata hai ki matra adhik thi, lekin naye vichar kam the. Isi karan is daur ko matra ke aadhar par amir, lekin naye vicharon ke aadhar par garib kaha jata hai. Exam point: Is daur ka Sanskrit sahitya matra me bharpur tha, kintu maulikta kam thi.

qe: Which two 17th-century masters are credited with laying down the set frame of the Kirtaniya type of Maithili dramas?
qh: मैथिली के कीर्तनिया नाट्यों का निर्धारित ढाँचा बनाने का श्रेय 17वीं सदी के किन दो आचार्यों को दिया जाता है?
e: Kirtaniya natya ka ek nirdharit dhancha (set frame) hota tha, yaani katha, gaayan aur bhasha ka pattern tay tha. Ye dhancha Umapati aur Ramadas naam ke do 17th sadi ke acharya lekhakon ne banaya. Aage ke lekhak isi dhanche ko follow karte rahe. Vidyapati bhale hi Maithili ke sabse bade kavi hain, par Kirtaniya ka dhancha Umapati aur Ramadas ka mana jata hai. Exam point: Kirtaniya dramas ka set frame Umapati aur Ramadas ne tay kiya.

qe: Vakachya-tarangini, a notable work among the lexicons of this period, was a dictionary of which two languages?
qh: इस दौर के शब्दकोशों में उल्लेखनीय वाकच्य-तरंगिणी किन दो भाषाओं की शब्दकोश थी?
e: Kosha matlab shabdkosh yaani dictionary. Is daur ke kosha-granthon me Vakachya-tarangini khaas hai kyunki yah Parsi aur Sanskrit ki shabdkosh thi. Isse pata chalta hai ki us waqt Parsi aur Sanskrit dono bhashaon ke vidwan maujood the aur dono paramparaon ka mel ho raha tha. Aise kosha-granth vidwanon ko dono bhashaon ke shabd tulanatmak roop se seekhne me madad karte the. Vidwan aise kosha-granthon se do bhashaon ke shabd aasani se yaad kar lete the. Exam point: Vakachya-tarangini Parsi-Sanskrit shabdkosh thi.

qe: Which Maithili poet's Krishna-janma, written in the mid-18th century, simplified the language to bring it nearer the spoken tongue and attempted a Mahakavya?
qh: अठारहवीं सदी के मध्य में लिखी किस मैथिली कवि की कृष्ण-जन्म ने भाषा को बोलचाल के निकट लाने का प्रयास किया और महाकाव्य रचा?
e: Manabodha ko reformist yaani sudharak lekhak mana jata hai. Unki rachna Krishna-janma me unhone bhasha ko bahut saral kiya, taaki aam bolne wali Maithili ke kareeb aa sake. Mahakavya matlab bada kavya, ek lambi katha-kavya rachna, jisme Purana ki kathaon ko vishay banaya jata hai. Unka tarika purane lekhakon se hat kar tha. Exam point: Manabodha ki Krishna-janma ne Maithili ko bol-chal ki bhasha ke kareeb laane ka prayas kiya.

qe: Which Sanskrit work by Vijayagovind, described as a modern Purana, gives the history of the kings of India from the beginning of the Kal yuga up to Warren Hastings?
qh: आधुनिक पुराण कही जाने वाली विजयगोविंद की कौन सी संस्कृत कृति कलियुग के आरंभ से वारेन हेस्टिंग्स तक भारत के राजाओं का इतिहास देती है?
e: Purana purane rajaon aur devtaon ki kathayen batate hain. Rajavali usi tarah ki rachna hai, isliye use aadhunik Purana kaha gaya. Isme Kal yuga ke aarambh se lekar Warren Hastings, angrezi Governor-General, tak Bharat ke rajaon ka itihas diya gaya hai, aur iske lekhak Vijayagovind the. Kalhana ki Rajatarangini, Banabhatta ka Harshacharita aur Bilhana ka Vikramankadevacharita anya vishayon ki prasiddh rachnayen hain. Exam point: Vijayagovind-krit Rajavali ko aadhunik Purana kaha jata hai, jo Warren Hastings tak ka rajaon ka itihas deti hai.

qe: Ramapati, who refused to deviate from the classical Kirtaniya tradition, was the author of which work?
qh: शास्त्रीय कीर्तनिया परंपरा से हटने से इनकार करने वाले रामपति किस कृति के रचयिता थे?
e: Ramapati classicist lekhak the, yaani ve purani Kirtaniya parampara se hatna nahi chahte the. Unki prasiddh rachna Rukmini-harana hai, jisme Rukmini ke haran, yaani vivah ke liye unke le jaane ki katha hai. Is daur me Mithila me aisi kavya-rachanaen Krishna aur unki leela se judi kathaon par hoti thi. Us daur me Mithila me aisi kavya-rachanaen Krishna aur unki leela se judi kathaon par hoti thi, isliye Ramapati ne bhi wahi marg chuna. Exam point: Classical Kirtaniya parampara ke lekhak Ramapati ki rachna Rukmini-harana hai.

qe: Rajavallabha Misra wrote a Sanskrit work on which subject at the instance of Colebrooke?
qh: राजवल्लभ मिश्र ने कॉलब्रुक के कहने पर किस विषय पर संस्कृत ग्रंथ लिखा?
oh: सही ढंग से मुंडन के नियम
e: Colebrooke ek angrezi vidwan the jo Sanskrit me gehri ruchi rakhte the, aur unke kehne par kai Sanskrit rachnayen likhi gayin. Unke nirdesh par Rajavallabha Misra ne Bharat ke teerth-sthano, yaani places of pilgrimage, par granth likha. Isse dikhta hai ki angrezi vidwanon ki ruchi ne bhi Sanskrit lekhon ko badhava diya. Is granth se Bharat ke teerth-sthanon ka purana vivran milta hai, jo itihas aur dharm dono ke liye mahatvapurn hai. Exam point: Teerth-sthanon ka Sanskrit granth Rajavallabha Misra ne Colebrooke ke aagrah par likha.

qe: As the Kirtaniya dramas widened beyond the Krishna theme, typically Maithili customs such as kovara, nainajogina and batagamani were introduced in them as a concession to what?
qh: जब कीर्तनिया नाट्य कृष्ण-कथा से आगे बढ़े, तब कोवरा, नैनाजोगिन और बटगमनी जैसे विशिष्ट मैथिली रीति-रिवाज उनमें किस बात को ध्यान में रखकर जोड़े गए?
oe: The popular taste and demand of the people
The orders of the king of Darbhanga
The advice of the pandits of Mithila
oh: जनता की लोकप्रिय रुचि और माँग
e: Jab Kirtaniya dramas me Krishna ke alawa anya kathayen, jaise Shiv-Parvati ka vivah, aane lagin, to unme Mithila ke lok-achar jaise kovara, nainajogina aur batagamani bhi daale gaye. Ye concession to popular taste tha, yaani logon ki ruchi aur maang ko dekh kar lekhakon ne ye badlav kiya, taaki natya lokpriya bana rahe. Exam point: Lok ruchi aur maang ke karan Kirtaniya dramas me Mithila ke lok-achar jaise kovara aur batagamani jagah paye.

qe: Yogadatta Jha wrote Vapanaviveka, which lays down rules for doing correctly which everyday act?
qh: योगदत्त झा ने वपनविवेक लिखा, जो किस रोज़मर्रा के काम को सही ढंग से करने के नियम बताता है?
e: Is daur ke Dharmashastra granthon me roz ke kaam ke niyam bhi likhe gaye. Vapana matlab mundan ya shaving. Yogadatta Jha ki Vapanaviveka batati hai ki shaving kaise ki jaye, kis din aur kis niyam ke saath. Isse pata chalta hai ki vidwan chhoti-chhoti baaton ko bhi shastra me likh dete the. Aise granth dikhate hain ki us daur me roz ke chhote kriyakarm bhi niyamon me bandhne lage the. Exam point: Yogadatta Jha ki Vapanaviveka shaving ke niyamon ka granth hai.

qe: Instead of writing in the spoken language of the people, later Maithili writers such as Ratnapani and Harsanath adopted which style?
qh: जनता की बोलचाल की भाषा में लिखने के बजाय रत्नपाणि और हर्षनाथ जैसे बाद के मैथिली लेखकों ने कौन सी शैली अपनाई?
oe: A simple style of daily conversation
A style borrowed from Persian poetry
A prose-only style with no poetry
An ornate style full of figures of speech on the pattern of later Sanskrit literature
oh: रोज़मर्रा की बोलचाल की सरल शैली
फ़ारसी कविता से उधार ली गई शैली
केवल गद्य की शैली, कविता रहित
बाद के संस्कृत साहित्य की तरह अलंकारों से भरी अलंकृत शैली
e: Maithili me sudharak lekhak bol-chal ki saral bhasha me likhte the, lekin baad ke lekhak Ratnapani aur Harsanath ne iske ulta kiya. Unhone alankrit (ornate) shaili apnayi, yaani shabd-alankar aur upmaon se bhara likhna, jaise baad ke Sanskrit sahitya me hota tha. Isse unki bhasha aam logon se door ho gayi. Is shaili me alankar, upma aur lambi-vakya prayog bahut hote hain, jisse rachna sundar to lagti hai par aam pathak ke liye kathin ho jati hai. Exam point: Ratnapani aur Harsanath ne saral bol-chal ki bhasha chhod kar alankrit shaili apnayi.

qe: Vana-mala, a work of Jyotisha written in this period, deals with which subject?
qh: इस दौर की ज्योतिष की कृति वनमाला किस विषय से संबंधित है?
oe: Rains in different seasons and how to predict them
The names of trees and their uses
oh: भिन्न ऋतुओं की वर्षा और उसका पूर्वानुमान
वृक्षों के नाम और उनके उपयोग
e: Jyotisha me khagol, ganit aur jyotish aate hain. Vana-mala us vishay ki rachna hai jo batati hai ki alag-alag rituon me varsha kaisi hoti hai aur use kaise pehle se bataya ja sakta hai. Krishi par nirbhar samaj ke liye baarish ka anuman, yaani prediction, bahut zaruri tha, isliye aise granth likhe gaye. Aise granthon ka bada mahatva tha, kyunki us samay ganit aur khagol ke sahayak yantra kam the aur log rituon ke lakshanon se hi varsha ka andaza lagate the. Exam point: Vana-mala varsha ke anuman se judi Jyotisha-granth hai.

qe: Vatsyayana's Kamasutra, which remained a classic in this period's tradition of love-literature, was composed centuries earlier at which city?
qh: इस दौर की प्रेम-साहित्य परंपरा में शास्त्रीय बनी रहने वाली वात्स्यायन की कामसूत्र सदियों पहले किस नगर में रची गई थी?
e: Kama-shastra matlab prem aur shringar se jude shastraon ki parampara. Vatsyayana ki Kamasutra, jo aaj bhi classic maani jati hai, sadiyon pehle Pataliputra yaani Patna me likhi gayi thi. Isliye is daur ke lekhak is vishay par likhte waqt usi purani parampara ko aage badha rahe the, na ki koi nayi shuruat kar rahe the. Is vishay ko shastraon me 'Kama' naam se bhi jana jata hai, jo jeevan ke chaar purusharthon me gina jata hai; isliye prem aur vivah se jude niyamon par bhi granth likhe gaye. Exam point: Vatsyayana ki Kamasutra Pataliputra yaani Patna me likhi gayi thi.

qe: In the Sanskrit learning of this period, Mithila maintained a long tradition of fondness for which one of the six classical Darshanas, with many books written on it?
qh: इस दौर के संस्कृत अध्ययन में मिथिला छह शास्त्रीय दर्शनों में किस एक के प्रति विशेष रुचि की लंबी परंपरा बनाए रखी और उस पर अनेक पुस्तकें लिखी गईं?
e: Darshana matlab darshan-shastra. Chhah prasiddh Darshana hain: Nyaya, Vaisheshika, Sankhya, Yoga, Mimamsa aur Vedanta. Nyaya tark, yaani logic ka shastra hai. Mithila me Nyaya bahut lokpriya tha aur is daur me bhi yahan Nyaya par bahut si rachnayen likhi gayin, isliye Mithila ki pehchan Nyaya ke adhyayan se jodi jati hai. Nyaya me praman, tarka aur nishkarsh ke niyam bataye jate hain, isliye vad-vivad me jeetne ke liye us daur ke vidwan Nyaya ka gehra adhyayan karte the. Exam point: Mithila me Nyaya (logic) shastra ka adhyayan sabse zyada prachlit raha.

qe: The devotional and secular writings of which Maithili poets formed a class by themselves, voicing the personal and genuine feelings of the poets concerned?
qh: किन मैथिली कवियों की भक्ति-परक और लौकिक रचनाएँ अपने आप में एक अलग वर्ग बनाती हैं, जो कवियों की व्यक्तिगत और सच्ची भावनाएँ व्यक्त करती हैं?
oe: Sitaram Jha, Badrinath Jha and Surendra Jha
oh: सीताराम झा, बदरीनाथ झा और सुरेंद्र झा
e: Maithili ke is daur ke kai kavi aise the jinki bhakti-bhari aur laukik, yaani sansarik vishayon ki rachnayen kisi purani shaili ki nakal nahi thi. Manganirama, Laksminath aur Sahebaramadas ki rachnayen apne hi varg ki thi, kyunki unme kavi ke apne sachche aur vyaktigat bhav ubharte the. Isliye inhe ek alag class mana jata hai. Exam point: Manganirama, Laksminath aur Sahebaramadas ki rachnayen vyaktigat bhav vyakt karne wali alag shreni maani jati hain.

qe: Bhojpuri is spoken mainly in which two areas of Bihar?
qh: भोजपुरी मुख्यतः बिहार के किन दो क्षेत्रों में बोली जाती है?
e: Bharat me Bhojpuri Uttar Pradesh aur Bihar dono me bolti hai, lekin Bihar me iska mukhya kshetra Saran aur Champaran hai aur inse jude aas-paas ke ilake bhi. Isi bhasha me bahut si lok-sangeet paramparayen maujood hain. Bihar ke alawa Uttar Pradesh ke purvi ilakon me bhi Bhojpuri bolne wale bahut hain, aur ise Bharat ki badi bhashaon me gina jata hai. Exam point: Bihar me Bhojpuri mukhyatah Saran aur Champaran kshetra me bolti hai.

qe: In which period did western influence begin to tell on Maithili literature?
qh: मैथिली साहित्य पर पाश्चात्य प्रभाव किस अवधि में पड़ने लगा?
oe: The second decade of the 20th century
The last quarter of the 19th century
The first quarter of the 19th century
e: Iske pehle Maithili par bahar ka prabhav bahut kam tha, kyunki Mithila ki Sanskrit parampara gehri thi. Angrezi shiksha aur nayi soch ka asar Maithili sahitya par unnisvin sadi ki aakhri chauhai, yaani lagbhag 1875 ke baad padna shuru hua. Usi samay Urdu bhi aane lagi aur bolne-likhne ke naye tarike prachar me aane lage. Naye tarike ke saath angrezi shiksha se aaye vichar bhi Mithila tak pahunche, isliye lekhak samajik vishayon par likhne lage. Exam point: Maithili sahitya par pashchatya prabhav 19vin sadi ki antim chauhai me padne laga.

qe: Who made the first attempt to collect and publish Bhojpuri folk-songs, bringing them out in the Journal of the Royal Asiatic Society and the Indian Antiquary?
qh: भोजपुरी के लोकगीतों को एकत्र कर प्रकाशित करने का पहला प्रयास किसने किया, जिसने इन्हें जर्नल ऑव द रॉयल एशियाटिक सोसाइटी और इंडियन एंटिक्वेरी में छपवाया?
e: Bhojpuri me lokgeet, lok-kathayen aur lok-kathaen, yaani folk-songs, folk-tales aur folk-lore, bahut purane aur bharpur hain. Inhe sabse pehle ek jagah jama karke chhapane ka shrey Dr Grierson ko jata hai, jinhone ye rachnayen Journal of the Royal Asiatic Society aur Indian Antiquary me prakashit karwayin. Unke baad William Crooke, Growse, Irvine aur Archer jaise videshi vidwan bhi aage aaye. Exam point: Bhojpuri lok-sahitya ko sabse pehle kolekt karke chhapane ka kaam Dr Grierson ne kiya.

qe: With the death of which Maharaja in 1860 did the Darbhanga Raj come under the Court of Wards, giving a rude jolt to the patronage of Maithili?
qh: 1860 में किस महाराजा की मृत्यु के बाद दरभंगा राज कोर्ट ऑफ वार्ड्स के अधीन आ गया, जिससे मैथिली के संरक्षण को गहरा झटका लगा?
e: Darbhanga Raj Maithili kaviyon aur vidwanon ko aashray deta tha, isliye uske ashray se Maithili ko badhava milta raha. 1860 me Maharaja Maheshwara Sinha ki mrityu ke baad rajya Court of Wards, yaani sarkari sanrakshan me chala gaya, jisse Maithili ke sanrakshan par gehri chot lagi. Isi daur me Urdu ko badhava mila aur purane tarike peeche reh gaye. Exam point: Maharaja Maheshwara Sinha ki mrityu (1860) ke baad Darbhanga Raj Court of Wards me chala gaya aur Maithili ke sanrakshan ko jhatka laga.

qe: Which Hindi scholar held the opinion that the speakers of no other dialect have made oral preservation of as many songs as the Bhojpuris?
qh: किस हिंदी विद्वान का मत था कि किसी अन्य बोली के बोलने वालों ने भोजपुरी वालों जितने गीत मौखिक रूप से सुरक्षित नहीं रखे?
e: Bhojpuri logon ne apne geeton ko sadiyon tak yaad rakha aur peedhi-dar-peedhi aage badhaya, isliye yahan lok-sahitya ka bhandaar bahut bada hai. Ram Naresh Tripathi ka mat tha ki kisi bhi anya boli ke logon ne itne geet maukhik roop se yaad nahi rakhe jitne Bhojpuri logon ne rakhe. Aise geet aam aadmi ke sukh-dukh ka sachcha chitran karte hain. Exam point: Ram Naresh Tripathi ka mat tha ki Bhojpuri logon ne sabse zyada geet maukhik roop se surakshit rakhe.

qe: The description of the famine of 1881 by which poet is cited as an illustration of the new literary trend in Maithili?
qh: 1881 के अकाल का वर्णन किस कवि ने किया, जिसे मैथिली की नई साहित्यिक प्रवृत्ति के उदाहरण के रूप में गिनाया जाता है?
e: 1881 ka akal Bihar me bahut bhayanak tha aur logon ka jeevan hila gaya. Chaturakavi ne us akal ka jo varnan kiya, wo nayi paristhiti aur naye dukh ka sachcha chitran tha, isliye use nayi sahityik pravritti ka udaharan mana jata hai. Isse pata chalta hai ki Maithili sahitya ab samajik sachchai ki taraf badh raha tha. Us samay ke kavi ab sirf purani kathayen nahi, balki logon ke dukh-dard ko bhi kavita ka vishay banana shuru kar rahe the. Exam point: 1881 ke akal ka varnan karne wale kavi Chaturakavi maane jate hain.

qe: The Bhojpuri songs sung at the birth of a son are of which two varieties?
qh: पुत्र के जन्म पर गाए जाने वाले भोजपुरी गीत किन दो प्रकार के होते हैं?
e: Bhojpuri lok-sahitya me paitrik geet kam nahi hain. Putra ke janm par do tarah ke geet gaye jate hain: Sohar aur Khelauna. Sohar me bacche ke janm ki ghadi, sasural walon ki chinta aur dai ki maang jaise vishay aate hain, jabki Khelauna me naye janme bacche ke rone, maa ke harsh aur parivar ki khushi ke geet hote hain. Aise geeton me parivar ki khushi aur maa-bacche ka rishta bahut sajiv roop me dikhta hai. Exam point: Putra-janm ke Bhojpuri geet Sohar aur Khelauna do prakar ke hote hain.

qe: In this period, the whole of which work of Vidyapati was rendered into Maithili prose?
qh: इस दौर में विद्यापति की किस रचना को पूरी तरह मैथिली गद्य में अनूदित किया गया?
e: Vidyapati Maithili ke sabse bade kavi hain, lekin unki rachnaen zyadatar pad ya kavya me thi. Is daur me unki Purusha-Pariksha, jo ek gadya-kavya jaisi rachna hai aur manushya ke gun-dosh ki pariksha se judi hai, ko Maithili gadya me anuvad kiya gaya. Isse Maithili gadya ke vikas ko bhi bal mila. Is anuvad se Maithili gadya ka shabd-bhandar bhi badha aur aam pathak ko Vidyapati ki rachna samajhne me sahuliyat hui. Exam point: Vidyapati ki Purusha-Pariksha is daur me Maithili gadya me anuvadit hui.

qe: Phagua and Chaita are which type of Bhojpuri folk-songs?
qh: फगुआ और चैता किस प्रकार के भोजपुरी लोकगीत हैं?
oe: Work songs sung while grinding grain
Songs of the various seasons and months of the year
oh: केवल विवाह पर गाए जाने वाले गीत
जाँता में आटा पीसते समय गाए जाने वाले गीत
वर्ष की विभिन्न ऋतुओं और महीनों के गीत
e: Bhojpuri me barah mahine ke liye alag-alag geet hain, jinhe rituon aur mahinon ke geet kaha jata hai. Phagua Phagun ke aas-paas, yaani basant ritu me, aur Chaita Chait mahine me gaya jata hai. In geeton me prem aur shringar ka bhav bhi milta hai, jaise Chaita me koyal se chhidne wala geet. Isi tarah barah mahine ke geet se pata chalta hai ki lok-jeevan rituon ke saath kaise badalta hai. Exam point: Phagua aur Chaita rituon aur mahinon se jude Bhojpuri lokgeet hain.

qe: Why was the beginning of modern prose literature, such as essays, criticism, novels and short stories, delayed in Maithili compared with other parts of Bihar?
qh: निबंध, आलोचना, उपन्यास और कहानी जैसे आधुनिक गद्य साहित्य की शुरुआत बिहार के अन्य भागों की तुलना में मैथिली में क्यों देर से हुई?
oe: Because Sanskrit was completely forgotten there
Because western education was introduced there later
Because Maithili had no script of its own
Because the rulers had banned prose writing
oh: क्योंकि संस्कृत पूरी तरह भुला दी गई थी
क्योंकि वहाँ पाश्चात्य शिक्षा देर से शुरू हुई
क्योंकि मैथिली की अपनी कोई लिपि नहीं थी
क्योंकि शासकों ने गद्य लेखन पर रोक लगा दी थी
e: Bharat ki anya bhashaon me naye gadya roop, jaise essay, aalochna, upanyas aur kahani, angrezi shiksha ke aane ke saath hi shuru ho gaye. Mithila me angrezi shiksha baki Bihar se kuchh der se shuru hui, isliye wahan yeh naya gadya thoda late aaya. Jab aaya, to Maithili ke apne lekhak sitaron ki tarah sabai ho gaye. Exam point: Mithila me pashchatya shiksha der se aane ke karan Maithili me aadhunik gadya baki Bihar se der se shuru hua.

qe: Sohni and Janta are Bhojpuri songs meant to be sung during which activity?
qh: सोहनी और जाँता किस काम के दौरान गाए जाने वाले भोजपुरी गीत हैं?
e: Kai Bhojpuri lokgeet kaam karte waqt gaaye jate hain, aur inhe work songs kaha jata hai. Sohni aur Janta aise hi geet hain, jo zyadatar mahilaen janta, yaani chakki par aata peeste samay gati hain. In geeton me nayi bahu apne sasural ke kasht aur apne pita se shikayat bhi gaakar sunati hai. Aise geet kaam karte waqt ek saath gaane se shram ka bojh kam lagta hai aur mahilaen apne mann ki baat kahi jaati hain. Exam point: Sohni aur Janta shram ke samay, vishesh roop se aata peeste samay gaaye jaane wale Bhojpuri geet hain.

qe: Which Maithili writer broke away completely from the tradition of Kirtaniya dramas and wrote dramas on social problems entirely in Maithili?
qh: किस मैथिली लेखक ने कीर्तनिया नाट्यों की परंपरा को पूरी तरह तोड़कर पूर्णतः मैथिली में सामाजिक समस्याओं पर नाटक लिखे?
e: Purane Kirtaniya dramas me Sanskrit aur Prakrit ke shabd bhari matra me aate the, isliye woh aam logon ki bhasha se door the. Pandit Jivana Jha ne is parampara ko poora todkar sirf Maithili me, aur woh bhi samajik samasyon par natya likhe. Isliye unhe Maithili natya ka naya yug shuru karne wala mana jata hai. Unke natyon me samajik samasyayen, jaise vivah aur parivar ke badalte rishte, vishay bante. Exam point: Pandit Jivana Jha ne Kirtaniya parampara tod kar poori Maithili me samajik samasyon par natya likhe.

qe: In the Bhojpuri folk-songs of the thread ceremony, the boy going to Kashi to study carries a stick of which wood?
qh: यज्ञोपवीत-संस्कार के भोजपुरी लोकगीतों में, पढ़ने के लिए काशी जाने वाला बालक किस लकड़ी की लाठी ले जाता है?
e: Yagyopavit, yaani janeu, ke sanskar me Bhojpuri geet bahut hote hain. In geeton me varnan hai ki bachcha Kashi jaakar padhai karta hai aur raaste ke liye Palasa ki lakdi ki lathi, munja ghaas ka langot aur hiran ki khaal pahanta hai. Ye brahmachari ke tapasvi jeevan ka pratik hai. Isse pata chalta hai ki lok-giton me sanskar ke har chhote-bade detail ka varnan hua hai. Exam point: Bhojpuri lokgeeton me Kashi jane wala brahmachari Palasa (dhak) ki lakdi ki lathi rakhta hai.

qe: Around the time of Jivana Jha and after him, Maithili poets were divided into which two groups?
qh: जीवन झा के समय और उनके बाद मैथिली कवि किन दो वर्गों में बँटे हुए थे?
oe: Those following the old descriptive method and those introducing imaginative elements
Those writing only in Sanskrit and those writing only in Urdu
Those patronised by the Raj and those patronised by the British
Those writing prose and those writing only drama
oh: पुरानी वर्णनात्मक पद्धति अपनाने वाले और कल्पनाशील तत्व जोड़ने वाले
केवल संस्कृत लिखने वाले और केवल उर्दू लिखने वाले
राज के संरक्षण वाले और ब्रिटिश संरक्षण वाले
गद्य लिखने वाले और केवल नाटक लिखने वाले
e: Us daur ke Maithili kavi do vargon me bante the. Pehle varg ke kavi purani varnan, yaani description ki padhdati ko follow karte the, jaise Sitaram Jha aur Badrinath Jha. Doosre varg ke kavi apni rachnaon me kalpanashil, yaani imaginative, tattva jodte the, taaki sahitya me naya aanand mile, jaise Bhubneshwara Singh. Exam point: Us daur ke Maithili kavi do vargon me the, purani varnanatmak shaili wale aur kalpanashil tattva jodne wale.

qe: In a Bhojpuri marriage song, from which place do the fine robes of the bridegroom come?
qh: एक भोजपुरी विवाह-गीत में वर के बढ़िया वस्त्र कहाँ से आते हैं?
e: Bhojpuri vivah geeton me saara vidhi-vidhan, tilak se lekar baraat jaane tak aur vidai tak, gaakar bayan kiya jata hai. Ek geet me poochha jata hai ki sajaya hua haathi kahan se aaya aur itne bade kapde kahan se aaye; jawab me kaha jata hai ki haathi Gorakhpur se aur bade kapde Patna se aate hain, jabki Kashi ka rajkumar vivah karne aaya hai. Exam point: Bhojpuri vivah-geet me varr ke badhiya vastra Patna se aane ka varnan hai.

qe: Which Maithili poet has remained the most popular by sheer dint of his easy style and choice of subject-matter, keeping readers interested for about forty years?
qh: सरल शैली और विषय-चयन के कारण कौन से मैथिली कवि करीब चालीस वर्षों तक पाठकों की रुचि बनाए रखते हुए सबसे लोकप्रिय रहे?
e: Pandit Sitaram Jha ko 'Kavivara' kaha jata hai. Unki shaili bahut saral thi aur unke vishay aam logon se jude the, isliye karib chalis saal tak Mithila ke pathak unki rachnayen padhte rahe. Aise lambe samay tak lokpriyta banaye rakhna kisi bhi lekhak ke liye badi baat hai. Unki rachnaon me aam jeevan ke drishya aur bol-chal ki saral bhasha milti hai, isi karan ve jan-manas ke kavi mane jate hain. Exam point: Pandit Sitaram Jha apni saral shaili aur vishay-chayan ke karan chalis saal tak lokpriy rahe.

qe: Which epic in fifteen cantos by Pandit Badrinath Jha deals with the heroic exploits of Ekavira and leads up to his marriage with Ekavali?
qh: पंडित बदरीनाथ झा का कौन सा पंद्रह सर्गों का महाकाव्य एकवीर के वीरतापूर्ण कारनामों और एकावली से उनके विवाह का वर्णन करता है?
e: Pandit Badrinath Jha ko shuddh kavya-pratibha ke liye sabse behtar mana jata hai. Sanskrit me unki rachna Radha-Premaja bhi prasiddh hui, lekin Maithili me unka bada granth Ekavali hai, jo pandrah sargon ka mahakavya hai. Isme Ekavira ke veerta-bhare karname aur Ekavali se unka vivah bayan hota hai. Sarg matlab kavya ka khand (canto). Exam point: Pandit Badrinath Jha ka pandrah-sargiya mahakavya Ekavali Ekavira aur Ekavali ki katha ke liye jana jata hai.

qe: Which Maithili poet's Asarha is described as the harbinger of the new type of poetry in Maithili?
qh: किस मैथिली कवि की 'असाढ़' को मैथिली में नई तरह की कविता का अग्रदूत बताया जाता है?
e: Maithili me nayi tarah ki kavita, jisme naye vichar aur naye chitra aate hain, ki shuruat late Bhubneshwara Singh 'Bhuvan' ki rachnaon se mani jati hai. Unki rachna 'Asarha' ko us nayi kavita ka agradoot, yaani harbinger, kaha jata hai. Iske baad Mithila kaviyon ka ghar ban gayi aur bahut se naye kavi aage aaye. Uski rachna ne Mithila ke bahut se yuva kaviyon ko nayi shaili me likhne ke liye prerit kiya. Exam point: Bhubneshwara Singh 'Bhuvan' ki 'Asarha' nayi Maithili kavita ka agradoot maani jati hai.

qe: Which new-line Maithili poet is regarded as the most progressive for introducing new ideology and making new experiments in metre and rhythm?
qh: नई धारा के किस मैथिली कवि को नई विचारधारा लाने तथा छंद और लय में नए प्रयोग करने के कारण सबसे प्रगतिशील माना जाता है?
e: Is daur me Mithila me kai naye kavi aage aaye, jaise Achutananda Datta, Bholalal Das, Surendra Jha 'Sumana', Kasikanla Misra 'Madhupa', Chandranath Misra 'Amara' aur Kanchunath Jha 'Kiran'. Inme Baidyanath Misra naye vichar laane aur chhand tatha laya me naye prayog karne ke karan sabse pragatishil mane jate hain. Chhand matlab metre aur laya matlab rhythm. Exam point: Baidyanath Misra naye vicharon aur chhand-laya ke prayogon ke karan sabse pragatishil Maithili kavi mane jate hain.

qe: Which Maithili poet, noted for steadfast adherence to classical poise and dignity, produced literature of permanent interest?
qh: शास्त्रीय संतुलन और गरिमा के प्रति अडिग निष्ठा के लिए प्रसिद्ध किस मैथिली कवि ने स्थायी महत्व का साहित्य रचा?
e: Nayi dhara ke kaviyon me Pandit Surendra Jha apni alag pehchan banate hain. Ve purani shastriya parampara ki garima aur santulan ko pakad kar rakhte the, isliye unki rachnayen aaj bhi padhne layak mani jati hain. Unke aise sahitya ko sthayi, yaani permanent, mahatva ka kaha jata hai, jo samay ke saath purana nahi hota. Exam point: Shastriya garima aur santulan ke karan Pandit Surendra Jha ka sahitya sthayi mahatva ka mana jata hai.

qe: With which Maithili writer did story-writing begin?
qh: मैथिली में कहानी-लेखन किस लेखक से शुरू हुआ?
e: Maithili me kahani aur upanyas ka aarambh Sanskrit-Prakrit ki parampara se nahi, balki naye gadya se hua. Sabse pehle Pandit Parameshwara Jha ne kahaniyan likhi, isliye unhe Maithili kahani-lekhan ka agradoot mana jata hai. Unke baad Pandit Jivacha Misra, Jainatha Chaudhari jaise lekhak aage aaye. Unke baad ke lekhakon ne kahani aur upanyas ke vishay samajik samasyayon se jode, jisse Maithili gadya samriddh hua. Exam point: Maithili me kahani-lekhan ki shuruat Pandit Parameshwara Jha se hoti hai.

qe: Which professor and writer of Maithili, in spite of his satirisation of almost everything old, became widely read for his wit and common sense?
qh: कौन से प्रोफ़ेसर और मैथिली लेखक पुरानी लगभग हर चीज़ की व्यंग्य-आलोचना करने के बावजूद अपनी हाज़िरजवाबी और व्यावहारिक बुद्धि के कारण बहुत पढ़े जाने लगे?
e: Maithili upanyas aur kahani ke pathak bahut kam the, lekin Professor Harimohan Jha ke aane par unki lokpriyta badh gayi. Ve purane riwazon ka vyang, yaani satire, karte the, phir bhi apni haazirjawabi aur vyavaharik buddhi ke karan log unhe khub padhte the. Isse Maithili gadya sahitya ko nayi jiwan mili. Unki rachnaon me Mithila ke madhyam-varg ke jeevan ki jhalak milti hai, isliye ve aam logon ke nazdeek rahe. Exam point: Professor Harimohan Jha vyang ke bawajood apni haazirjawabi aur vivekbuddhi ke karan bahut lokpriy hue.

qe: Which work of Kumar Ganganand Sinha is described as an excellent piece of art dealing with subtle studies of typical Mithila characters?
qh: कुमार गंगानंद सिंह की कौन सी रचना मिथिला के विशिष्ट पात्रों के सूक्ष्म अध्ययन वाली उत्कृष्ट कलाकृति बताई जाती है?
e: Kumar Ganganand Sinha fiction ke purane lekhak the, lekin unki sarvasheshth rachna pichhle bees saalon ki mani jati hai. Unki rachna Agilahi me Mithila ke aam logon ke jeevan aur unke sukshm swabhav ka adhyayan hai, isliye use kala ka umda namuna kaha jata hai. Sukshm matlab bareek, gehri drishti se dekha gaya. Is rachna se Mithila ke samaj ke badalte swaroop ko samajhne me madad milti hai. Exam point: Kumar Ganganand Sinha ki Agilahi Mithila ke paatron ke sukshm adhyayan wali utkrisht rachna hai.
